title: Newtopia
overview: Set in an air defense unit in a high-rise building in Seoul, the drama depicts the process of a soldier, Jae-yoon, and his girlfriend, Yeong-joo, who have just been notified of a breakup, running toward each other while fighting a horde of zombies.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Young-joo, who is focused on adjusting to her new job, grows tired of the constant complaints of her boyfriend, Jae-yoon, who's serving in the anti-aircraft unit at 77 A Tower. She breaks up with Jae-yoon, and he accepts the breakup with a heartfelt voice message. Upon hearing this, Young-joo heads to the tower to meet Jae-yoon, but on her way there, she encounters an unexpected incident.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yoon and his direct junior, In-ho, head down to Eden Hotel, right below their air defense unit, for an errand. Upon arrival, they find a plane crashing into the heart of Seoul, and the hotel turned into a bloody chaos. Meanwhile, Young-joo and Jin-wook also confront zombies and team up with Tae-shik, who happens to be passing by. Together, they begin their fight for survival.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yoon and In-ho, and Soo-jeong and Chef Jung from Eden Hotel manage to return to the air defense unit. However, even the base they thought was safe begins to face the threat of zombies. Meanwhile, Young-joo see the text messages sent by Jae-yoon and confirms that he is safe. She decides to go alone to Tower 77 A where Jae-yoon is located.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: In the midst of the zombie crisis, Jae-yoon and Young-joo reminisce about their happy past and long for each other even more. Meanwhile, Jae-yoon and his squad mourn the loss of their comrades but find relief in the news of a supply helicopter's arrival. Young-joo's group encounters Tripeater, who has been bitten by a zombie but has not yet turned.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: After downing the supply helicopter, First Sergeant Jung Tae-hwa realizes that survival at their station is impossible. He plans to lead his platoon in an escape from the zombie-ridden A Tower. Meanwhile, Young-joo's group finally reaches the gate of A Tower, only to be greeted by a horde of zombies.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Young-joo is left by herself at the Express Bus Terminal Station, but a stroke of luck leads her to a metro staff office, where she gathers supplies to battle the zombies. Meanwhile, Jae-yoon's group reaches Eden Hotel, where they run into Arron Park, who has survived there alone. But the group gets split up by an unexpected attack by the zombies, throwing them into separate hotel rooms.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: On her way to Suseo Station, Young-joo meets a very special person, who helps her reminisce on the good memories with Jae-yoon. She relentlessly fights the zombies alone on her way to Jae-yoon. Meanwhile, Jae-yoon and the squad successfully reach the 35th floor through the ducts, but they must find another way down to the first floor.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yoon escapes the A Tower first and saves others with a brilliant idea. But they must endure another goodbye. In the meantime, Young-joo runs into people who are even more brutal than zombies. Will Jae-yoon and Young-joo, the two lovers fighting their own separate battle, finally reunite in this chaotic apocalypse?

title: My Dearest Nemesis
overview: As a high school senior, Su-Jeong began playing an online game where she met another player nicknamed "Black Dragon". They unexpectedly got close, developing crushes and planning a meeting in real life… that concluded in humiliation and disaster when "Black Dragon" turned out to be an awkward middle schooler instead of the young man he portrayed himself to be! Sixteen years later, Su-Jeong is a skilled planner at Yongseong Department Store, but her job is about to get a shakeup with the arrival of Ban Ju-Yeon, the ambitious new head of strategic planning and heir to the company. There's just one problem: Ban Ju-Yeon is actually "Black Dragon", and Su-Jeong still holds a grudge. Will their past come back to haunt them, or can they find a way to resolve their misunderstandings – and even find love as adults?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: 19-year-old Sujeong had a busy life filling the gap of her late mother. She met her first love 'Black Dragon.' However, her romantic ended up becoming the most embarrassing moment in her life.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Sujeong tries to make up for her relationship with Juyeon, but to Juyeon who has a secret life, Sujeong is just an eyesore. The tables are turned when Juyeon's secret life is busted by Sujeong.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: With Juyeon in the lead, Yongsung Department Store is having a large-scale renewal project. Juyeon and Sujeong become closer as they work together. Then Juyeon becomes highly disappointed in Sujeong.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Sujeong receives help from Juyeon unexpectedly. She can't stop laughing at the new side of Juyeon. Meanwhile, Shinwon ends up doing something for the first time in his life for Hajin.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Hajin sees Sujeong and Juyeon together. She must set them apart before they recognize each other. Hajin even draws Shinwon to set them apart!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Why on earth did he kiss me? Sujeong is confused about what happened last night. She expects Juyeon to ask her out or explain why he did it, but Juyeon keeps quiet.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Juyeon doesn't hide his feelings for Sujeong. However, Sujeong rejects him due to the 'younger man' trauma. Then Juyeon is about to get caught by Hyoseon.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Sujeong and Juyeon finally confirm each other's hearts. Their risky secret relationship begins. They must hide it from everyone, yet they're still happy to be together... But what is this ominous feeling?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: 'Strawberry' and 'Black Dragon' met again. Due to the broken heart in the past, the conflict between Sujeong and Juyeon deepens. To make things worse, their scandal breaks out.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Juyeon gets fired. He's abandoned by Hyoseon in the end and left alone. Sujeong hides the crisis from Juyeon and struggles to make an effort. Meanwhile, Hajin's ex visits Sulo.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Joo-yeon negotiates with Hyo-sun. Soo-jeong and Joo-yeon, who returned to the strategic planning headquarters, work hard to make the renewal project a success. However, all their efforts are met with difficulties that will go down the drain, and Joo-yeon decides to do something.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Soo-jeong, who lived alone, shouldering everything in order to be recognized and not be ignored. Joo-yeon, who wanted to be loved by her grandmother even while hiding herself. Can the two of them release their respective seals and be together?

title: Friendly Rivalry
overview: Woo Seul-Ki grew up in an orphanage out in a province. She moves to Seoul and enrolls in Chaehwa High School, which is a school for the top 1% students in South Korea. Woo Seul-Ki doesn't get along with the other students. A student named Yoo Je-Yi approaches her and they become friends. Yoo Je-Yi is the most powerful student in the school. She has a high IQ, comes from a wealthy family background, and is attractive physically. She has lived as the envy of other people since she was born and she is aware of her superiority. She is also cunning enough to know how to take advantage of her position. She shows special interest in transfer student Woo Seul-Ki. They soon develop a dangerous relationship between friendship and obsession.
broadcast: U+ Mobile TV · Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday · 00:00

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi, who went missing as a child and grew up in an orphanage, transfers to Chaehwa Girls' High School in Seoul to find her father. Then, Jae-yi, the top student in the school and the object of everyone's admiration, approaches Seul-gi...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: A past exam question from a prestigious academy submitted by someone is the same as the math grade test taken. Seul-gi heads to the prestigious academy as if possessed. She meets Jae-yi there. Can she trust Jae-yi?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yi gives Seul-gi a new school uniform as a gift. Seul-gi, who had been wary of Jae-yi, finds out about Jae-yi's unexpected side and her heart is unlocked. She decides to go back to sitting next to Jae-yi.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After the class president election, Seul-gi, who has become close to Jae-yi ends up sleeping at Jae-yi's house. Seul-gi wakes up to the sound of Jae-yi's phone constantly ringing, and when she finally opens it, she is shocked!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: A copy of Seul-gi's essay, the only one to receive an A+, is found in a drawer of a classmate's desk, and Jae-yi gets upset and tells her not to let anyone read it, but for some reason Seul-gi doesn't seem to care.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi is disappointed that Jae-yi approached her for another reason. Before she knows it, the midterm exam is approaching, and Seul-gi, who has run out of medicine, obtains it illegally because she cannot get it prescribed at the hospital.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi, who became the top student in the entire school along with Jae-yi, is suddenly threatened by Byeong-jin and is worried that drugs will be detected during the health checkup. Seul-gi approaches Jae-yi, who calls her up to the rooftop.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: The school is in the middle of a festival, and Seul-gi is trying to trust Jae-yi again. For some reason, Jae-yi looks for Do-hyuk's phone, and there is a shocking video on the phone she gets her hands on.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yi, who learned the whole story of the incident, encounters an unexpected person in the printing room. Meanwhile, Seul-gi, who was stabbed, is taken to the hospital by Tae-jun, where she witnesses Tae-jun's eerie secret.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: The school is investigated by the police due to the festival incident, and the victim, Seul-gi, is accused of being the perpetrator. When Seul-gi is put in danger because of Ara, who is cornered, Jae-yi makes a choice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi and Jae-yi search for the missing Je-na. Jae-yi finds out that Je-na had a conversation with Kyung-yi on the festival day and questions Kyung-yi. Then, he gets a call from Kyung-yi, who says he knows Je-na's whereabouts and offers a deal!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yi hears that Je-na had the fake ID card that Byeong-jin was looking for. Then, Jae-yi gets a phone call. Je-na is dead?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi, who had been suspicious of Je-na's death, finds out the whole story of the case while looking for Soo-jin and begins to cooperate with Jae-yi. Kyung-yi and Ye-ri each approach the case in their own ways.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi and Jae-yi try to find Je-na and make her a witness in court. However, when Tae-jun threatens Seul-gi's life, Jae-yi promises to become the daughter her father wants. Has Jae-yi really abandoned Seul-gi?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 15
episodeGuide.summary: During the final exam, the rankings of the entire school change drastically, and Seul-gi is frustrated because she cannot figure out Jae-yi's intentions. As Jae-yi said to use Seul-gi, Tae-jun makes a deal with Seul-gi by offering her a killer college entrance exam question.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 16
episodeGuide.summary: Seul-gi and Jae-yi, who have different plans, clash, and Jae-yi ends up betraying Seul-gi and going ahead with her own plan. What was Jae-yi hoping for?

title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
overview: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs --- proving love endures across time.

episodeGuide.title: Spring in a Heartbeat
episodeGuide.summary: Raised by a tenacious mother, a young, bright-eyed Ae Sun has dreams bigger than her village — until an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

episodeGuide.title: Sassy First Love
episodeGuide.summary: As love blossoms between Ae-sun and Gwan-sik, they make their first bold move together. But their romantic adventure hits a snag.

episodeGuide.title: Yesterday Was Your Spring
episodeGuide.summary: After a dramatic rescue, Ae-sun and Gwan-sik return to Jeju. Soon, Ae-sun resigns herself to a sad fate — leaving Gwan-sik devastated.

episodeGuide.title: The Blazing Summer Sunshine
episodeGuide.summary: Summer brings joy as the newlyweds start a life together, but living with Gwan-sik's family tests their happiness — can they find a path to peace?

episodeGuide.title: A Midsummer Night's Full Nets
episodeGuide.summary: As Gwan-sik struggles to find work, Ae-sun worries for her family — until a lifeline appears. Soon after, Ae-sun sets her ambitions higher in Jeju.

episodeGuide.title: Life Goes On and On
episodeGuide.summary: Just as Ae-sun and Gwan-sik taste the joys of their new life, a summer storm changes everything — testing their will to carry on.

episodeGuide.title: A Fruitful Fall
episodeGuide.summary: As the village chief election approaches, Ae-sun faces corrupt opposition. Geum-myeong receives an unusual request that tests her morals.

episodeGuide.title: The Moon Wanes, Yet the Young Heart Remains
episodeGuide.summary: When Geum-myeong receives a chance to study in Japan, dreams take flight. Now Ae-sun and Gwan-sik must make a tough decision.

episodeGuide.title: The Wind Goes Whoosh, My Heart Goes Boo-Hoo
episodeGuide.summary: Life in a small apartment tests Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as they struggle to parent Yang Eun-myeong. Meanwhile, Geum-myeong juggles love and life in Seoul.

episodeGuide.title: The Storm Sweeps My Heart, the Love Rocks My Heart
episodeGuide.summary: While Geum-myeong grows closer to her quirky colleague, Ae-sun's troubling dreams stir real concerns. Do they hold any meaning?

episodeGuide.title: My Love by My Side
episodeGuide.summary: As Geum-myeong's engagement moves toward marriage, her heart fills with doubt — will her first love story find its happy ending like her mother's?

episodeGuide.title: A Glistening Winter
episodeGuide.summary: Back in Jeju, Geum-myeong mends her heart in familiar surroundings. Ae-sun treasures sweet moments with her loved ones.

episodeGuide.title: Such an Uneven Love
episodeGuide.summary: While facing a career setback during an economic downturn, Geum-myeong encounters a familiar face — sparking an unexpected new beginning.

episodeGuide.title: Spread Your Wings and Fly
episodeGuide.summary: Ae-sun and Gwan-sik grapple with Yang Eun-myeong's misfortune, sacrificing everything they can to help him. But Eun-myeong's self-confidence takes a hit.

episodeGuide.title: A Spring Every Day
episodeGuide.summary: Between new business ventures and career changes, the family faces separate hurdles on their paths — drawing strength from their bond to press ahead.

episodeGuide.title: Here’s to All You’ve Been Through
episodeGuide.summary: As the Yang family finally enjoys the fruits of their labor, sudden agony strikes — testing their resolve and the strength of their enduring love.

title: The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call
overview: To create a top-tier trauma center, a war-seasoned doctor arrives bringing his blunt but skilled ways to transform his team into life-saving mavericks.

episodeGuide.title: Enter Doctor Maniac
episodeGuide.summary: Baek Kang-hyuk arrives at Hankuk National University Hospital to vitalize the trauma unit — diving headfirst into a stabbing and a hiking accident.

episodeGuide.title: The Birth of Protégé No.1
episodeGuide.summary: During a high-risk helicopter rescue, Kang-hyuk and Yang Jae-won attempt surgery mid-air. But, as the two grow fonder, Kang-hyuk clashes with Han Yu-rim.

episodeGuide.title: Keep On Running
episodeGuide.summary: A multi-car wreck brings critical patients, forcing Kang-hyuk and Jae-won to handle sensitive organ transplants — all while they face internal pushback.

episodeGuide.title: Closer Than You Think
episodeGuide.summary: Amid a contentious budget meeting, Kang-hyuk rushes to save a trauma patient close to Jae-won and Yu-rim. He soon hears a dark rumor about his past.

episodeGuide.title: Code Black
episodeGuide.summary: While facing media ridicule, Kang-hyuk confronts a bridge disaster — forcing all hands on deck and leading to Jae-won's first solo emergency surgery.

episodeGuide.title: Reasons for Not Giving Up
episodeGuide.summary: Even as hospital politics intensify, Kang-hyuk's focus on patients stands firm. Meanwhile, Cheon Jang-mi tries to cheer up a despondent Jae-won.

episodeGuide.title: SOS from South Sudan
episodeGuide.summary: Facing a malpractice investigation, Kang-hyuk's crisis doubles: save a critical patient and defend his reputation. After, he embarks for a case abroad.

episodeGuide.title: Patient: Baek Kang-hyuk
episodeGuide.summary: Amid flying bullets, Kang-hyuk leads his team to save a military captain. Upon his return, he suddenly finds his life in the hands of his protégés.

title: Trigger
overview: An action thriller drama that depicts what happens when guns of unknown origin are unleashed in South Korea, a gun-free country, and guns are given to angry people one by one.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: When a shocking mass shooting shatters Korea's calm, Lee Do races to stop the violence — then realizes the threat of illegal guns is just beginning.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: As shootings spread, Lee Do discovers guns in the hands of everyday citizens. When a victim hits close to home, his investigation grows more urgent.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: A police raid uncovers a cache of military weapons. Lee Do and his new ally Moon Baek close in on the arms network as the city reels from bloodshed.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Lee Do confronts a violent standoff and must decide how far to go to stop the killings, while suspicions about Moon Baek threaten their fragile alliance.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Guns reach bullied students and grieving parents, sparking new tragedies. Lee Do uncovers a network delivering weapons to vulnerable people across Korea.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: A gun in the hands of a student spells crisis at school. As panic spreads, Lee Do and Moon Baek race rush to restore order — but it may be too late.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: As fear and confusion grow, police and gangs rush to recover illegal guns. Lee Do feels powerless as the true scale of the arms crisis comes to light.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Police raid the gun syndicate, and rival gangs and old enemies clash in bloody battles. Lee Do is pushed to the limits as violence hits all of Korea.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: When Moon Baek's message echoes through the media, guns reach new hands and fear takes hold. Across Korea, people must choose how to respond.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: With emotions running high, Lee Do and Moon Baek move toward a crossroads. One final choice will shape Korea's future — or plunge it into darkness.

title: Dear X
overview: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

episodeGuide.title: Her "Xs"
episodeGuide.summary: When Sung-hee attempts to expose Ah-jin's secrets, she strikes back with the help of fellow classmates.

episodeGuide.title: The Moment a Human Becomes a Devil
episodeGuide.summary: Ah-jin is accepted into her dream law school, but her dreams are crushed when her father returns.

episodeGuide.title: Breaking the Shackles
episodeGuide.summary: With her dream shattered, Ah-jin begins to work at a cafe and secretly schemes to manipulate Jung-ho.

episodeGuide.title: No Turning Back
episodeGuide.summary: As suspicions fall on Ah-jin with nowhere to turn, she is approached by Mi-ri, who steps in to save her.

episodeGuide.title: Grant me The Power to Rise to the Top
episodeGuide.summary: Ah-jin makes her debut as an actress and grows increasingly wary of Lena.

episodeGuide.title: Setting the Trap
episodeGuide.summary: Determined to advance her career, Ah-jin sets her sights on top star, Heo In-gang.

episodeGuide.title: The Wheel of Fate
episodeGuide.summary: Ah-jin's year-long romance with In-gang deepens, but her past is at risk of being exposed.

episodeGuide.title: Before Judgment
episodeGuide.summary: After his grandmother's passing, In-gang proposes, but Ah-jin ends their relationship instead.

episodeGuide.title: New Heights
episodeGuide.summary: As Ah-jin faces public backlash for her break up with In-gang, a wealthy savior comes to her rescue.

episodeGuide.title: The Monster in the Mirror
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-seo learns the secret of his birth and leaves Ah-jin's side while she marries Do-hyuk.

episodeGuide.title: Save Me, My God
episodeGuide.summary: Ah-jin discovers the unnerving truth about her husband. Desperate to break free, she turns to Jae-oh.

episodeGuide.title: The Final X
episodeGuide.summary: Ah-jin's deepest darkest secrets are revealed just as she rises to the very top.

title: Good Boy
overview: A comical action youth investigative drama in which medalists who became police officers as special recruits from the Olympics wear police ID cards around their necks instead of medals and fight against a world rife with unscrupulousness and foul play.

episodeGuide.title: Our Twisted Hero
episodeGuide.summary: After causing trouble, Dong-ju is demoted to the Insung Metropolitan Police Agency, where he's treated like dead weight and his fellow world-class medalists also face discrimination and scorn. But when a major case erupts, it reignites the fire in their hearts.

episodeGuide.title: Faster Further Stronger
episodeGuide.summary: At Man-sik's suggestion, a special criminal investigation team is formed with the former world-class medalists. Ready for a fresh start, each member joins with their own hopes and goals, but behind the creation of this special team lurks a hidden agenda.

episodeGuide.title: Million Dollar Baby
episodeGuide.summary: Convinced that Ju-yeong is the hit-and-run driver, Dong-ju scrambles to find evidence. Meanwhile, Jong-hyeon heads to the Prosecutors' Office at Man-sik's request to investigate Gyeong-il's case, and Ju-yeong meets someone in the shadows.

episodeGuide.title: Float Like a Butterfly
episodeGuide.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is now complete with Han-na's return and Jong-hyeon joining. They launch a full-scale investigation into Gyeong-il's death and Min Ju-yeong. As they split into teams and close in on their targets, Han-na receives her father's case files.

episodeGuide.title: Punch-Drunk Love
episodeGuide.summary: While investigating Ju-yeong, the Special Criminal Investigation Team is forced to hand him over to the prosecution after their sudden intervention. Dong-ju is hospitalized for tests following his car accident, and the team digs deeper into Ju-yeong's true identity and his connections to the prosecution.

episodeGuide.title: Counterpunch
episodeGuide.summary: Using Han-na's surprise kiss as an excuse, Dong-ju heads out alone with her on an investigation and discovers Ju-yeong's burner phone. Jong-hyeon finds himself growing uneasy as Dong-ju and Han-na get closer. Meanwhile, Drugmon, under surveillance in an apartment, begins plotting her escape.

episodeGuide.title: Par terre Par terre
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-ju's assault puts the Special Criminal Investigation Team in a major crisis. Man-sik fights to keep the team together, while the others continue investigating Ju-yeong, weighed down by uncertainty. Meanwhile, Ju-yeong leaves the hospital and heads to an unknown destination.

episodeGuide.title: The Aimless Bullet
episodeGuide.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team catches wind of Ju-yeong's drug smuggling and infiltrates the customs office disguised as a quarantine unit. Following a lead left by Drugmon, they manage to find the container hiding the drugs but walk straight into a trap set by Ju-yeong.

episodeGuide.title: Allez
episodeGuide.summary: Han-na is kidnapped, and Dong-ju and Jong-hyeon rush to rescue her, only to find themselves trapped in a deadly crisis. Just when it seems there's no way out, an unexpected gunshot rings out. With an unforeseen sacrifice shaking the team, will they survive?

episodeGuide.title: Time-out
episodeGuide.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is disbanded in the end. Dong-ju quietly prepares revenge against Ju-yeong alone, but his reckless move only invites a greater crisis. Catching on to his plan, Ju-yeong launches a counterstrike.

episodeGuide.title: Countdown
episodeGuide.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team reunites and uncovers Ju-yeong's huge secret. Growing anxious over the provocative countdown sent by Dong-ju, Ju-yeong makes desperate moves. Who will have the last laugh?

episodeGuide.title: Foul
episodeGuide.summary: Falling into Ju-yeong's trap, Dong-ju suffers a critical injury and faces his greatest crisis yet. Will he push through or fall where he stands?

episodeGuide.title: Load, Start... Don't Stop
episodeGuide.summary: With no way left to retreat, Dong-ju and the team launch their final all-out attack on Ju-yeong. Charging forward without hesitation, they soon face fierce counterattacks and unexpected obstacles. What will be their fate?

episodeGuide.title: Kings Never Die
episodeGuide.summary: Facing their final showdown with Ju-yeong, Dong-ju and the team fight desperately to win. In this fateful battle between two men who refuse to give up, who will be the true champion left standing in the ring?

episodeGuide.title: On the Ropes
episodeGuide.summary: The entire Insung Police Force comes together to launch a full-scale operation against Ju-yeong's cartel. But just as victory draws near, Ju-yeong's most devastating counterattack plunges the city into utter chaos.

episodeGuide.title: We Are The Champions
episodeGuide.summary: Amidst the chaos, Dong-ju and the team begin their final battle to determine Insung City's fate. With the weight of everyone's hopes and expectations on their backs, can they seize final victory and return as true heroes?

title: The Manipulated

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Taejoong is suddenly arrested for a crime he claims he didn't commit.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Taejoong uncovers a shocking truth in prison.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Taejoong uncovers something and hatches a new plan.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Despite unforeseen obstacles, Taejoong pushes forward with his plan.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Yohan's true nature is revealed, and a twisted new game begins.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Trapped in Yohan's twisted game, players fight to survive.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Taejoong hunts for the mastermind, while a corrections officer searches for him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Taejoong goes after the culprit but finds himself in a seemingly inescapable situation. Will he be able to break free and expose those responsible?

title: Nine Puzzles
overview: After discovering the body of her murdered uncle, Yoon Ena becomes a profiler to uncover the truth behind what happened that night. A decade later, Detective Hansaem still suspects Ena was responsible, and when a series of murders begins to occur, each linked to a corresponding puzzle piece, Hansaem will follow his instincts to track down the killer.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Detective Hansaem suspects Ena after she fails to remember anything about her uncle's murder.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: A puzzle piece arrives on the same day as a murder, and Hansaem suspects it's no coincidence.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Ena and Hansaem warily work together to solve the case.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: A prime suspect emerges, but things aren't what they seem.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Another puzzle piece arrives, and a new murder case unfolds.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: The meaning behind the drawings on the puzzle pieces is uncovered.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Han Saem makes a shocking discovery and becomes unsure of whom to trust.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: As the investigation escalates, new suspects begin to emerge.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: In an unexpected twist, a new suspect is arrested shortly before another victim is discovered. E-na and Han-saem risk it all to try and catch the true killer.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: A stunning truth behind the serial murders is revealed.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: The final puzzle piece arrives. Will the team be able to catch the killer in time?

title: Genie, Make a Wish
overview: A woman becomes the master of a genie who keeps tempting her to make a wish — sparking a risky, magical connection.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: After a lifetime of abandonment, Ki Ka-young confronts her mother in Dubai. During her trip, she releases Iblis, indifferent to any wish he might grant.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Back at Ka-young's home, Iblis learns about her past from the locals — and navigates modern Korean society while trying to threaten a wish from her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Iblis agrees to grant Ka-young's first wish — to corrupt others — although she remains an enigma. Meanwhile, Ejllael plots his revenge against Iblis.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After sharing her first kiss with Iblis, Ka-young searches for any excuse to kiss him again. Ejllael struggles to sway Ka-young to his long-held plan.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Ka-young makes her second wish — this time for her grandmother. Meanwhile, Iblis continues corrupting others in a bid to win his bet with Ka-young.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Iblis seeks Ejllael to probe his missing years with Ka‑young. Meanwhile, Ka‑young faces memories of her past life — and a fateful wish.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Despite learning of her past, Ka-young suspects there's more to her story with Iblis. Ejllael and Iblis discover a secret force lurking in the shadows.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Iblis and Ka-young travel to Dubai for answers about their unaccounted past. Soon, Ka-young begins to feel an unexpected bond with him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Ejllael uses Oh Pan-geum as bait to bring down Iblis. As Khalid's threat grows, Iblis and Ka-young uncover a major clue about their past connection.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: With Khalid's next move imminent, Iblis and Ka-young dig into their blurry past. Meanwhile, Pan-geum prepares for her fate, stoking suspicion around her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: A millennia ago, Ka-young's past self survives certain death — reconnecting with Iblis and falling in love, until greed tragically tears them apart.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As Khalid's endgame nears, Ka-young, Iblis and their loved ones face grave danger — but their hidden plan can seal a destiny forged over a thousand years.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: With her life turned upside down, Ka-young searches for Iblis to make her final wish. Will they find eternal happiness, or be bound by cruel fate?

title: Karma
overview: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections. A hit-and-run. A cover-up. A debt-fueled murder plot. Karma weaves together the fates of six characters, each bound by a single, irreversible moment. The Witness observed a mysterious accident in the dead of night, setting the Unspoken Fate in motion. The Surgeon, haunted by a lifelong trauma, and confronted by the painful past she vowed never to face again. The Debtor & the Outsider, jobless and trapped, plunge headlong into the fate of dark deals. The Doctor & the Alluring Girlfriend, as one fateful mistake on a dark night spirals uncontrollably into a catastrophic accident. Six lives, one inescapable fate.

episodeGuide.title: The Man With Loan Shark Debts
episodeGuide.summary: As the debtor faces imminent danger from his loan shark, he enlists Jang Gil Ryong for a diabolical task — one that comes at a high and personal cost.

episodeGuide.title: The Man Who Disposed of a Body
episodeGuide.summary: Distracted by Lee Yoo Jung, Glasses gets into a car accident. When he discovers a witness, he panics and tries to erase any trace of his involvement.

episodeGuide.title: The Unrighteous
episodeGuide.summary: After the witness demands more money, Glasses uncovers inconsistencies in the recent accident. The Debtor panics as Gil Ryong demands his due.

episodeGuide.title: The Woman Trapped in the Past
episodeGuide.summary: Caught in the shadows of her past, Lee Joo Yun is stirred by a name that echoes old memories, pushing her to confront lingering questions.

episodeGuide.title: Rewind
episodeGuide.summary: Prepared with a plan, the Debtor confronts Gil Ryong — but the plot soon devolves into chaos when the Witness sees an opportunity to exploit.

episodeGuide.title: Karma
episodeGuide.summary: The Witness faces unexpected setbacks after thinking he's in the clear. But with Joo Yun on his trail, can he break free from the relentless karmic cycle?

title: Study Group
overview: It follows the life of student Yoon Ga Min, who wants to be good at studying but is only good at fighting, as he forms a study group at the worst school on earth and tells a fierce story about college entrance exams. Yoon Ga Min, who looks like a model student but is a student of Yusung Technical High School, which is one of the worst schools to study at. Although he studies extremely hard, his grades don't rise in the slightest. Despite all that, Yoon Ga Min sits diligently at his desk with the goal of going to college. However, when his study group friends get bullied, Yoon Ga Min takes off his glasses and school uniform jacket to put his fighting skills to use. Lee Han Kyeong, Yoon Ga Min's teacher, dreams of seeing the school change for the better. Lee Han Kyeong tutored Yoon Ga Min during her university days and reunites with him when she is appointed as a temporary teacher, holding a secret.

title: The Murky Stream
overview: A gripping tale of twisted fates unfolds in lawless Joseon, where the once-pristine Gyeonggang River has turned into a murky stream. Jang Si Yul, a man who buries his past to survive as a gangster, Choi Eun, a sharp-minded and righteous soul, and Jung Chun, an idealist striving to become an honest official, find their destinies entangled in a world where justice is scarce, and survival comes at a cost.

episodeGuide.title: ONE. ROGUES
episodeGuide.summary: A sharp-eyed worker named Siyul catches the eye of Mudeok, a low-ranking Mapo bandit.

episodeGuide.title: TWO. THE WIND THAT STIRS IN MAPO
episodeGuide.summary: Siyul reaches breaking point. Eun finally starts a new job, and Chun becomes an officer.

episodeGuide.title: THREE. A STRONG NEW MAN
episodeGuide.summary: Mudeok blackmails Siyul while Chun and Eun rage against a corrupt world.

episodeGuide.title: SEVEN. SWORD, SPEAR, HAMMER, AND SICKLE
EIGHT. TO LIVE OR TO DIE

title: Confidence Man
overview: A comedy-drama that depicts three crooks extorting large sums of money from people who are stained with desire with grand and unusual plans on the stage of the colorful world of real estate and finance.

episodeGuide.title: Speed Dial 0
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-rang, James, and Gu-ho take down another villain. Out of nowhere, Gu-ho announces he's leaving the con game and walking away from the team.

episodeGuide.title: Sand Foundation
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-rang and Gu-ho head to the Philippines to avenge James, who's in a coma. Tae-su blocks land and sea. Their only chance now is an aerial attack!

episodeGuide.title: Déjà Vu
episodeGuide.summary: Gu-ho discovers a hidden side of Mr. Famous, the hottest name in art criticism. But strangely, Yi-rang seems reluctant to join the con.

episodeGuide.title: Ghost Castle
episodeGuide.summary: A painting finally sees the light of day, stirring up chaos at an auction. Meanwhile, Yi-rang slips away alone, chasing traces of a buried memory.

episodeGuide.title: Atmos Black Noir
episodeGuide.summary: After a nightmare, Gu-ho meets an unexpected figure. Meanwhile, Chairwoman Lee hears of Dr. Rachel, a VVIP concierge doctor, and tails James.

episodeGuide.title: Waves on the Edge
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-woo learns Yi-rang's secret, prompting her to make a shocking announcement. Gwang-sik's return gives Chairwoman Lee one last chance.

episodeGuide.title: Mask Girl
episodeGuide.summary: A familiar woman appears before a disgraced James. Meanwhile, the trio enlists a popular influencer to help punish Gil Beauty, the queen of lawsuits.

episodeGuide.title: Mr. Gray
episodeGuide.summary: The sad tale of Un-nyun and Big Noggin is revealed. Something clicks for Gil Beauty, leading her to a village where locals share one thing in common.

episodeGuide.title: Their First Encounter
episodeGuide.summary: Ha Jung-ho is a corrupt seafood tycoon and cinephile. When he doesn't easily invest, Yi-rang comes up with a new plan—surely not a honey trap?

episodeGuide.title: Madame Oh's Heydays
episodeGuide.summary: Jung-ho agrees to invest on one condition—a full script overhaul. He wants to write, produce, direct, and act. Yi-rang's motive is finally revealed.

episodeGuide.title: The Falling Out
episodeGuide.summary: The trio drifts apart, and each carries on with their own life. Yi-rang misses James and Gu-ho, but still plots to reach Kang Yo-seop alone.

episodeGuide.title: Checkmate
episodeGuide.summary: The trio lures Yo-seop to the final feast. But Gu-ho is shot, and Yi-rang and James are captured. Who will the goddess of victory smile upon?

title: Tempest
overview: A former diplomat uncovers a conspiracy that threatens the stability of the Korean Peninsula.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Munju returns to support a candidate's presidential run. At a mass they attend, a gunshot rings out.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: A mysterious shadow looms over the shooting. Munju enters the presidential race to find the truth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: A crisis strikes Munju on her way to declare her candidacy. Sanho races in once again to save her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: A discovery is made that threatens national security.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Munju exposes the plot to start a war and spends what could be her last night with Sanho.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Munju receives some intelligence that changes everything.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Standing at the edge of truth, Munju and Sanho face a choice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: The shadow of war returns. Munju and Sanho step into the eye of the storm.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Their final strike begins. With the truth in hand, can Munju stop everything before it's too late?

title: Aema
overview: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative ''Madame Aema''.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Disgusted by the steamy "Madame Aema" script, Jeong Hee-ran refuses the lead role. Her vengeful producer retaliates by casting a rookie instead.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Even before filming starts, the crew faces challenges — tensions grow between Hee-ran and Shin Ju-ae, and strict censorship forces script changes.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Ju-ae battles a demanding film set and doubts her acting, but proves her grit. Later, she steps into a mansion that gives her an ominous feeling.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Shocked by a glimpse of the industry's dark side, Ju-ae faces a career-defining choice. Will she play it safe — or take Hee-ran's bold advice to fight?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: In the middle of the night, Hee-ran finds Ku Jung-ho's secret ledger. Later, the director finds all the film reels have vanished without a trace.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: "Madame Aema" sweeps Korea, bringing Ju-ae fame. At a live award ceremony, Hee-ran steps into the spotlight and gets unexpected help from Ju-ae.

title: Moon River
overview: Joseon Crown Prince Lee Gang is known by many as an unserious, pleasure-seeking man, but he uses this facade to mask his deep pain from losing his beloved wife. While his mother tries to find him a new spouse, he's dismissive of her attempts, only wishing to pursue revenge. His life takes a turn when he runs into Park Dal I, a merchant with amnesia who bears a startling resemblance to his wife. Although Dal I and Lee Gang's first meeting goes poorly, they soon find themselves as unlikely allies helping those in need. However, the two awaken one morning to the shock of a lifetime: they've swapped bodies. As Lee Gang and Dal I try to figure out how this happened, they uncover political conspiracies and dangerous secrets – and that their connection might run deeper than they think.

episodeGuide.title: The Red Thread of Fate (1)
episodeGuide.summary: Lee Gang, overseeing state affairs on behalf of the ailing king, cannot forget the Crown Princess who died unjustly and spends each day in torment. Left State Councillor Kim Han Chul, driven by boundless ambition, seeks to consolidate his power by marrying his daughter to the Crown Prince. Meanwhile, Dal, a peddler who has lost her memory, heads to Hanyang to save Lord Heo's daughter.

episodeGuide.title: The Red Thread of Fate (2)
episodeGuide.summary: Dal uses her wits to rescue Lord Heo's daughter late at night. However, the household servants block her way. Gang and Prince Je Un arrive just in time, saving Dal and the young mistress. Out of gratitude, Dal promises to treat Gang to a bowl of rice soup. The next day, Dal is falsely accused and suddenly branded a thief; she eventually gets dragged away to face punishment.

episodeGuide.title: Heungbu, Nolbu, and Swallow
episodeGuide.summary: After finding out U Hui is the Left State Councillor's daughter, Grand Prince Je Un decides to let her go. U Hui demands that Gang personally fetch her from Sinjusa Temple, so Gang heads to the temple. On the way, Gang meets Dal, who was also headed to Sinju Temple. Upon Gang's arrival, mysterious assassins storm into Sinjusa.

episodeGuide.title: A Swallow Does Not Just Repay Kindness
episodeGuide.summary: Gang and Dal get attacked by the ruffians that U Hui sent. Fortunately, Shin Won comes to their rescue right on time. Gang must save both the King and Je Un, and he needs to come up with a wise solution. Meanwhile, Dal is rewarded by Gang with silk clothes, which later gets her into trouble.

episodeGuide.title: Walk a Mile in My Shoes
episodeGuide.summary: Dal and Gang wake up having swapped bodies and are both shocked. Gang tries every possible way to get into the palace, and eventually, with the help of the Queen Dowager, enters the Crown Prince's quarters disguised as a eunuch. They attempt to recreate the situation from before their bodies were swapped, but no matter how many times they try, they cannot return to their original state.

episodeGuide.title: One Body and Soul
episodeGuide.summary: U Hui and Je Un witness Dal and Gang sleeping under one blanket. The rumour spreads, so Gang, who is in Dal's body, leaves the palace and stays in hiding for the time being. However, Gang is captured and is about to be punished. Right then, the Queen Dowager comes to the rescue. Meanwhile, the Left State Councillor finds out that Lord Heo helped Dal.

episodeGuide.title: Hide and Seek
episodeGuide.summary: After being attacked by the Chief Court Lady, Gang believes it'd be best to avoid being with Dal to protect her. Gang keeps avoiding and hiding from Dal, which makes her frustrated. Gang figures out that the Left State Councillor still has the Jimjo Bird, so he decides to find a way into the Left State Councillor's estate. Meanwhile, Dal gets falsely accused by the Left State Councillor, and she is left to be flogged.

episodeGuide.title: Silence Is Golden
episodeGuide.summary: After the flogging incident, Gang takes Dal in as his concubine. Gang finds evidence that the Left State Councillor used the Chief Court Lady to take care of the Jimjo. Gang sets off to find the Jimjo himself, but the Jimjo behaves in an unforeseen manner, attacking everyone at the palace, including Dal.

episodeGuide.title: There Are No Secrets
episodeGuide.summary: Gang and Dal figure out that their bodies swap when their blood and water meet. Gang and Je Un find the connection between the Choraengi Mask and the former Chief Court Lady, and they search for the body in the cave where the Choraengi Mask disappeared into. Meanwhile, Dal gets accused of bringing Jimjo to the palace and gets interrogated.

episodeGuide.title: The Calm Before the Storm
episodeGuide.summary: Gang is shocked to find out that the King himself released the Left State Councillor from the Royal Investigation Office. He learns of the secret pact his father made after the Gyesa Year incident. Gang is left with no choice but to carry on with the Royal Wedding. Meanwhile, a fragment of Dal's memory returns.

episodeGuide.title: There Is No Paradise in Running Away
episodeGuide.summary: Even after some of Dal's memory returns, she decides to return to the palace and stick by Gang's side instead of running away. After losing U Hui, Je Un begins acting strangely, looking like he's determined to get rid of the Left State Councillor. While trying to find the Left State Councillor's private army, Gang finds out who Dal really is.

episodeGuide.title: The Woman in White
episodeGuide.summary: The Left State Councillor apprehends Dal's parents and Hong Nan to have them executed. He demands Dal to expose her true identity to save them, and Dal reveals that she is the Deposed Crown Princess. She is imprisoned, but with U Hui's help, she escapes and heads to Mount Gamak to find proof to bring down the Left State Councillor.

episodeGuide.title: A Sword’s Purpose
episodeGuide.summary: Prince Je Un finds the hidden message in the military treatise that shares the location of the Left State Councillor's private army base. Je Un unites with Gang in Dal's body, and they meet Deok Chun, who tells them about the lady who holds the secret pact. Meanwhile, Dal secretly meets U Hui and shares her plan on the day of the Royal Wedding.

episodeGuide.title: A Fleeting Memory
episodeGuide.summary: The Left State Councilor takes Dal hostage and storms into the palace with his private army. He threatens Gang to bring Queen Jangjeong. Gang has no time to hesitate as Dal is in danger. After the Left State Councilor's crimes are revealed, U Hui gets imprisoned, and when Un comes to rescue, she refuses to leave.

title: The Divorce Insurance
overview: A drama that contains the explicit process of putting a value on divorce, such as developing a new divorce insurance product by an insurance company's innovative product development team, which is comprised of only the best brains, quantifying all matters related to divorce and determining the appropriate insurance amount.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: For genius actuary Ki-jun, divorce was the worst disaster of his life. Determined to turn it into an insurance product, he forms a team with his recently divorced neighbor, Han-deul, as an underwriter, and his ex-ex-ex-wife, Na-rae, as a quant. Thus, the divorce insurance project officially begins.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: The team is astonished to learn that Na-rae, who joins the task force as a special advisor quant and a senior managing director at Plus General Insurance, is also Ki-jun's ex-ex-ex-wife, though the two seem surprisingly unfazed. As the team pairs up to gather data for the divorce insurance policy, Ki-jun takes Han-deul to an unexpected place seemingly unrelated to their research.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: The team works tirelessly, fully dedicated to developing a divorce insurance policy. After much effort, the team finally secures conditional approval. But to everyone's dismay, Ki-jun leads them to a wedding fair to meet their subscriber target. However, Han-deul suddenly cancels all sign-ups at the fair, abruptly halting the plan for reasons unknown.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: When Han-deul bumps into Ki-jun, weary from a run-in with his former brother-in-law, they begin to understand each other's demons of the past. Meanwhile, Na-rae and Jeon-man click and spark a mutual attraction, and Ah-young meets dancer and farmer Woong-sik on a blind date. However, as the task force gains momentum, they face a new challenge — rising divorce rates among their clientele.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Ki-jun and Han-deul rush to resolve a complaint that their divorce insurance subscription event violates industry regulations. Meanwhile, a policyholder couple's decision to get a divorce breaches both industry regulations and company conditions. The task force scrambles to locate the couple, only to discover that the husband, who holds the key to saving the divorce insurance, is missing.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Ki-jun and Han-deul get lost searching for Hyeon-jae when a looming shadow sparks fear — could the rumored tiger be real? They find Hyeon-jae just in time and escape. Upon reuniting with the team, they notice Mi-rae has come for Hyeon-jae but keeps her distance. With village head Woong-sik's help, they find lodging and work to mend the couple's rift while reflecting on their past and future.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: "Would you like to live at my place?" In an effort to make Han-deul feel more comfortable, Ki-jun suggests they swap homes. Thanks to his thoughtful gesture, she gradually regains her self-esteem. However, when an elderly couple files for divorce, the divorce insurance faces a new challenge, sparking a heated debate within the team over the implications of late-life divorce.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Ki-jun and Han-deul have no choice but to explain their situation when Na-rae and Jeon-man catch them living in each other's homes. Meanwhile, evidence of Young-kyu's affair comes to light, voiding his divorce insurance subscription. This development helps the project avoid another crisis. However, for some reason, Han-deul suddenly tries to dissuade Seon-hee from proceeding with her divorce.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: A leak of confidential company information about the divorce insurance leads to the shocking announcement of the team's disbandment. The internal audit team suspects Han-deul, prompting Ki-jun and the team to work tirelessly to clear her name. Meanwhile, Jeon-man spots Na-rae in a private conversation with the vice president, leaving him conflicted. Will Han-deul succeed in proving her innocence?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Financial Supervisory Service Manager Kim visits the task force to announce his decision to get a divorce. When Han-deul insists the couple should split, Ki-jun struggles to hide his disappointment as her stance feels like a resignation from the project. Just then, Kim's wife, Yeo-reum, declares she will never agree to the divorce, leading to a dramatic turn of events.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Ki-jun and Han-deul finally confirm their feelings for each other, deepening their love as she teaches him to weave with her favorite red yarn. Meanwhile, Ah-young slowly opens up to Woong-sik, and Jeon-man finds happiness with Na-rae, who decides to leave. As everyone navigates their newfound relationships, Dae-bok's wife marks their wedding anniversary by filing for divorce.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: The long-awaited launch of the divorce insurance leaves the team with mixed emotions. During their farewell getaway, everyone opens up and bares their deepest feelings. Later, Jeon-man decides to follow Na-rae to Singapore. Thanks to the insurance, Dae-bok reconciles with his wife and goes on an Aurora trip. Meanwhile, Ki-jun and Han-deul redefine their relationship, envisioning a happy future.

title: The Price of Confession
overview: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Artist Lee Ki Dae is murdered in his studio. His wife, Ahn Yoon So, is held for questioning amid a media frenzy and relentless police investigation.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Prosecutor Baek pressures Yoon So as she is taken back to the crime scene. While she furiously protests her innocence, another woman admits her guilt.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Mo Eun and Yoon So come face to face. After public outcry over the investigation, Baek gets a warrant for the detention center and orders a polygraph test.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon So is given an ankle monitor — and a curfew. After an attorney volunteers to represent Mo Eun, she sends a threatening letter to her new ally.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon So chases a hooded figure just as Mo Eun is reported missing from prison. Baek starts to suspect that the two women may be one step ahead of him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon So digs up dirt on her target's sinister past and spots a potential clue in the studio. A violent fight breaks out while Mo Eun is left unsupervised.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Both women try to erase evidence which could change the course of the investigation. Meanwhile, Ko Se Hoon is reported missing by his grandfather.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Mo Eun shares evidence that complicates Yoon So's case. As Baek uncovers Se Hoon's fatal crime, a new arrival in the cell stirs up old secrets.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Mo Eun raises eyebrows after a medical emergency. Attorney Jang Jung Goo receives a pivotal phone call, and an escape attempt puts an inmate in danger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: A tense confrontation with Jung Goo, Baek and Mo Eun reveals vital withheld information about the case. A shocking murder confession hits the news.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: A hidden motive — and fingerprint — in Lee Ki Dae's murder case leads to an unlikely source. Mo Eun orchestrates a plan after news of a kidnapping.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As the pieces start falling into place in both murder cases, Baek and Jung Goo receive a chilling video. Mo Eun has a final message for Yoon Soo.

title: Crushology 101
overview: If there were a guide for love, would Bunny not have been a pushover? Although she is crazy over good looks, Bunny believes sincerity is more important when dating. The result? Her first love with terrible looks and an awful personality turns out to be the worst, and she becomes known as a school-wide pushover. With the determination to never fail again, Bunny declares she will no longer act like a doormat and only date alpha males when four outstanding oppas appear before her. Bunny's heart gets no rest amid the endless parade of high-quality flirting, aimed to win her over and become her number one oppa. Is this a guide to stop being a pushover? Or is it a proper dating course for falling in love? Will Bunny the pushover transform into a dating genius?

episodeGuide.title: A Dynamic New Semester
episodeGuide.summary: When it comes to dating, Bunny cares about looks. Having high standards for men, however, good-looking guys have no interest in her. Therefore, she ignores her boyfriend, Bong-soo's looks. Meanwhile, Bong-soo makes a big mistake and humiliates Bunny. Bunny was going to take a leave of absence, but she changed her mind immediately after bumping into a good-looking guy.

episodeGuide.title: A Cruel Fate
episodeGuide.summary: Bunny is determined to pay back her debt of 2,000 dollars. However, she lacks the means to do so and decides to work part-time at an exhibition. There, she meets another handsome guy. Bunny also decides to enter a strength contest to win a brand-new tablet and be freed from her debt and notetaking.

episodeGuide.title: Flirting and Fighting
episodeGuide.summary: A-rang agrees to do the alumni interview as Hee-jin asked him to. Seeing Hee-jin getting closer with A-rang, without knowing, Jae-yeol is concerned about Hee-jin and tells Hee-jin that A-rang isn't a nice guy. Meanwhile, A-rang wants to see Hee-jin in private, and he invites her to his studio.

episodeGuide.title: A Direct Love That Only I Didn't Notice
episodeGuide.summary: After checking the conversation between A-rang and Ji-young, Jae-yeol runs to Hee-jin, worrying that she would be fooled by bad guys again. However, Hee-jin thinks what Jae-yeol does is cross the line and doesn't listen to him. Out of concern, Jae-yeol asks Ji-won for help. Meanwhile, Hee-jin finally gets to see the real side of A-rang.

episodeGuide.title: Racing Heart Alert
episodeGuide.summary: Hee-jin tells Jae-yeol what happened that night, thinking he would be embarrassed about it. However, Jae-yeol doesn't get startled by it, and he confesses his feelings again. Hee-jin is still in doubt, but unexpected events make her think about him again. Meanwhile, Yeo-reum, who is a popular sports announcer, comes to school, and it seems like she and Jae-yeol have a history.

episodeGuide.title: What We Are...
episodeGuide.summary: Hee-jin and her friends find out that Jae-yeol and Yeo-reum were a couple a few years ago. Hee-jin doesn't show it to others, but she's bothered by it. Jae-yeol tells Hee-jin that there's nothing between him and Yeo-reum, and this makes Hee-jin relieved. Watching them, Ji-won gets confused about his feelings toward Hee-jin. Meanwhile, Yeo-reum comes to school to see Jae-yeol again.

episodeGuide.title: Misunderstanding and Understanding
episodeGuide.summary: Multiple misunderstandings build up between Hee-jin, Jae-yeol, and Ji-won, causing Hee-jin to believe that Jae-yeol still has feelings for his ex, Yeo-reum. Meanwhile, the campus bustles as the school festival approaches with the Confession Tree event, planned to be hosted by Yeo-reum.

episodeGuide.title: Feelings Left Unsaid
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yeol and Ji-won's war of nerves escalates after the incident of the Confession Tree. While Jae-yeol is tormented between Hee-jin and Yeo-reum, he finds out about the truth behind his breakup with Yeo-reum. Hee-jin and Ji-won keep running into Jae-yeol and Yeo-reum, and they end up sharing a meal together at the same table.

episodeGuide.title: Heart Fluttering Unlocked
episodeGuide.summary: Just as Hee-jin and Jae-yeol find happiness, disaster strikes Hee-jin's family finances and her crucial art project is jeopardized. Reeling from setbacks and leaning on Ji-won for support, she unknowingly fuels Jae-yeol's suspicions. Their fairytale beginning crashes hard against grim reality.

episodeGuide.title: An Undying Ember
episodeGuide.summary: While Jae-yeol's suspicions grow, Hee-jin applies for a scholarship program in the US. Things become more uncomfortable with the realization that the two must stay apart if she is accepted. On top of that, Ji-won also decides to go to the US to stay with his parents and sister.

episodeGuide.title: An Unexpected Reunion
episodeGuide.summary: Hee-jin comes back to Korea after a year in the US. As she returns to school, she encounters Jae-yeol, her ex. Meanwhile, she also runs into Hyun-o, her first crush from when she was little. As the three coincidentally keep bumping into each other, a whirlwind of emotions ensues.

episodeGuide.title: First Love
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yeol wants to tell Hee-jin how he feels about her, but Hee-jin ends up misunderstanding his true intention. Hyun-o asks out Hee-jin, and it makes her even more confused. Meanwhile, Jae-yeol finds out that he lost the hard drive that has all the work of his commercial footage. Hee-jin ends up helping Jae-yeol find the hard drive, and Jae-yeol finds another chance to confess his feelings.

title: Nice to Not Meet You
overview: A romantic comedy about an actor who plays the roles of detectives and wants to become a master of romcoms, and a former political reporter who has fallen from grace to entertainment journalism.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Once a rising actor, Hyeon-jun lived quietly until a student film made him a star. 7 years later, undercover reporter Jeong-sin drops into his world!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: After a fiery red carpet clash, Jeong-sin is bumped to entertainment and exposes Hyeon-jun. Furious, he boots her from an event and she vows revenge!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: As Hyeon-jun spirals, his mom Ae-suk shows up unannounced. Hwa-yeong spots the star at Jeong-sin's hospital and offers her a scool-for-transfer deal.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin sees a pitch on adult film actors and mentions Ae-suk, who she spotted in Hyeon-jun's hospital room. Her article drops, and chaos erupts!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon-jun visits the stadium for his pitch, hoping Jeong-sin comes. She does and greets Jae-hyeong, sparking unexpected jealousy in Hyeon-jun.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin outs herself as a fan mid rice cooker deal. Hyeon-jun is moved by a stranger's confession. A hospital scoop kicks off their uneasy team-up.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin faces a lawsuit over Yoon Jung-ho's scandal. Hyeon-jun urges her to apologize, but the truth about Yoon reveals her real motive.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin confronts Hyeon-jun about Yoon Jung-ho, but hears a shocking plan. Meanwhile, Jae-hyeong asks her out, and she makes a bold choice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin finally meets "Melomaster," but it's Byeong-gi posing as Hyeon-jun! Meanwhile, Hyeon-jun learns that "Soulishere" was Jeong-sin all along.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin crashes Hyeon-jun's shoot! Byeong-gi scrambles to hide his identity, while Hwa-yeong plots to bring Jeong-sin and Hyeon-jun together.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon-jun, Jeong-sin, Hwa-yeong and Jae-hyeong end up in a sudden four-way meet. Hearing Jeong-sin will attend the press event, Hyeon-jun acts fast.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon-jun finally confesses everything to Jeong-sin. It leaves her confused, until she takes the first step and asks to meet. What awaits them now?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon-jun and Jeong-sin cross paths at King's Back. Meanwhile, tensions rise on set and Hyeon-jun storms off after clashing with Byeong-gi and Se-na.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon-jun desperately reaches out to Jeong-sin after hearing Mr. Hwang's dismissal. Jeong-sin joins Hwang to secure evidence on the Lee Dae-ho case.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 15
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon-jun's press conference statement stirs commotion, while Jeong-sin uncovers evidence of Lee Dae-ho's corruption, edging closer to the truth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 16
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-sin exposes Dae-ho's corruption to the world, but the backlash soon targets both her and Hyeon-jun. Now, they must pay the price of justice.

title: Made in Korea
overview: In 1970s South Korea a man determined to reach the pinnacle of wealth and power lives a double life - KCIA agent by day and dangerous business man by night. Determined and unstoppable, he comes face to face with a tenacious prosecutor willing to risk it all to bring him down.

episodeGuide.title: A Businessman
episodeGuide.summary: An aeroplane headed to Fukuoka is hijacked midair. Ki-tae attempts to negotiate with the terrorists but, in the process, reveals his true identity.

episodeGuide.title: The Power of the Dog
episodeGuide.summary: Geon-young has been working to bring down the Manjae Gang - unaware they're being protected by the KCIA. In response, Ki-tae is ordered to investigate.

episodeGuide.title: The Age of Prohibition
episodeGuide.summary: Kitae gets involved in an illegal operation as Geonyoung closes in on the truth.

episodeGuide.title: In the Name of the Father
episodeGuide.summary: Kitae meets with Ikeda clan to scale up operations while Geonyoung follows him to Japan.

episodeGuide.title: War of Blood
episodeGuide.summary: Geonyoung figures out how to arrest Kitae, who obliviously continues to expand his business.

episodeGuide.title: Made in Korea
episodeGuide.summary: Kitae searches for a new business partner with Yuji, while Geonyoung sets a trap to catch him.

episodeGuide.title: Kumicho (The Number One)
episodeGuide.summary: In 1979, Kitae is enjoying his power as deputy director of the KCIA when an unexpected event occurs.

episodeGuide.title: Survival of the Fittest
episodeGuide.summary: Kitae has an unexpected encounter with Kihyun, and Yejin, now a prosecutor, joins the investigation.

episodeGuide.title: Enemy's Enemy
episodeGuide.summary: Geonyoung returns and begins closing in, putting Kitae in a desperate position.

episodeGuide.title: The Beginning of the End
episodeGuide.summary: Kitae sets a dangerous plan in motion as part of his relentless pursuit of power.

episodeGuide.title: God's Will
episodeGuide.summary: As Geonyoung closes in, the conflict between Kitae and Kihyun continues to escalate.

episodeGuide.title: Made in Korea
episodeGuide.summary: Kitae and Geonyoung each set their final plans in motion.

title: The Witch
overview: Dong Jin is recognized as the best in the field of data mining. The reason he majored in statistics at his university was because of Mi Jung and his wish to help her. Dong Jin and Mi Jung attended the same high school and he had crush on her, but she was called a witch. Since Mi Jung was little, strange things occurred around her like all the guys who liked her died or got injured. 10 years after school graduation, Dong Jin happens to meet Mi Jung again. She has now cut herself off from the world, believing her fate is cursed, but she wants to go out into the world. In hopes of Mi Jung breaking out of her shell, Dong in wants to prove that all these unfortunate incidents are not because of her. To prove his thesis, he investigates all the situations when guys around her got hurt. Risking his life, he finally finds the law of misfortune around her.

episodeGuide.title: The Female Student
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-jin runs into Mi-jung, the girl who was branded as a witch in their high school. He follows her to her home without realizing it and sees how she's still suffering from the curse she's rumoured to have. Dong-jin decides to find out the law of the curse so he can help lift it and save Mi-jung.

episodeGuide.title: Witch Park Mi-jung
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-jung, who couldn't stand the rumour of her being a witch and the boys from the same school getting hurt and dying, drops out of school. But the same rumour spreads in her village, leaving her no choice but to hide from everyone. Her father decides to take her to Seoul, but an unfortunate accident kills her father as well.

episodeGuide.title: Coincidence
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-jin joins the statistics class and befriends Joong-hyuk at university, and they become best friends. He writes a statistics report to prove Park Mi-jung is not a witch, gaining the professor's attention. Dong-jin returns home during school break but learns the villagers have ousted Mi-jung from the village, breaking his heart. After graduating, he gets a job with Shine Solutions and becomes successful.

episodeGuide.title: Error of Statistics
episodeGuide.summary: The statistics report Dong-jin wrote returns to him after his mother's death, and a battle within himself begins. He takes time off work and finds a place to live next to Mi-jung to get closer. Meanwhile, a victim of Dong-jin's work comes to get his vengeance, which makes him realize numbers aren't the answers to everything. Afterward, he returns to his hometown to find clues that will break Mi-jung's witch's curse.

episodeGuide.title: The Law of Death
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-jin returns to Taebaek in search of a clue that could break the witch's curse on Mi-jung. With the support of his friends, he meticulously compiles information about the string of accidents and uncovers a disturbing pattern. As he digs deeper, he realises that he meets every condition of his hypothesis, leaving him filled with suspicion and uncertainty.

episodeGuide.title: Means and Methods
episodeGuide.summary: To uncover the missing years in his investigation, Dong-jin reaches out to Eun-sil, the one person who has been close to Mi-jung since their university days. With her help, he uncovers more accidents and deaths tied to her, strengthening his theory. As the puzzle pieces fall into place, Dong-jin realises the only way truly to validate his findings is to put himself to the ultimate test.

episodeGuide.title: Data Validation
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-jin takes on a delivery job at the supermarket where Mi-jung regularly shops. Every Tuesday, as he delivers her orders, he begins to test the theory he's been developing about her. Gradually, he pushes the boundaries of his own rules, discovering just how dangerous it can be to remain within a ten-meter radius of her. Yet, despite the growing risks, his deepening desire to be closer to her and to linger in her presence threatens to draw him into ever greater peril.

episodeGuide.title: Lee Dong-jin
episodeGuide.summary: Aware of the dire consequences of getting too close for too long, Dong-jin plunges into the river in a desperate attempt to save himself. However, Mi-jung recognises him, intensifying the danger he's already in. As he recovers in the hospital, Dong-jin turns to Producer Heo, seeking her help to identify a key variable in his hypothesis that might hold the solution he is desperately searching for.

episodeGuide.title: Shine on You
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-jin mysteriously disappears, leaving Eun-sil deeply worried about his fate. Desperate for answers, Eun-sil implores Joong-hyuk to use his detective skills to find him. As Joong-hyuk delves into the case, he recalls the past with Dong-jin, uncovering hidden clues Dong-jin left behind. In the process, Joong-hyuk uncovers Dong-jin's statistical analysis and decides to test it by approaching Mi-jung.

episodeGuide.title: The Last Variable
episodeGuide.summary: Joong-hyuk reveals Dong-jin's work to Park Mi-jung, unveiling the deeper motivations behind it. As he uncovers that Dong-jin's analysis contains subtle references to him, Joong-hyuk begins to apply Dong-jin's rules to his own life, growing increasingly close to Eun-sil. Meanwhile, in a distant country, Dong-jin patiently waits for Mi-jung, holding onto the words he has long kept hidden, eager to finally speak them aloud.

title: The Winning Try
overview: Joo Ka-Ram used to be a rugby player who was the hope for Korean rugby. He had talent and star potential, but a drug scandal ruined everything. All of the sports media covered his drug scandal. He retired from the sport under the stigma of a drug addict. 3 years later, he returns as a contract coach for the high school rugby team where he once played for. The high school rugby team is the weakest team in its league. As a coach, Joo Ka-Ram shows unrivaled charisma and an uncompromising leadership ability. He also reunites with his ex-girlfriend Bae Yi-Ji (Lim Se-Mi), who is a shooting coach at the same high school. They dated for 10 years, but, after his drug scandal, Joo Ka-Ram disappeared. Now, they reunite again while working at the same high school. Meanwhile, the rugby team has 7 players including its captain Yoon Seong-Joon. Yoon Seong-Joon is in the 3rd year of high school. He has a twin brother who is a member of the junior national soccer team. Yoon Seong-Joon also played soccer in the past, but he switched to rugby due to his lack of talent. He is twisted by envy and feels inferior toward people with talent. Yet, Yoon Seong-Joon is a hard-working person who wants to be recognized in sports.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Ju Ga-ram reemerges after a doping scandal to coach the struggling rugby team at his alma mater — facing pushback from colleagues, players and his ex.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Ga-ram risks dismissal after clashing with school staff. After, Yoon Seong-jun quits the team in protest — just before their next match.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: The team takes a hit after losing their star player, forcing Ga-ram to quickly find a replacement — but when he does, he's met with resistance.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Ga-ram faces a new challenge when the school sets a trap to block his recruit's admission — a challenging test across multiple sports.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Even with a full roster, the rugby team resorts to unconventional training. But as tensions rise, their team spirit wavers — putting everything at risk.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: With a tournament approaching, Ga-ram steps up to bring in a scout despite his reputation. Meanwhile, rumors of a controversy involving Bae I-ji spread.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: After Ga-ram is suddenly rushed to the hospital, I-ji learns the truth about his condition. Meanwhile, the two try to conceal the secret from the school.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: The rugby team receives encouraging feedback after their Presidents Cup match. As Mun Ung struggles to tackle, his teammates try to find a solution.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: An enraging confrontation with a colleague pushes Ga-ram to throw a punch. But disciplinary action forces him to step into the other coach's role.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: As the National Sports Festival nears, Seong-jun fights through a shoulder injury — but when an unexpected visitor arrives, his troubles only deepen.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Shortly after protecting Seong-jun, Ga-ram ends up at the hospital — and his students boldly rally to defend him against those who want him gone.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Ga-ram returns to witness his team in the long-awaited finals. Can they rise above every hardship and doubt to achieve the miracle of victory?

title: Low Life
overview: A man and his uncle are offered to find a bowl relic in the West Sea, and they jump into a treasure hunt to escape from their lives of selling fakes. As more and more people search for the treasure, their obsessions become mad and they are forced to make choices between desire and humanity.

episodeGuide.title: The Rumor
episodeGuide.summary: Gwan-seok, skilled at finding money, joins Hee-dong to pursue rumours of a sunken treasure. The two set off in pursuit of a potential fortune.

episodeGuide.title: Bring in the Pros
episodeGuide.summary: Gwan-seok and Hee-dong reach Mok-po, facing a rough welcome from Captain Hwang and Beol-gu's gang before they search for the shipwreck's exact location.

episodeGuide.title: Outlaws of the Sea
episodeGuide.summary: The location is still unknown when a rival shows, adding to the race. Chairman Cheon wavers, forcing Gwan-seok to scheme to get him back on board.

episodeGuide.title: Feast with the Enemy
episodeGuide.summary: Gwan-seok and Hee-dong partner with Professor Kim's crew and set sail. Meanwhile, Chairman Cheon bribes an assemblyman with pottery for favours.

episodeGuide.title: Pro Wrestler
episodeGuide.summary: Jung-sook and Deok-san reach Mok-po; she assesses pottery, he seeks Professor Kim. Convinced of the pottery's value, the team makes their first dive.

episodeGuide.title: The Plunge
episodeGuide.summary: The team hires more divers, making their first real haul. Gwanseok takes a secret job; Jungsook auctions shipwreck treasure at a U.S. military base.

episodeGuide.title: The First Casualty
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Cheon makes a big error and Jungsook jumps to control the company. At the salvage site, an accident occurs and it is Heedong's turn to dive.

episodeGuide.title: The Sunken Ship
episodeGuide.summary: The ship rises from the deep, pottery in tow in front of Heedong. Men seize Professor Kim; Heedong, eyeing profit, dreams of a grand public salvage.

episodeGuide.title: Flip-Flop
episodeGuide.summary: Under a false government banner, the salvage begins. As Honggi probes the diver's accident, danger near. He gives Heedong key information to survives.

episodeGuide.title: A Hell of a Mess
episodeGuide.summary: Professor Kim flees to Busan with the loot, with Honggi in pursuit. In Seoul, Gwanseok takes on a task. Heedong and Seonja reach warehouse in Muan.
