episodeGuide.title: The Last Order
episodeGuide.summary: Sensing trouble, Gwanseok rushes to Muan. After Professor Kim's boat sinks, Gwanseok, Heedong, Jungsook and others fight over the remaining treasure.

title: ONE: High School Heroes
overview: A school action drama that depicts the story of a model student who once dedicated all his attention to studying but finds himself entangled in domestic violence and school bullying, compelling him to make a transformative decision. "High School Heroes" pertains to a group formed by the main characters who stand up against school violence perpetrators on behalf of the victims.

episodeGuide.title: Walkman
episodeGuide.summary: "How are you going to fight tomorrow? It starts tomorrow." After losing the cassette, Ui-Gyeom meets Yoon-Ki and their normal life is shaken up.

episodeGuide.title: Emergency Room
episodeGuide.summary: "Fighting is a talent, after all." After a fight with Seung-joon, he encounters an unexpected accident.

episodeGuide.title: Privilege
episodeGuide.summary: "I don't want to give in, not to them..." The resolve to fight back. Despair, visions, and an unexpected hand lead him on.

episodeGuide.title: Hero Mask
episodeGuide.summary: "The problem is there are too many bad guys in the world." Anger with nowhere to go and shaky justice. Yun and Yi decide to "revolutionize.

episodeGuide.title: High School Heroes
episodeGuide.summary: "Us? We just decided to be High School Super Heroes!!" Masked Yi-gyeom and Yoon-gi, the High School Super Heroes begin to move.

episodeGuide.title: Bad Guy
episodeGuide.summary: "That's enough. We have to be different from them." High School Super Heroes in action. Choi Ki-soo appears in front of the outrageous Yi-gyeom and Yoon-ki who is trying to stop him.

title: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
overview: Legendary Goblins and Gumiho appear in 21st-century Seoul, Getting tangled with them, everything start to go wrong! The almighty Goblin King and the soft, squishy aspiring actor a tingling, electrifying romance fantasy begins!

title: Love Scout
overview: A successful and confident woman, Kang Ji Yun, is the CEO of a headhunting company. To survive in the fiercely competitive headhunting field, she puts everything she has into her work. Outside of her job, she doesn't know how to do anything. She has a secretary named Yoo Eun Ho who takes care of pretty much everything for her. Unlike his boss, the secretary is friendly, well-mannered, and considerate of other people. He is a single father, who is also good at parenting and housework.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: As the CEO of a top executive search firm, Kang Ji-yun scouts and recruits talent. Yoo Eun-ho is a thorn in her side, thwarting her recruitment goals.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yun is displeased with her new secretary, Eun-ho. As hard as he tries to ingratiate himself, Eun-ho can't seem to crack through her icy demeanor.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-ho dwells on what he had seen at CareerWay. Meanwhile, he slowly adjusts to the headhunter life, and Ji-yun's chilly exterior starts to melt.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After learning what had gone down between Ji-yun and Hye-jin in the past, Eun-ho tries to cheer her up. The Peoples employees are abuzz with conflict.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: After the dinner, Ji-yun finds her thoughts drifting to Eun-ho but refuses to entertain the idea. Oblivious to her unrest, Mi-ae arranges a meeting.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yun and Eun-ho spend the night at his house. Ever since then, something is brewing between them. Meanwhile, Su-hyeon's call sends Eun-ho running.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yun now understands her feelings for Eun-ho. Her eyes are perpetually fixed on her secretary, and others in the office are starting to notice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Once Ji-yun and Eun-ho confirm their feelings for each other, they begin a clandestine office romance. Ji-yun attends an event hosted by Chairman Woo.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-ho comforts Ji-yun, and the two grow closer than ever. Ji-yun and Hye-jin compete head-to-head to appoint the CEO of a domestic industry giant.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yun learns that the child her father had saved back then was Eun-ho. In the light of this shocking truth, their relationship starts to crumble.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Peoplez takes a huge hit when they are suspected of being involved in an investment scam, and Ji-yoon and Eun-ho.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: When Ji-yun announces her resignation, the office falls into chaos. Confident in her defeat of Ji-yun, Hye-jin moves in to take over the Peoplez firm.

title: Walking on Thin Ice
overview: A human thriller that takes place when a housewife in her 40s with a sick husband accidentally picks up drugs that fell on the road.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-soo faces the looming threat of losing her home after her husband's investment fails. To make matters worse, he is diagnosed with cancer, shattering their once-peaceful life. In the midst of the chaos, Eun-soo stumbles upon a drug bag left behind by the trafficking organization and steps into a world of crime. Eun-soo now finds herself torn between right and wrong, caught in a moral crisis.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: A dangerous and desperate partnership begins between Eun-soo and Kyung. They start selling the product offline together to VIPs at the nightclub where Kyung works. Meanwhile, the police intensify their investigation, combing through the club district in search of the missing drugs and gradually closing in on Eun-soo and Kyung.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: For Eun-soo, the need for money never stops. It's a relentless string of expenses with her husband's new treatment, her daughter's art class fees, and even unexpected home repairs. James finds out the source of the drugs Eun-soo brought and becomes furious. He tells her to give up all the drugs as it's dangerous, and Eun-soo feels like she's lost all her hope.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Lee Kyung challenges Eun-soo to earn 100,000 dollars within two weeks. Determined, Eun-soo ventures into online sales, but the reality proves far more difficult than expected. Just then, a mysterious buyer appears and offer to purchase the product, but only through a face-to-face deal. After much deliberation, Eun-soo decides to meet the buyer in secret without Lee Kyung's knowledge.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: After finding Eun-soo's name on a burner phone, detectives Tae-gu and Kyung-do search her home but come up empty. Eun-soo masterfully plays the part of a devoted mother, but Tae-gu's instincts scream that something is dangerously wrong. Some secrets refuse to stay buried.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: A violent attack on Eun-soo takes a horrifying turn when she recognizes one of the masked men as her co-worker, Dong-hyun. She and Lee Kyung manage to subdue him and his brother, but their desperate solution quickly unravels when the captives vanish without a trace. Now they know who she is.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Forced to pay a blackmailer an impossible sum, Eun-soo and Kyung must restart their dangerous business to meet the one week deadline. As they scramble for the money, they desperately hunt for the culprit who seems to be watching their every move. The truth is closer than they think.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: The money-grubber is shockingly revealed to be Detective Tae-gu, who uses Lee Kyung's revenge plot to blackmail him into a corner. Now, Lee Kyung must force an unsuspecting Eun-soo to sell drugs to pay him off, causing Eun-soo's life to shatter. Some secrets are meant to be broken.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: As Detective Kyung-do gets closer to the truth about the Phantom case, his own superior Tae-gu frames him as a corrupt mole. With his most dogged pursuer neutralized, Tae-gu now turns his attention to Eun-soo, ordering a rookie to tail her young daughter Su-ah. Now, everyone is a target.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Though Su-ah is finally safe, Eun-soo is immediately cornered by Tae-gu, who threatens to expose her daughter's crimes. With Do-jin also discovering her secret, a desperate Eun-soo listens as Lee Kyung presents a dangerous way out. Some offers can't be refused.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Waking up from a brutal attack, corrupt detective Jang Tae-gu discovers his world is collapsing from the inside. His own protege, Choi Kyung-do, uncovers the damning evidence that could expose everything, proving that the hunter has officially become the hunted. There is no one left to trust.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Facing a lifetime in prison, Kang Eun-soo is offered a dangerous way out by the police. She and her partner Lee Kyung must lure her husband's murderer, the fugitive Jang Tae-gu, into a deadly trap. But as she fights for her freedom, Eun-soo discovers the deepest betrayals come from those she once called friends. Some lines, once crossed, can never be erased.

title: Buried Hearts
overview: To survive, a man hacked into a political slush fund worth 2 trillion won. The other man is a powerful shadowy figure, who loses 2 trillion won by killing a man without knowing that he was hacked.

episodeGuide.title: Dong-ju, Betrayed by Love
episodeGuide.summary: Seo Dong Ju is confident he can have it all, Daesan Group and the love of his life. But...

episodeGuide.title: Dong-ju, Taken Out by Attackers after Securing Slush Funds
episodeGuide.summary: Dong Ju risks being kicked out of Daesan Group after news spreads about him living with Eun Nam.

episodeGuide.title: Dong-ju, Steals 2 Trillion Won to Stay Alive
episodeGuide.summary: Dong Ju deceives Yeom Jang Seon and steals 2 trillion won to survive.

episodeGuide.title: Dong-ju, Returns to Recover Lost Memories
episodeGuide.summary: Yeom Jang Seon searches for Dong Ju belatedly. Dong Ju wakes up remembering only the name Seong Hyeon.

episodeGuide.title: Dong Ju's Mind Holds Two Trillion Won
episodeGuide.summary: Dong Ju returns, but Yeom Jang Seon refuses to believe his amnesia.

episodeGuide.title: Resurfacing Memories, and Sister Agnes
episodeGuide.summary: No matter the torture, Dong Ju claims to remember nothing. Heo Il Do suggests hypnosis therapy.

episodeGuide.title: Cinnamon from the One behind Sister Agnes' Death
episodeGuide.summary: During Sister Agnes' funeral, Dong Ju sets out to find those responsible for his sister's death.

episodeGuide.title: Forget the Two Trillion and Kill Seo Dong Ju
episodeGuide.summary: Dong Ju falls into a coma, and Yeom Jang Seon seizes the chance to take over Daesan Group.

episodeGuide.title: Here's the Gun, Sir
episodeGuide.summary: Dong Ju must save Eun Nam from Jang Seon's murder plot. He uncovers the force backing Jang Seon.

episodeGuide.title: I'd Like to Meet You Just Once
episodeGuide.summary: While searching for the Dandelion files to complete his revenge, Dong Ju uncovers a shocking truth.

episodeGuide.title: Keep It a Secret Until the End
episodeGuide.summary: After learning about his father, Dong Ju investigates his car accident from 30 years ago.

episodeGuide.title: I'm Still Alive, Keep Shooting
episodeGuide.summary: Dong Ju secures the Dandelion files, including the truth about the incident from 30 years ago.

episodeGuide.title: You're a Terrible Person, a Real Bastard
episodeGuide.summary: After Il Do learns the truth about his son, he cuts off Jang Seon. Jang Seon seeks out Gang Cheon.

episodeGuide.title: Mr. Yeom Crawling at My Feet, Begging?
episodeGuide.summary: Saved by Il Do's sacrifice, Dong Ju begins planning his revenge against Jang Seon.

episodeGuide.title: I'm Not Even Allowed to Say That?
episodeGuide.summary: Having lost everything, Jang-seon vows to claim Daesan Group, fuelling a rivalry with Dong-ju.

episodeGuide.title: You'll Have to Ask More Earnestly
episodeGuide.summary: With his revenge complete, Dong-ju ties up loose ends. But where's Jang-seon?

title: The Haunted Palace
overview: Born with shamanic powers that she refuses to accept, a young woman confronts her gift to rid the Joseon palace of evil spirits and save her first love.

episodeGuide.title: Unwilling Journey Begins
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo Ri tries to escape the shadow of Gang Cheol, the dragon deity who ruined her past. A request from Yun Gap leads her onto a dangerous path where he is lethally ambushed by political foes, giving Gang Cheol the perfect chance to possess his body. Now, her greatest enemy is closer than ever within the form of her trusted, dying friend.

episodeGuide.title: Where Gang-cheol Walks, Autumn Turns to Spring
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo Ri wakes up at the palace. She finds out that Kang Cheol wasn't the one who attacked Yun Gap. However, she's still suspicious about Kang Cheol since he possessed Yun Gap's body. She looks for Yun Gap's spirit, but she runs into something else instead. Meanwhile, Kang Cheol who is in Yun Gap's body is fascinated by the human senses. It feels awkward, but he starts to enjoy being human.

episodeGuide.title: The Eight-Foot-Tall Ghost
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo-ri manages to locate Yoon Gap's soul and prepares a shamanic ritual to retrieve it. Gangcheori worries for her, though his fears are unfounded.

episodeGuide.title: The Shining Gem of the Night
episodeGuide.summary: The king is possessed by the Eight-feet Spirit, but Yeo Ri and Kang Cheol manage to get rid of it. Kang Cheol wants to leave the capital to stay away from the Eight-feet Spirit, but Yeo Ri asks him to help her get rid of the spirit and save Yun Gap. However, the king banishes the two from the capital for breaking the law, which is doing a ritual in the capital. Meanwhile, the Eight-feet Spirit finds another target.

episodeGuide.title: The Eight-Foot-Tall Ghost Has an Ally
episodeGuide.summary: Cheol asks Monk Ga Seop if he could perform gubyeongsisik and drive the Eight-feet spirit out of the world. The monk tells him that they need to deplete the energy of the glowing pearl within his body to settle the resentment of the evil spirit. After Prince Yeong In's passing, Cheol finds out someone in the Palace is aiding the Eight-feet spirit.

episodeGuide.title: The Skull in the Pillow
episodeGuide.summary: Pung San is pleased to find out that the Queen is pregnant with the King's child, giving the General of Heaven and Earth another child to feed on. Cheol learns from Bi Bi that he needs to kill the body of Gap to get out of his body. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri finds a skull with a talisman hidden in the Queen's pillow that causes the Queen to have nightmares.

episodeGuide.title: A Deadly Spell
episodeGuide.summary: The water spirit attacks Yeo Ri with a deadly spell. She slowly shows the same symptoms as the Queen, who is bedridden due to an unknown illness. Kang Cheol suggests that the King become bait to catch the water spirit, as it wants the royal blood. Yeo Ri hears the news and rushes to the river where Kang Cheol and the King are waiting for the water spirit to emerge.

episodeGuide.title: Aguji
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo Ri and Kang Cheol grant the water spirit's wish and bring his remains to his daughter. In return, the water spirit confesses that Aguji was behind the attacks on the Queen. The King locks up all the blind shamans from the Bureau of the Blind and interrogates them to find who Aguji is. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri finds out that the Eight-feet Spirit killed her grandmother.

episodeGuide.title: 13 Years Ago
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo Ri finds out the Eight-feet Spirit devoured her grandmother's spirit while trying to save the late King. Cheol makes Bi Bi guard Yeo Ri in case she puts herself in danger while pursuing the Eight-feet Spirit. As the King wants to make Choi Won U the First Vice-Premier, Kim Bong In uses Pung San and Dowager Queen to put a stop to it.

episodeGuide.title: There is No Evil Ghost
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo Ri shares with the King that they need to uncover the identity of the Eight-feet Spirit and settle his grudge to be able to send him off. As soon as Yeo Ri realises that Pung San is Aguji, he takes Yeo Ri by force and hides her. Cheol goes to the Bureau of the Blind to find her, and Aguji reveals his true identity to him.

episodeGuide.title: Who is Behind Eight-Foot-Tall Ghost?
episodeGuide.summary: The origin of the ghost gets Gangcheori thinking. Bi-bi is left susceptible and resentful when Yeo-ri keeps her from getting Gangcheori's help.

episodeGuide.title: The Anthology of Light and Darkness
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Chul mourns Bi Bi's absence with a heart riven by sorrow. Yeo Ri tells Jeong that Kim Bong In is behind Aguji and the Eight-feet Spirit. Jeong summons Bong In and asks why he did such terrible deeds. Yeo Ri, Jeong, and Kang Chul head to Yong Dam Village. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri senses the presence of the One-legged Spirit again.

episodeGuide.title: The Return of The Spirit
episodeGuide.summary: Amidst astonished faces, the eight-foot-tall ghost reveals itself. Feelings grow deeper between Gangcheori and Yeo-ri as someone lurks in their midst.

episodeGuide.title: The Ghostbane Stone
episodeGuide.summary: Pung San tells Yoon Gap to pour the mysterious liquid over the warding stone so that the King can claim his body for good. Gap asks Yeo Ri to send him over before he harms the King. The ritual for the Eight-feet Spirit is held with the King and Queen's presence. When Yeo Ri summons the spirit, she senses that something has gone wrong.

episodeGuide.title: Spirit Possession
episodeGuide.summary: Gangcheori and Yeo-ri mourns the fallen King. But the eight-foot-tall ghost is only beginning. In what may be their last, the two share precious time.

title: The Hunter With a Scalpel
overview: Seo Se-Hyun is a genius forensic pathologist. While examining a corpse, she discovers traces of her father Yoon Jo-Kyun who is a serial killer. She desperately attempts to track down her father Yoon Jo-Kyun with Jung Jung-Hyun. He is the chief of the violent crimes team.
broadcast: U+ Mobile TV · Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: One of the bodies entrusted to Seo Se-hyun, a promising soup autopsy. The thread sutured with the smell of rocks in the body reminds me of her past. Jung Hyun, the head of the strong team, is in charge of the investigation.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Se-hyun, who visited the body organic field with Chung Hyun, recalls the traces of his dead murderer, Yoon Jo Kyun. Meanwhile, after visiting Yongcheon site, Oh Min-ho, the team member of Se-hyun, continues the absence for a few days.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: In Yongcheon, a carcass with a thread is found, and the identity of the body is found to be the missing team of Se-hyun. Se-hyun, who discovered the same technique and clues in the second body, feels that the bacteria are back.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Chung Hyun, who arrested an innocent citizen as a suspect, is hit by the media, and Se-hyun, who helps him, announces a serial murder. Se-hyun, who reveals his existence to Cho Kyun, tries to stimulate him and pull him over the surface.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Se-hyun installs a temporary autopsy in Yongcheon and chases traces of the bacteria. That night, Se-hyun finds a third carcass in front of his studio. Se-hyun tells Cho Kyun, who celebrates his birthday, and tells him to start playing in the future.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Se-hyun finds her childhood photographs planted by Cho Kyun in the third body and is shocked. Se-hyun, who is in a hurry by the caught clue, heads to Hae-ryong, who lived with Jo Kyun in the past. There, there is a faces of Cho Kyun and his new murder assistant, Se-eun.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Jung Hyun's investigation expands to the "Cheongwoon Port Incident", where Se-hyun and Cho Kyun were together. In the investigation situation, Se-hyun suggests that Cho Kyun is making a fake criminal. However, Sehyun falls into a trap from the address sent by Cho Kyun.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Se-hyun, who managed to deal with the trap of Cho Kyun, meets Jocyun at the appointment. On the other hand, Jung Hyun finds out that Se-hyun hid the outcome of the drug and doubts.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Jung Hyun is confused by the suspicious circumstances of Se-hyun, and Cho Kyun makes a full war to isolate Se-hyun. Se-hyun, who has been seized and searched for the sin for deceiving the result of the drug, chooses silence in front of Jung-hyun, who asks for the truth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Se-hyun is a suspect of all murder in Cho Kyun's careful manipulation, and even Hyun-hyun pursues Se-hyun. Se-hyun, who is at a corner, heads to a nursing hospital with a mother-in-law, and finds the situation where Cho Kyun went there. Se-hyun decides with the last battle and heads to the residence of Joseun.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: An attempted murder occurs at a laundromat, and Se-hyun is wanted. Jeong-hyeon, who has been suspended from duty, decides to conduct an independent investigation. Meanwhile, Se-hyun, who was captured by Jo Gyun and imprisoned in a truck, encounters Se-eun, the girl who replaced him, and gets caught up in a horrific family game.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-hyeon, who got closer to the truth through the living victim, tracks down Jo Gyun's truck. Se-hyeon and Se-eun devise a way to escape from the truck.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: Jung-hyun is in danger due to a serious injury. Se-hyun is forced to make a crucial decision to protect Se-eun, and let the world know that there is another victim, Se-eun, who is still suffering.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: Se-hyeon confesses his past to Jeong-hyeon. The two decide to work together to capture Jo Gyun. Meanwhile, Jo Gyun threatens Se-hyeon using Se-eun's life as an excuse.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 15
episodeGuide.summary: With Se-eun's whereabouts unknown, Se-hyeon becomes enraged, believing that Jo-gyun has already killed the girl. After receiving Jo-gyun's message, Se-hyeon escapes the hospital and tracks down Jo-gyun. Jeong-hyeon sets out to find Se-eun.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 16
episodeGuide.summary: Despite his injury, Jeong-hyeon does not give up on finding Se-eun to keep his promise to Se-hyeon. At the same time, Se-hyeon faces Jo-gyun at the Mujin Tidal Flat and is faced with a final choice.

title: The Art of Negotiation
overview: Yoon Joo-no, a key figure in the former M&A Team of SANIN GROUP, suddenly disappeared one day, leaving for Hawaii for undisclosed reasons. Rumors spread that he had been demoted, but the truth remains unknown to anyone. Then, three years later, when SANIN GROUP is facing bankruptcy with 11 billion dollars in debt, he is called back to Korea as their last hope. His mission is clear: to save SANIN GROUP. However, his solution is far from straightforward. Gaining the support of CEO Song Jae-sik, he forms a new M&A Team and gathers the best negotiators to dive into the perilous world of high-stakes deals. With his team, Joo-no takes one last gamble. Can he secure the 11 billion dollars needed to save the company, or will even the so-called "god of negotiation" be brought down?

episodeGuide.title: The Kick Off
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Joo-no the White Snake that moves without sound and swallows without a trace is returning. The return of a cold-blooded meritocratic M&A expert means SANIN GROUP is in serious trouble. Who will have to die for SANIN GROUP at stake to survive?

episodeGuide.title: The Key Man
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Joo-no has to cut out SANIN Construction to save SANIN GROUP. Despite SANIN Construction CEO Lee Hun-min's interruption, Joo-no successfully conducts bidding. However, SANIN Construction's hidden risk comes to the surface, and he faces a crisis in the last negotiation. Will Joo-no and the M&A Team resolve this crisis?

episodeGuide.title: The Pivot
episodeGuide.summary: The M&A Team's next target is CHACHA Games. Yoon Joo-no suggests CHACHA Games CEO Cha Ho-jin switch the "game" business to something else. However, Cha Ho-jin doesn't want to sell the company. What does CHACHA Games mean to him?

episodeGuide.title: Your Language
episodeGuide.summary: Who's getting in the way of negotiation with CHACHA Games? Yoon Joo-no and his team now have to hide without revealing themselves. Meanwhile, Choi Jin-soo realizes negotiation went under due to his mistakes. He now makes an effort to redeem himself.

episodeGuide.title: The Deadline
episodeGuide.summary: When SANIN Group's crisis is reported, its stock price plummets. If SANIN fails to defend its stock price, it'll be taken over by SAMOEL FUND. The reason for the stock price collapse is the failure to list its bicycle company affiliate WIND. Yoon Joo-no and his team head to Japan to persuade their vendor in Japan and list WIND.

episodeGuide.title: Inner Thoughts
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Joo-no and his team are cornered in the negotiation with the Japanese company SHIMIZ. However, Joo-no would never back down like this. The M&A Team prepares a countermeasure. However, the M&A Team faces a crisis that even SHIMIZ didn't expect. To resolve the problem, Joo-no digs up the secret between WIND and SHIMIZ.

episodeGuide.title: Classified
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Song Jae-sik got a 50 million dollar loan secured on his SANIN GROUP. What did he spend it on? To find the clue, Joo-no and his team set off to DADO Hotel on Jeju Island. There, they meet Ji-oh who's been staying in the suite.

episodeGuide.title: Opportunity Cost
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Joo-no suggests DADO Hotel's CEO Song Ji-oh sell the resort. When Chairman Song hears it, he becomes furious. In the end, he orders Joo-no and his team to return to the headquarters with their letters of resignation. What's the reason Chairman Song and Ji-oh want to keep DADO Hotel so desperately?

episodeGuide.title: The Direction
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Song offers Joo-no an executive position. All SANIN GROUP executives passed Chairman Song's test before they were promoted, and Joo-no isn't an exception. Joo-no's test is to sell GREEN VIEW Country Club which happens to be located in Lawyer Oh Soon-young's hometown.

episodeGuide.title: Loyalty
episodeGuide.summary: While doing a recce on GREEN VIEW Country Club, corruption is revealed. And the person responsible for it is Soon-young's friend as well as GREEN VIEW's finance manager Jeong Bon-ju. Meanwhile, Lee Hun-min who appears as a buyer demands to fire all employees as the M&A condition. Yoon Joo-no is now on the verge of giving up on his belief to pass Chairman Song's test.

episodeGuide.title: Disciplinary Action
episodeGuide.summary: SANIN GROUP's Audit Team receives an anonymous letter about M&A Team Manager Yoon Joo-no's JUMBO Pharma stock manipulation. Joo-no is summoned to the disciplinary committee. Ha Tae-soo chokes Joo-no with inevitable evidence. Joo-no has no escape, and he confronts Ha Tae-soo head to head.

episodeGuide.title: Operation
episodeGuide.summary: What was the reason the White Snake had to leave the country? There were a lot of rumors about Yoon Joo-no. As the disciplinary committee continues, the truth about his participation in JUMBO Pharma is revealed, and Joo-no faces the emotions he hid deep down in his heart.

title: FC Soldout
overview: FC Soldout is about a soccer team that is not doing well, one day it is bought by a agency, the reason for the acquisition is just to commoditize the team to make money again, the agency takes over and cuts out all the players with poor face，then forces the actors with face value from their agency to become players.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Ji Woo's struggling soccer team takes on a new investor who adds a roster of popular influencers to the team.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Team members who need to improve their teamwork skills are invited to a special training camp.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Jae reveals to Ji Woo that they used to be classmates during their school days. Sun Bin is scolded by Tae Young, but the two find time to connect one on one and mend their relationship.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: The captain and Sun Bin train well together, but captain is distracted by Ji Woo and Kyung Jae's interactions, making Sun Bin jealous. Sun Bin schemes behind the scenes to get what he wants.

title: Mercy for None
overview: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death -- embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: After Nam Gi Suk's mysterious death, Nam Gi Jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: After tracking down Gi Suk's hit, Gi Joon discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun Mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi Jun himself.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi Suk's hit. After Jun Mo attacks his friends, Gi Jun goes head-to-head with Jun Mo's army.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Cha Young Do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum Son seizes power, Gi Jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum Son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi Jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?

title: Business as Unusual
overview: Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he's older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn't progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind…

episodeGuide.title: To All the Submissives Clumsy at Love

title: Cashero
overview: An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Unable to afford a place with Kim Min Suk, Kang Sang Woong visits his father — who grants him a power that will test both his morals and his bank account.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Sang Woong calls Park Jung Ja for help when he finds himself in a crisis — only to end up in danger. Meanwhile, Jo Anna uses Min Suk as bait to lure him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: After realizing he's become a target, Sang Woong trains with Byun Ho In and Bang Eun Mi. Soon after, he contacts Jung Ja for help to face Anna's army.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Longing for a normal life, Sang Woong considers selling his power to the Mundane Vanguard — but Ho In attempts to stop him from making a mistake.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: After narrowly escaping danger, Sang Woong, Ho In and Eun Mi find themselves taunted by Jo Nathan. Soon, they investigate a drug ring at a nightclub.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: After escaping another trap, Sang Woong realizes his regular life is taking a negative impact. But Anna comes forward with an unexpected proposal.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: The bank scheme quickly turns perilous, pitting Sang Woong against Anna and Nathan. But Nathan lures him in by taking what matters most.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Fighting for his love, Sang Woong goes toe-to-toe with the Mundane Vanguard. Will he and his friends finally become the heroes they were meant to be?

title: The First Night with the Duke
overview: A handsome, selfish noble falls for a beautiful, kind commoner -- at least, that's how the story's supposed to go. When an average college student wakes up as Cha Sun Chaek, an extra in her favorite romance novel, she resolves to enjoy the luxuries of her character's status while watching the novel's plot unfold from the sidelines. However, her plans are soon derailed when she finds herself in bed with no other than Lee Bun, the novel's hero! Dodging the villainess' schemes, the Duke's advances, and her own feelings, can Sun Chaek keep the story on track and survive beyond the first night?

episodeGuide.title: Reading a book is like a person's life is coming to you
episodeGuide.summary: University student 'K' finds herself magically transported into her beloved novel "The Obsessive Tyrant", where she takes on the role of Lady Cha Seon Chaek, the only daughter of the Chief State Minister. She had dreamed of being a quiet observer, simply witnessing the romantic tale between Prince Gyeong Seong and Cho Eun Ae unfold. However, during the night of the Dahong Club's meeting, an unexpected turn occurs. When she awakens the following day, she discovers she's lying next to Prince Gyeong Seong!

episodeGuide.title: The first night in Yi Beon's life
episodeGuide.summary: By chance, Seon Chaek meets Bun and ends up spending the night at his place. The next day, Bun wishes to rush to arrange a wedding with Seon Chaek, but Seon Chaek has no intention of marrying him. She begins plotting clever ways to escape the situation. Will Seon Chaek's plans succeed? Meanwhile, she finds herself threatened by thugs in the woods. That's when a mysterious man suddenly appears to help her.

episodeGuide.title: Something Always Happens on a Moonlit Night
episodeGuide.summary: To set her story back on course, Seon Chaek orchestrates a gathering to unite the intense Lord Lee Bun with his intended match. But her elaborate scheme hilariously backfires, only fanning the flames of his dangerous obsession with her instead. Now, she's trapped in a new chapter she never meant to write.

episodeGuide.title: We need Cha Sun Chaek.* (*Means "Plan B")
episodeGuide.summary: Bun shocks everyone in the Astral Philosophy Club by announcing that he's going to marry Sun Chaek. To make matters worse, Bun goes to Sun Chaek's family and claims that she took his innocence and that is the reason they must get married. However, Sun Chaek's father firmly opposes the idea.

episodeGuide.title: There Is No Such Thing As
episodeGuide.summary: Resolved to bet her fate on Yi Beon, Seon Chaek bravely enters the treacherous royal bride selection. Just as she commits to her path, Su Gyeom reels from the shocking news that Eun Ae is also a candidate. The game for Yi Beon's heart has just become dangerously complicated.

episodeGuide.title: The Answer to the Second Screening
episodeGuide.summary: Beon gets close to Hwa Sun in order to enter the Do family's house and snoop around inside to find evidence regarding the foreigner. Meanwhile, Seon Chaek feels lost about how to tackle the assignment given by the Queen Dowager, but after witnessing the struggles of farmers suffering from a bad harvest, she suddenly gets an idea.

episodeGuide.title: The Inflection Point
episodeGuide.summary: Lee Beon creates a perfect romantic day for Seon Chaek, proving their love can overcome any obstacle thrown their way. Their fairytale moment is destroyed by the arrival of Lee Gyu, a charismatic stranger who claims a prior right to Seon Chaek's hand. He built a perfect world for her, only for another man to tear it down.

episodeGuide.title: Lee Gyu's Suspicious Return
episodeGuide.summary: While sharing a moment of affection with Lee Beon, Seon Chaek is caught by her father and is promptly grounded. Meanwhile, the King grows suspicious of Lee Gyu's sudden return to Hanyang. Meanwhile, Bun makes every effort to earn the favour of Seon Chaek's family. Beon's first target is Seon Chaek's brothers.

episodeGuide.title: The Wounded Things
episodeGuide.summary: Yi Beon's desperate rescue of Seon Chaek should bring them closer, but a new mystery tears them apart. When the kidnapper's body appears in public, Seon Chaek confronts a horrifying truth about the man she loves. She is safe in his arms, but she may be in love with a monster.

episodeGuide.title: Who Is the Accomplice?
episodeGuide.summary: Su Gyeom confronts Eun Ae, asking if she's the one who wrote the letter that led Seon Chaek into the trap. Determined to clear her name, Hwa Seon decides to find the real culprit herself. Bun presses Eun Ae to reveal who her accomplice is, but she refuses to give in easily. Seon Chaek asks Yi Gyu to step in and help Bun out of his predicament.

episodeGuide.title: The Fortune and the Fall
episodeGuide.summary: Seon Chaek seeks out Sul Gi to ask about the identity of the wooden doll, but Sul Gi draws a fortune that even she struggles to interpret. The King fears that the Black Gang might come after him while Yi Beon is away from the palace. While Yi Beon is away and the King grows weaker, Yi Gyu begins to undermine him.

episodeGuide.title: The Miracle of the Bracelet of Fate
episodeGuide.summary: Yi Beon miraculously finds his way back to the Palace. Yet, the King, shaken to his core, believes it is Yi Beon's ghost that is haunting him. Meanwhile, Seok Chaek asks Eun Ae, her favourite character, when she started becoming so cruel, and Eun Ae answers without hesitation that this is who she has always been.

title: Hyper Knife
overview: Jung Se Ok, a formerly successful neurosurgeon who works as a shadow doctor in an underground surgery clinic after being expelled by her mentor, Choi Duk Hee. Soon, both doctors reunite, reigniting a tense and emotional rivalry.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Once a brilliant neurosurgeon but now a pharmacist in a rural town, Se-ok still performs brain surgeries at night. Se-ok is confronted by Deok-hee, the mentor who had a hand in stripping her of her medical license and ruining her life.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Deok-hee wants Se-ok to operate on him for a tumour in his head, but Se-ok does not want to comply with her mentor's request. Frustrated by his former pupil's reluctance, Deok-hee puts pressure on Se-ok.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Se-ok wants revenge for what Deok-hee did to her and meets Na-nae in the hope of stopping Deok-hee from winning the Ichida trophy, an award he is poised to win for the tenth consecutive year.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Se-ok is in search of Deok-hee's weaknesses. She visits a former patient, Kim Myeong-jin, who is the main reason for Deok-hee's betrayal, and asks him why he wanted to erase her from his life.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Se-ok's past comes back to haunt her when Doo-bong, a former patient, calls and warns her of a threat coming her way. To make matters worse, a sudden house fire pushes Se-ok to the edge.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: A rich patient requires a highly complex surgery that needs two skilled neurosurgeons. Deok-hee comes on board, taunting Se-ok and telling her he wants to see what her world is like. Stuck with no other choice, the two reunite at the operating table.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Se-ok assumes that Deok-hee's ailment only requires surgery, but learns from U-yeong that his condition is terminal; she prepares for the surgery and calls Deok-hee, telling him to come right away so she can operate on him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Se-ok's past begins to resurface as she tries to blackmail Deok-hee into being treated; after causing confusion as a medical consultant in an investigation, Deok-hee makes a deal with Inspector Yang.

title: Spirit Fingers
overview: Song U-Yeon (Park Ji-Hu) is an ordinary high school student, who isn't special in any specific thing. Her mother always put her older brother and younger brother before Song U-Yeon and her opinions are usually ignored at home. Due to this, Song U-Yeon doesn't express her feelings and she has low self-esteem. One day, a good looking man on the street asks her to pose as a model for a group of people. The man is Koo Sun-Ho (Choi Bo-Min) and the group are members of sketch club Spirit Fingers, including their President Nam Geu-Rin (Park Yoo-Na). Song U-Yeon poses on the street for them, but, unlike Song U-Yeon, the members are full of individuality and seem to get along well. This leads Song U-Yeon to join Spirit Fingers. The members encourage and compliment Song U-Yeon, which causes her self-esteem to grow. Meanwhile, Nam Gi-Jung (Jo Joon-Young) is Club President Nam Geu-Rin's younger brother and he is a high school student and the same age as Song U-Yeon. He has an attractive appearance and models for internet shopping malls as a part-time jpb. Due to Song U-Yeon, he begins to think about his future as a model seriously.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Song Woo-yeon, an ordinary high school student with low self-esteem, finds herself posing for a painting while out with friends. She's then invited to the mysterious croquis group "Spirit Fingers." Seduced by the handsome Seon-ho, Woo-yeon joins the group. However, there, she encounters Ki-jeong, the younger brother of fellow member Green, who witnessed her embarrassing behavior at the hands of a bully.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Worried that Ki-jung will tell Seon-ho about his embarrassing behavior, Woo-yeon desperately avoids him, and Ki-jung is displeased with Woo-yeon's behavior. Meanwhile, Seon-ho, who likes Green as a woman rather than a friend, is heartbroken by her friend-only attitude. Then, when Ki-jung's one-sided promise overlaps with his date with Seon-ho, Woo-yeon lies to Ki-jung and breaks his promise...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Ki-jung notices that Woo-yeon likes Seon-ho. He's furious, but he's also confused about why. Unaware of Ki-jung's true feelings, Woo-yeon fears Ki-jung will tell Seon-ho about her feelings, and misunderstands that Ki-jung is angry because she's worried that he, an ordinary person, will come between Seon-ho and Green, who seem like a perfect pair.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Ki-jung unconsciously confesses her feelings for Woo-yeon. Woo-yeon can't believe Ki-jung likes her, but Ki-jung, now aware of her feelings, finds Woo-yeon unbearably adorable. Meanwhile, seeing Woo-yeon brighten and become more handsome through Spirit Fingers, and even receiving a confession from Ki-jung, Mirae's self-esteem explodes, leading her to say something hurtful to Woo-yeon, and the two end up in a huge fight...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Seonho, whose secret feelings for Green have finally burst forth, declares that from now on, he will be a man, not just a friend. However, Green, fearful of losing his precious friend, avoids Seonho's feelings. Meanwhile, Kijung and Wooyeon are growing closer. The two schedule a date that isn't really a date, and on the day of the date, Wooyeon, who is waiting for Kijung, is quietly approached by the dark hand of Yerim, who has a crush on Kijung...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: After Seonho's confession, Seonho and Green's relationship becomes increasingly awkward. Green finds this situation incredibly distressing. Wooyeon, too, hates the feeling of being small and being compared to others around her when she's with Kijung, and declares she'll never love her. Meanwhile, Wooyeon, who studied hard to confidently attend the "Spirit Fingers" club, finally tells her mother when her grades improve, but she's severely scolded and heartbroken...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Seon-ho's bombshell announcement that he's about to enlist in the military shakes Green's heart, and thoughts of Seon-ho fill his mind. Meanwhile, Ki-jung goes around bragging about taking responsibility for Woo-yeon after the kissing incident, and Woo-yeon begins to open up to Ki-jung, who, despite his awkwardness, is always bright and caring. However, Ye-rim, trying to break up the relationship between Ki-jung and Woo-yeon, asks Woo-yeon to join the "Spirit Fingers" gathering.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Ye-rim follows Woo-yeon to a "Spirit Fingers" gathering. Woo-yeon is deeply disturbed by the sight of Ki-jeong and Ye-rim's affectionate couple pose. However, Ki-jeong, oblivious to Woo-yeon's true feelings, finds Woo-yeon unfazed. Then, Sera and Mirae, who happen to run into the triplets who have been bullying Woo-yeon, engage in a heated fight. Woo-yeon receives a call that the two are at the police station and rushes to them...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Woo-yeon and Ki-jeong finally confirm their feelings for each other. Despite the difficulties of their relationship, Ki-jeong finds nothing but happiness in their time together. Meanwhile, Seon-ho and Green also confirm their feelings for each other and enjoy a sweet yet thrilling CC life. Just when they thought their future was all about happiness, an unexpected crisis looms...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: After hearing Woodol's words, Ki-jeong resolves to be a boyfriend Woo-yeon can be proud of. He then receives a casting offer from an entertainment agency, which Ki-jeong accepts. Meanwhile, Seon-ho's sudden appearance in Green's life puts him on edge, and a chill begins to settle between them. Meanwhile, Woo-yeon visits Ki-jeong's workplace and, upon seeing her unfamiliar appearance, feels a strange sensation...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Wooyeon feels jealous of Kijung, who shines so brightly without effort, a stark contrast to herself. He hates and loathes himself for this, yet finds Kijung uncomfortable, so he avoids her. To make matters worse, Wooyeon's mother catches him attending a Spirit Fingers meeting, and he's grounded. Meanwhile, Seonho and Green struggle to open up to each other, and misunderstandings mount...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Woo-dol's runaway leaves Woo-yeon's house in chaos. Ki-jeong rescues Woo-dol and Bong-gu from near-critical injury, and Woo-yeon's family and Ki-jeong meet at the hospital. Meanwhile, Green heads to see his first love, Heo Je-ro, to resolve their marriage... What will be the outcome of Woo-yeon and Ki-jeong's love? Will Seon-ho and Green have a happy ending? This is the final story of young people, each with their own struggles to find their own unique identity, each with their own worries!

title: Way Back Love
overview: The Grim Reaper appears as the person you love the most before you die. In front of 24-year-old Hee Wan who had no will to carry on and lived as a social outcast, her childhood friend as well as her first love Ram Woo appears as a Grim Reaper and tells her she will die in a week. Hee Wan and Ram Woo are forced to spend a week together. Throughout their time together, they rediscover the meaning of life and reconnect with what truly matters.

episodeGuide.title: April Fools' Day
episodeGuide.summary: Jung Hee-wan is a feisty high school girl. Kim Ram-woo is a transfer student to Eunsung High School. On April Fools' Day, their classmates decide to swap names for a day, and Ram-woo and Hee-wan swap their names. After swapping their names, Hee-wan has her best day. She feels like swapping names with Ram-woo brings her luck, so she wants to keep swapping their names.

episodeGuide.title: One Last Week
episodeGuide.summary: Ram-woo died four years ago. And four years later, he goes to Hee-wan as a grim reaper and tells her that she will die in a week. Hee-wan can't believe what she sees and hears and refuses to talk to Ram-woo. As Hee-wan is lethargic and wants to do nothing before she dies, Ram-woo suggests that Hee-wan complete his bucket list together.

episodeGuide.title: Shooting Stars
episodeGuide.summary: Ram-woo and Hee-wan share many memories. Hoping to make her feel better and encourage her to stop isolating herself from the outside world, Ram-woo drags Hee-wan to her college. However, Hee-wan feels unbothered and wants to push Ram-woo away.

episodeGuide.title: Painful Memories
episodeGuide.summary: Hee-wan cries and tells Ram-woo that she couldn't forgive herself and that the past memories alone give her enough pain. She wants to quit completing the bucket list with Ram-woo. Meanwhile, Hee-wan goes to see Hong-seok. However, Hong-seok doesn't seem happy to see her.

episodeGuide.title: Unsolved Problem
episodeGuide.summary: Hee-wan goes to Ho-gyeong and asks about Jeong-suk's whereabouts, but she refuses to tell Hee-wan. Hee-wan really wants to see Jeong-suk and tells her the truth that Ram-woo's death was her fault, and that it was not because of Jeong-suk. However, Ram-woo thinks Hee-wan should move on and stop feeling guilty.

episodeGuide.title: One Day Left
episodeGuide.summary: Although she wastes most of her week, Hee-wan still has one more day to say goodbye to the world. She prepares gifts for Hee-ju and her father. With Ram-woo, Hee-wan wants to go on a typical, predictable date with him. Meanwhile, Hee-wan keeps getting calls from Yeong-hyeon.

title: The Queen Who Crowns
overview: Queen Won Kyung, born to Min Je during the Goryeo period, came from a prestigious family of high-ranking officials. Married to Lee Bang Won, son of King Taejo, she supported her husband's ambitions to become King Taejong after his father bypassed him for the throne. As a kingmaker, she helped establish a new regime. However, their relationship soured after Lee Bang Won became king, took concubines, and sought to curb Queen Won Kyung's influence and that of her family.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: A banquet is held to celebrate Bangwon's coronation, and Won-gyeong and Bangwon rejoice, confirming that they have had a strong love and trust for each other up until this point. However, when Yeong-sil, who secretly raised Bangwon's child during his time as a concubine, appears, the trust between the couple cracks, and this issue escalates into a subject's problem opposing the king's authority.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Yeong-sil, who believed in the king's favor, is rude to Won-gyeong, and Won-gyeong feels greatly insulted. Furthermore, when the woman Bang-won takes again is Chae-ryeong, the woman Won-gyeong trusted, Won-gyeong's emotions finally explode, and he ends up refusing to marry the king... When Lee Seong-gye tries to kill Bang-won with a hammer, Won-gyeong puts aside his feelings of resentment and instinctively steps forward to save Bang-won.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: In the process of saving himself, Bang-won feels passionately toward his wife Won-gyeong, who gets hit with a hammer instead. However, he feels a sense of crisis due to the information power of the Min clan, who knew about this fact in advance, and while watching their movements, Won-gyeong detects the movement to restore the former king. If he informs Bang-won of this fact, Won-gyeong and the Min clan will be faced with a dilemma as it will be revealed that they disobeyed the king's order...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Thanks to Won-gyeong's efforts, the movement to restore the former king is completely defeated, but Yeong-sil is unexpectedly involved. Bang-won tries to protect Yeong-sil, the concubine who is implicated in the treason, even breaking his principles. Won-gyeong feels a great shock, betrayal, and jealousy at Bang-won's attitude. Won-gyeong is the head of the palace concubine who has the power to save Yeong-sil. Instead of asking Won-gyeong for a regrettable favor, Bang-won tries to turn the situation around by abandoning Yeong-sil...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: In order to be wary of the Min clan who are confident and trusting in the queen's achievements, Bang-won even sets up a wedding ceremony to bring in a concubine. Won-gyeong and Bang-won continue to have extreme conflicts over this issue. Meanwhile, Chae-ryeong, who has sensed the king's loneliness, approaches Bang-won more actively and eventually becomes pregnant.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Finally, when the investigation team causes trouble and Bang-won goes on a campaign, Won-gyeong puts aside her resentment toward Bang-won, realizes her passionate love for him, and mobilizes her intelligence and everything she has to help Bang-won. In her negotiations with Lee Seong-gye, Bang-won promises one thing. He will cut off the vested interests based in Gaegyeong and return to Hanyang. However, the core of those vested interests includes Won-gyeong's maternal family, the Min family.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: After returning to Hanyang, Bangwon devoted himself to stabilizing the royal authority and taking care of the people. One day, he received a request for a princess from the Ming Dynasty. Won-gyeong incited his officials to pressure Bangwon, saying that he could not send the princess, and he resolved the issue under his own responsibility. When the Min clan tried to expand their power by trusting the queen, Bangwon tried to break through by declaring that he would abdicate to Crown Prince Yangnyeong…

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Under the belief that an unprepared regent could endanger the crown prince's life, Won-gyeong confronts Bang-won and withdraws his intention to abdicate. Meanwhile, after the return of the capital to Hanyang, when the secret real estate speculation of the powerful families hinders state affairs, Bang-won takes special measures. However, Won-gyeong's younger brothers are among the speculators. This puts Won-gyeong in danger...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Bang-won tries to choose the crown princess for political reasons, but Won-gyeong argues that it is right to prioritize qualifications. In the end, Won-gyeong makes the process of choosing the crown princess public, thereby breaking the king's will. Chae-ryeong finds out the whereabouts of Pan-su, who has been Won-gyeong's informant for a long time, and informs Bang-won. Bang-won decides to use this as a means to weaken Won-gyeong's power...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Won-gyeong, who disobeyed the king's orders and left the palace to collect Pan-su's body, finds out that some of the king's relatives have been embezzling the grain and wealth the king had given to the people. He tries to tell Bang-won about this, but he is caught in an unexpected plot and not only does he lose the deposed queen, but his life is also threatened... With the help of the people, Won-gyeong returns to Hanyang and tells Bang-won all of the facts... This incident serves as an opportunity for Bang-won to recall that Won-gyeong had the same dream as him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Apart from his love for Won-gyeong, Bang-won ordered the death of the queen's younger siblings who were already political obstacles. Won-gyeong, although feeling bloody, tries to understand and accept Bang-won, the king of Joseon, rather than his personal feelings. However, he can never treat Bang-won with the same feelings as before. As Prince Seongnyeong dies together, the two regain their trust as a couple before becoming kings... The last task for them is to replace the crown prince.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Bangwon, who believes that Crown Prince Yangnyeong's qualifications are lacking but can be improved upon, eventually decides to depose Yangnyeong, accepting Won-gyeong's advice that a king who lacks qualifications should be replaced because he is endangering the people. Won-gyeong makes Chungnyeong reveal his vision to his father directly, providing the basis for Bangwon to decide on Chungnyeong as the crown prince... As soon as he ascends the throne, Chungnyeong establishes the foundation for the great Joseon Dynasty that his mother, Queen Wongyeong, had dreamed of so much and makes it blossom.

title: The Good Man
overview: Seok-cheol, the eldest son in a family of three generations of gangsters, navigates the tumultuous ups and downs of life with tears and laughter, all to protect his family, career, and love.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol dreamed to be a poet but became a gangster. When his sister's gambling debt risks their home, she left home. He's determined to find her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol saves Seokkyung, but she doesn't want to return home. Seokcheol then oversees a site job where a fire breaks out putting Jinho in danger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol quits the gang after the project ends. Miyoung fails her audition. Seokcheol asks Taehoon for help. Taehoon's scheme lands Changsoo in jail.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Miyoung sings beautifully at Nilvana and grows close to Seokcheol. Taehoon sees her show and likes her. Changsoo guides Seokcheol to handle Taehoon.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Miyoung rejects Taehoon. Seokcheol refuses to eliminate Taehoon. Their clash escalates when Taehoon discovers Miyoung has feelings for Seokcheol.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol's proud as Miyoung nears her dream. His retirement's at risk for Changsoo's gang's loss. Taehoon returns, threatening Miyoung to meet him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Taehoon mistakenly thinks Seokcheol tried to kill him. Miyoung learns Taehoon's link to the agency's offer. Seokcheol unexpectedly sees their meet-up.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol and Miyoung profess love by the sea. Seokkyung sneaks out to earn cash from Jeongnim so she can secretly pay off her debt.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Taehoon hesitates to eliminate Seokcheol. Seokcheol is offered leadership. Sangyeol, the second-in-command of the gang, feels betrayed and jealous.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Taehoon's gang raids Changsoo's club; Seokcheol survives a crash caused by Taehoon. Miyoung leaves Seokcheol after threats from Taehoon.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Miyoung mourns her mother. Seokcheol comforts her, reigniting love. Meanwhile, Sangyeol plots to take over both gangs and go after Seokcheol.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol is framed as a traitor. Taehoon meets with Seokcheol and he's attacked. Seokcheol escapes with Miyoung but a hitman appears and stops that.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: After coming back to life, Seokcheol introduces Miyoung to his family. He then confronts the one who tried to kill him and gets his own justice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: Seokcheol turns himself in and ends the relationship with Miyoung after his revenge. Some time later, he hears Miyoung's debut song while in jail.

title: 24 Health Club
overview: Do Hyeon-joong was once the star of "Mr. David," the premier bodybuilding competition in the U.S.—until he vanished without a trace. Now he's running a shabby 24-hour gym. After a terrible first night with her boyfriend, followed by an even worse breakup, Mi-ran signs up for Hyeon-joong's expensive personal-training plan, desperate to reboot her life. As Mi-ran fights to get fit and find herself again, Hyeon-joong's own world heads in unexpected directions. Can Hyun-joong prove himself as a rookie gym owner, and will Mi-ran rediscover her spark? Their sweaty, heart-warming reboot begins now.

episodeGuide.title: When Muscles Meet Meltdowns
episodeGuide.summary: Do Hyun Joong, a fallen bodybuilding star, now manages a rundown 24-hour gym. Lee Mi Ran, fresh off a breakup, mistakes it for a nightclub and ends up humiliated. Hyun Joong offers to transform her life through intense training, but his brutal honesty drives her away. Still, his words hit a nerve. Can Hyun Joong change heartbroken Mi Ran's life and save the crumbling gym?

episodeGuide.title: Heartbreak Bootcamp
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-ran sets out on a gruelling fitness journey to win back her ex, and the entire gym gets caught up in her mission. Hyun-joong sees a spark of potential in her, pushing her even harder. But is it for her sake or the gym's survival? As every rep tests her spirit, Mi-ran must confront what she's really fighting for.

episodeGuide.title: Mi Ran’s Training Crumbles
episodeGuide.summary: Mi Ran's intense training program falls apart and goes to waste after she breaks down in front of her ex-boyfriend. Despite achieving some results, including fitting into an undersized dress, Mi Ran quits the gym and demands a refund, leaving Hyun Joong frustrated. Meanwhile, Hyun Joong puts everything on the line to attract 120,000 new members to the gym, determined to turn the struggling gym around.

episodeGuide.title: Pushed Too Far
episodeGuide.summary: Ro Sa gets suddenly pulled from all duties at the 24-Hour Health Club, shocking staff and members alike. While rumors swirl about her departure, she's pushed toward competing in the "Nabbi Women's Fitness Championship," ready or not. Meanwhile, tensions rise as Hyun Joong's over-the-top training gets her injured, and Mi Ran escapes to the gym to avoid her mother.

episodeGuide.title: Parenting and Diet, Ready to Explode!
episodeGuide.summary: Mi Ran starts cutting out flour and becomes increasingly irritable, and Hyun Joong struggles with the exhaustion of balancing parenting and work. Tension grows between Hyun Joong and Mi Ran as they fail to understand each other's hardships, and their relationship gets pushed to the limit when all their built-up frustration explodes.

episodeGuide.title: Learning to Let Go
episodeGuide.summary: Mi Ran breaks the treadmill at the gym, so Hyun Joong starts offering personal training himself to make more money to get a new treadmill. Sung Im signs up for the PT session with Hyun Joong, and she starts pestering him all the time. Later, Hyun Joong finds out the reason why Sung Im had to stay at the gym all the time. Meanwhile, Mi Ran breaks down after seeing a glimpse of her ex.

episodeGuide.title: Broken Routines, Buried Wounds
episodeGuide.summary: Mi Ran tries to move on from heartbreak by tossing out the past, emotionally and physically. She gives up working out, but Hyun Joong notices her slump and gently tries to help her bounce back incessantly. But in his effort to motivate her, he unintentionally reopens old wounds. Their miscommunication deepens, threatening to unravel what little progress they've made.

episodeGuide.title: Ulterior Motive
episodeGuide.summary: A famous influencer, Kang Sol, registers at Hyun Joong's gym, helping the gym to get more members. Hyun Joong isn't glad to see her as she's his ex, and he can't help but think she has an ulterior motive. Sol becomes friends with Mi Ran, and she sets her up on a blind date. After a few dates, Mi Ran realizes her feelings toward Hyun Joong are too strong to meet someone new.

episodeGuide.title: The Heart's Heavy Lift
episodeGuide.summary: The health camp Mi Ran hoped would bring her closer to Manager Do takes a dramatic turn with surprising news about his connection to Sol, but a far more profound truth emerges when Sol confronts a serious personal challenge. Amidst the romantic misadventures, a story of quiet courage unfolds, reshaping everyone's perspectives. The real tests are rarely physical.

episodeGuide.title: Hyun Joong’s Absence
episodeGuide.summary: Hyun Joong disappears without a trace, and members of the gym are determined to guard the gym until he comes back. Mi Ran tirelessly searches every place Hyun Joong might have gone. Amid the collective effort to save the gym, Ro Sa hears something utterly devastating. Meanwhile, Ji Ran is having a hard time getting over Dan.

episodeGuide.title: Flirting Fails Fatally
episodeGuide.summary: After idyllic tteokbokki outings, Mi Ran is bewildered when Hyun Joong suddenly gives her the cold shoulder. Her disastrous attempts to rekindle their connection only make things worse, leading to a painful confrontation. Now, Hyun Joong must decide if Mi Ran is a distraction or his destiny.

episodeGuide.title: Muscle-Pumping Romantic Love
episodeGuide.summary: Hyun Joong and Mi Ran begin a secret romance. Hyun Joong expresses his love in his own quirky way, and Mi Ran starts to find his oddness endearing. With the gym building falling apart and water leaking everywhere, Hyun Joong faces pressure as the landlord shrugs off responsibility and tells him to deal with it or move out.

title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
overview: At his uncle's funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn't seen in years. It turns out Iljo's struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn't keen on dating him, but somehow, he's a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. Is this a love story in the making, or a disaster waiting to happen?

title: No Mercy
overview: When a voice phishing scam destroys her family, struggling actress So Min dives into the underworld of deepfake technology to seek revenge. Armed with forged identities and nothing to lose, she infiltrates a powerful crime syndicate—crossing paths with a power-hungry boss, a conflicted cop, and a charmingly dangerous hacker. But as the lies stack up, the question remains: will she bring them down, or be consumed by the very deception she wields?

episodeGuide.title: The Lost Mother, the Stolen Voice
episodeGuide.summary: Ha So-min, an unknown actress, is stuck running errands while dreaming of her lead debut. But her life collapses when her mother is struck by Ma Seok-gu's car while buying flowers for her and is abducted for his own schemes. Desperate, So-min and her father search endlessly, until she crosses paths with Detective Park Jeong-hun, a former classmate who discovers Seok-gu's link to the case, just as her father's shock drives him into a devastating choice.

episodeGuide.title: Mother's Death and the Evil Deeds of the Ilseongpa
episodeGuide.summary: After her father's death, Ha So-min receives a call in her mother Kim Mi-yang's voice. However, So-min soon realizes that the one behind the phone is Ma Seok-gu using voice technology. Searching for clues, she finds an SOS from Mi-yang and chases a mysterious woman. As secrets unravel, So-min learns that Mi-yang's voice is being exploited by a phishing ring. Consumed by grief and rage, she vows revenge, joining forces with Detective Park Jeong-hun and turning to deepfake herself for a strike.

episodeGuide.title: So-min's Disguise, the Beginning of Infiltration
episodeGuide.summary: When So-min learns that the Ilseongpa is planning to send the Yongsinje event staff to a Chinese call center, she seizes the opportunity to disguise herself and sneak into the Ilseongpa captain's house. Sensing that Jeong-hun will return to his police officer role and intervene, she confesses her lies to President Kim and makes a new proposal.

episodeGuide.title: The beginning of a game of deception and deception
episodeGuide.summary: Unlike the call center, Somin, known as the luxurious Ilseongpa stronghold, catches Seokgu's eye thanks to her overwhelming skills. Seokgu senses a familiarity yet a strangeness in her, and becomes suspicious of her identity. However, Somin exposes the Heungsam-i faction's spy, averting the crisis and earning Seokgu's trust.

episodeGuide.title: Identity Crisis and New Proposals
episodeGuide.summary: So-min, whose identity is almost exposed due to the ticket for "The Woman from Yanbian," lies to Seok-gu even more brazenly and proposes that they recruit Mason to "Genie the Star" to secure the business rights. Then, she introduces Mason's close associate, Eric Choi, aka Jeong-hoon, to Seok-gu, and So-min and Jeong-hoon's joint operation begins.

episodeGuide.title: Somin's escape and Jeonghoon's new plan
episodeGuide.summary: So-min, anxious about the presence of a man with a tattoo of the Ilseongpa faction, attempts to meet Jeong-hoon. However, she witnesses Jeong-hoon being kidnapped by the Ilseongpa faction and, while chasing him, loses him. She then receives a phone call from Seok-gu threatening, "If you don't return the money, I will kill Jeong-hoon."

episodeGuide.title: Jung-hoon's kidnapping and Seok-gu's blackmail
episodeGuide.summary: So-min, who is trapped in an abandoned warehouse, despairs when he learns that Jung-hoon was on the same page as the Ilseong faction. Jung-hoon uses Seok-gu's cell phone to lure his entourage, and together with Doo-sik's spy Yoo Seung-seung, he recovers Seok-gu's slush funds and becomes loyal to Doo-sik. Helpless, Seok-gu succumbs to Doo-sik and gives up all power.

episodeGuide.title: The End of the Ilseongpa and the Liberation of the People
episodeGuide.summary: So-min is on the brink of death, and the arrival of a new ally and a surprise attack by Jeong-hoon, the police, and the Public Security Bureau turn the tables. Seok-gu is stabbed to death after a fierce confrontation with So-min. After the Ilseong faction is completely wiped out and the corrupt faction is brought to justice, So-min, having completed her sentence, finally breaks down in tears after cleaning the memorial tablets of Mi-yang and Hyeon-jin and watching a video letter left by her mother

title: Love, Take Two
overview: Lee Ji Ahn has built her life on strength, dignity, and quiet resilience as a single mother. But everything shifts when her grown daughter, now a med student, stages a late rebellion-and Ji Ahn nexpectedly reconnects with her first love, Ryu Jung Suk. As mother and daughter navigate personal turning points, they discover something neither expected: the right to choose joy, love, and themselves -this time around. Not every love story happens in your twenties.

episodeGuide.title: Hyo-ri’s Runaway
episodeGuide.summary: Hyo-ri drives her drunk mother home after another get-together. Tired and angry, Hyo-ri says she'll never live like her. Ji-an needs to pay Hyo-ri's tuition, but her acquaintance hasn't repaid the 30,000 dollars she owes. As the tuition deadline approaches, Ji-an calls Hyo-ri's university to confirm the date, but she hears something she didn't expect.

episodeGuide.title: Fate or Coincidence
episodeGuide.summary: The boss tells Ji-an she must take responsibility for the audit issue and leave the company. Feeling guilty for not being there when Hyo-ri needed her most, Ji-an promises that she will stay by Hyo-ri's side and protect her from now on. On her way to see Hyo-ri, Ji-an unexpectedly runs into an old crush from years ago.

episodeGuide.title: When Something Starts to Grow
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-an begs Jeong-seok to renovate the house together, but Jeong-seok tells her he absolutely doesn't want to. However, Jeong-seok finds it difficult to completely ignore Ji-an's request. Hyo-ri calls Seon-yeong and tells her to take Ji-an to Seoul. While working together at the flower farm, everything seemed beautiful to Bo-hyeon, as if he had fallen for Hyo-ri.

episodeGuide.title: Unspoken Feelings
episodeGuide.summary: Hyo-ri shares with Seon-yeong her worries about how to break the news of her illness to Suk. Seon-yeong comforts her, saying that since it's Suk, she will understand Hyo-ri's feelings without saying a word. Meanwhile, Jeong-seok and Ji-an head to Seoul to meet the field team and also to check out Ji-an's house.

episodeGuide.title: The Woman with the Suitcase
episodeGuide.summary: An old woman appears and claims to be Ji-an's mother. Ji-an says her mother died more than 20 years ago. Still, when she sees the woman carrying the same suitcase her mother once had, she feels unsettled. Yet the strange woman appears again at Ji-an's home, scolding her just like a mother would. Then, an unexpected accident breaks out in the house.

episodeGuide.title: The Wound Mun-hui Hides
episodeGuide.summary: Hyo-ri is taken to the hospital, and Jeong-seok is concerned that Ji-an might have been shocked. Out of the blue, Bo-hyeon's mother is back, and Bo-hyeon and Jeong-seok are uncomfortable with her around them. At the hospital, Ji-an runs into Mun-hui by chance, and an unexpected encounter unravels secrets about her identity and family.

episodeGuide.title: Yeo-jeong’s Warning
episodeGuide.summary: On the grand opening day of Nature's Masterpiece, Seon-yeong and Ji-an's restaurant launch is met with great success. In the middle of the celebration, Yeo-jeong makes her presence felt. With a sharp tone, she says she is uncomfortable with Jeong-seok being too close to Ji-an. Meanwhile, Hyo-ri confesses her condition to Bo-hyeon.

episodeGuide.title: Life without Your Dearest
episodeGuide.summary: Hyo-ri drives her drunk mother home after another get-together. Tired and angry, Hyo-ri says she'll never live like her. Ji-an needs to pay Hyo-ri's tuition, but her acquaintance hasn't repaid the 30,000 dollars she owes. As the tuition deadline approaches, Ji-an calls Hyo-ri's university to confirm the date, but she hears something she didn't expect.

episodeGuide.title: When I Feel Love For the First Time
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo-jeong asks Ji-an to help her reconnect with Jeong-seok and Bo-hyeon, which puts Ji-an in a difficult position. Ji-an decides to give up on Jeong-seok on one condition - that Yeo-jeong properly apologise for what she did to Jeong-seok in Germany. Meanwhile, Suk comes to visit Hyo-ri in Cheonghae and has it out with So-yeon once and for all.

episodeGuide.title: Spring, And…
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-oh goes to see his mom, thanks to Seon-yeong's help, and he finds out what his mom's been hiding from him. Hyo-ri goes on an overnight trip with Bo-hyeon, and so do Ji-an and Jeong-seok. After the mother and daughter's happy trips, Ji-an receives news that Hyo-ri's surgery has been moved up, and she hopes her daughter's surgery will bring them spring again.

episodeGuide.title: To You Who Resembles Me
episodeGuide.summary: Hyo-ri's surgery date gets moved up, and the residents of Cheonghae offer comfort and support to Hyo-ri and Ji-an in their own ways. Jeong-seok reassures Hyo-ri that he will stay by Ji-an's side, no matter what happens. Meanwhile, Ji-an tells Jeong-seok who the birthmother of Hyo-ri was and how Hyo-ri was raised.

episodeGuide.title: To All of Our First Love
episodeGuide.summary: Before her surgery, Hyo-ri confesses to her mom that she is the best kind of mother she could ever had. After Hyo-ri returns from surgery, Bo-hyeon tells her he wants to go study in Germany. Inspired by what Bo-hyeon said, Hyo-ri decides to pursue studying medicine.

title: Dear Hongrang
overview: When a long-missing heir returns with lost memories, love and suspicion entwine. Is he truly Hongrang, or a stranger disturbing hearts and family ties?

episodeGuide.title: Rainbow Hong, Shining Rang - My Brother Hongrang
episodeGuide.summary: Twelve years after Sim Hongrang's sudden disappearance, a man seeming to be him appears — passing all the tests. Yet Sim Jae-yi remains unconvinced.

episodeGuide.title: The One Who Stole Our World
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yi and Hongrang separately search for a ghost rumored to be abducting children. In their search, peril strikes Jae-yi — but Hongrang is at her rescue.

episodeGuide.title: The Most Authentic Replica
episodeGuide.summary: After Hongrang's act of heroism, Jae-yi begins to question her doubts. Sim Mu-jin schemes to expose Hongrang's identity at his birthday celebration.

episodeGuide.title: Our Reflective Scars
episodeGuide.summary: Learning of Min Yeon-ui's plans, Sim Yeol-guk devises a counterattack. Hongrang struggles with his conscience after being assigned a terrible task.

episodeGuide.title: The Thicker the Veil, the Clearer the Heart
episodeGuide.summary: As she learns more about Hongrang's past, Jae-yi begins to care for him. Later, Hongrang and Mu-jin suspect Lady Min's scheme to marry Jae-yi off.

episodeGuide.title: Nothing Mu, Finished Jin - Brother Mu-jin
episodeGuide.summary: As plans to stop Jae-yi's arrangement fail, she finds herself in a dangerous bind. The opposition between Yeol-guk and Yeon-ui reaches a boiling point.

episodeGuide.title: Roaring Waves
episodeGuide.summary: As Mu-jin's fate remains dire, Jae-yi attempts to do whatever it takes to save him. Later, news of a dead child returning spreads, alarming Hongrang.

episodeGuide.title: Imperfect Jae, Departing Yi - My Name is Jae-yi
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-yi decides to leave with Mu-jin despite her feelings for Hongrang. Yeol-guk initiates damage control after discovering a conspiracy against him.

episodeGuide.title: The Living Offering
episodeGuide.summary: A manhunt for Hongrang and Jae-yi ensues, putting them in grave danger. As they hide, their bond deepens, facing threats and challenges together.

episodeGuide.title: A Bittersweet Farewell
episodeGuide.summary: With Hongrang captured, Yeol-guk attempts to restore the guild in his name. But Grand Prince Hanpyeong wastes no time putting his grand plan into motion.

episodeGuide.title: Forever and After
episodeGuide.summary: The truth about Hongrang is revealed, but enemies remain. In the end, will he be able to save Jae-yi and free himself from the shackles of his past?

title: Peach Trap
overview: At that moment when Yoo Do Ha is in the biggest crisis of his life, three men approach him! He gets caught up in a storm of love signals with each of the three men. Even at the same time! A whirlwind of fate that centers around Do Ha. Who will the final love stick be directed towards?! A cheerful and lively romantic comedy depicting the process of finding a boyfriend.

title: Surely Tomorrow
overview: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships.
