A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyungdo now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Entertainment reporter Kyeong-do reports on an affair and drug scandal involving an actress and a chaebol's son-in-law. The problem is, the man in question happens to be the husband of his unforgettable first love. Because of one article, Kyeong-do and Ji-woo come face to face for the first time in ten years. Now, neither of them wants to get entangled again.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: After Jiwoo's divorce story breaks, Kyeong-do becomes caught up in a scandal himself. With help from his friends, he manages to publish a rebuttal article. However, at the request of Ji-woo's older sister, Ji-yeon, he ends up getting involved with Ji-woo once again.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Kyeong-do stops Ji-woo just as she is about to leave the country, and the two unexpectedly begin living together. Ji-woo comes to face the truth about Kyeong-do's treatment for alcoholism and the secrets she and her mother have been hiding.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Kyeong-do takes Ji-woo to the hospital after she collapses from drinking. The painful memories from their first breakup come rushing back to him. Meanwhile, Min-woo meets Director Choi and makes a dangerous deal.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Jin-eon steps back in response to Kyeong-do's flirting. Kyeong-do then settles into Ji-woo's home, insisting he will stay close and take care of her alcoholism.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Kyeong-do ultimately gives up his training program in Chicago. Meanwhile, Ji-woo learns the secret between Ji-yeon and Kyeong-do. Now Ji-woo must decide what to do.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: The two finally confirm their feelings for each other. However, Jin-eon still seems to have lingering feelings for Ji-woo. Meanwhile, Kyeong-do hears a shocking story about Min-woo from Ji-yeon.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: After discovering dangerous substances in the coffee brought by the secretary, Kyeong-do warns Ji-yeon not to consume it. When Ji-woo finally returns to the company, she makes bold moves from the very start.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-woo heads to Málaga with Kyeong-do to meet luxury designer Bella Jin. However, when they finally meet, Bella Jin rejects Ji-woo's proposal.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yeon's dementia symptoms grow more severe, which affects Jarim Apparel. Determined to protect her sister and the company, Ji-woo makes a major decision, and Kyeong-do fights alongside her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: A fabricated divorce? Another scandal erupts involving Kyeong-do and Ji-woo. Now Kyeong-do must prepare the most heartbreaking rebuttal article of his career.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: After exposing Min-woo's misdeeds to the world, Kyeong-do decides to leave Ji-woo's side for her sake. The two must face yet another separation. Where will the end of this love lead them now?

title: Heroes Next Door
overview: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but solely to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

episodeGuide.title: Hasn't Even Served in the Military
episodeGuide.summary: Choi Kang, a new resident of Changri-dong, clashes with youth president Kwak Byeong-nam over recycling issues. He then pursues a suspicious foreigner to clear up a misunderstanding, only to be threatened. During the chase, an unexpected incident unfolds.

episodeGuide.title: Butane Gas, My Ass
episodeGuide.summary: Choi Kang is suspected of being a spy after a clash with a foreigner of unknown nationality. While tracking the foreigner's secrets with Kwak Byung-nam and Lee Yong-hee, he discovers an unexpected clue. This clue connects to Choi Kang's past.

episodeGuide.title: My Bestie's Bestie is My Bestie Too
episodeGuide.summary: A series of mysterious incidents unfold in Changri-dong. Choi Kang, Kwak Byeong-nam, and Lee Yong-hee begin to investigate the truth behind the incidents. The military attempts to cover up the situation, and someone is quietly watching the whole situation unfold.

episodeGuide.title: What Brings You to Our Town?
episodeGuide.summary: A video of Kim In-seop exposing the incident goes viral, but no one raises suspicions. Park Jeong-hwan and Jeong Nam-yeon join Choi Kang, Park Byeong-nam, and Lee Yong-hee to uncover the truth behind the incident, and armed forces kidnap Kim In-seop.

episodeGuide.title: Are We Strangers?
episodeGuide.summary: Choi Kang learns of the mastermind behind Kim In-seop's kidnapping and, with Kwak Byeong-nam's help, rescues Kim In-seop and takes him to safety. Kwak Byeong-nam, Jeong Nam-yeon, Lee Yong-hee, and Park Jeong-hwan gather there.

episodeGuide.title: Heroes Next Door (1)
episodeGuide.summary: A crisis befalls the special forces tracking down clues to Kim In-seop's kidnapping. Their best efforts narrowly save their lives. The recovered evidence reveals a surprising truth, and someone appears before Hwang Mi-kyung and Do-yeon.

episodeGuide.title: Heroes Next Door (2)
episodeGuide.summary: Changri-dong, facing a crisis due to the continued pursuit of our neighborhood special forces, is saved by Kim Soo-il's unexpected intervention. Meanwhile, Choi Kang discovers the true mastermind behind the incident.

episodeGuide.title: A Whistle for the Bad Guy

title: My Secret Vampire
overview: When innocent country boy, Dongha, shows up at a mysterious vampire house, his life takes a thrilling turn.

title: Second Shot at Love
overview: A story about a woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness. Han Geum Joo is a mechanic who becomes a public servant at a large company because she loves cars. She was called a "woman who drinks better than men," but when she is given another title of "alcoholic," Geum Joo decides to challenge herself by "abstaining from drinking." Seo Ui Joon is a doctor who was on a roll as a specialist at a prestigious university hospital in Seoul but ended up moving down to the rural village of Bocheon Health Center. He believes that alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic and can ruin your life, and he will likely get involved with Geum Joo, who has been given the title of "alcoholic".

episodeGuide.title: An Unwelcome Reunion
episodeGuide.summary: Geum-ju calls off her wedding. Geum-ju's mother, Gwang-ok is upset because of Geum-ju. Pushed by her mother's pressure, Geum-ju heads to Bocheon. The whole village is abuzz with the news of Geum-ju's broken engagement. In Bocheon, Geum-ju runs into someone she'd rather not see.

episodeGuide.title: Quit Drinking, Geum Ju
episodeGuide.summary: The entire town is thrown into panic by Geum-ju's sudden disappearance. Gwang-ok warns people that anyone who sells alcohol to her family will no longer be able to do business with her. With alcohol banned, her family members start going crazy. Meanwhile, Geum-ju pays dearly for hurting Ui-jun, the precious doctor of the town.

episodeGuide.title: There's a Reason I'm Drunk
episodeGuide.summary: Ui-jun suggests that Geum-ju take an alcohol dependence test. Seon-wook teaches taekwondo to Hyun-joo so she can relieve her stress. Geum-ju, Hyun-joo, and Jung-soo's secret drinking does not escape Gwang-ok's notice, and they are forced to go to the Sobriety Camp held at a temple.

episodeGuide.title: Blackout
episodeGuide.summary: Geum-ju, Hyun-joo, and Jung-soo fail to quit drinking. Ui-jun lectures at the county office about alcoholism, and Geum-ju, Hyun-joo, and Jung-soo are forced to attend the lecture by Gwang-ok. Time passes, and the day of the wedding Geum-ju once called off finally arrives.

episodeGuide.title: The Reason I Cut You Off
episodeGuide.summary: A medical checkup reveals how much damage alcohol has done to their bodies, so Geum-ju, Hyun-joo, and Jung-soo decide to stop drinking right away. Ui-jun promises to grant Geum-ju's wishes if she manages to stay off alcohol for a week. But soon, a challenge emerges that puts Geum-ju's strong determination to the test.

episodeGuide.title: Withdrawal Symptoms
episodeGuide.summary: Geum-ju loses sleep at night after Ui-jun confesses his old feelings to her. Seon-wook admits to Hyun-joo that he tried to bury his feelings, but he can't anymore. Geum-ju, Hyun-joo, and Jung-soo undergo withdrawal symptoms. Meanwhile, Gwang-ok says she's going to Seoul to take some time for herself, leaving her family surprised.

episodeGuide.title: First Kiss
episodeGuide.summary: It's only now that Geum-ju's family comes to understand the true reason behind her broken engagement, and the truth leaves them filled with regret. With the townspeople, her family, and friends on her side, Geum-ju feels stronger than ever. Meanwhile, Geum-ju goes back to her job at the company.

episodeGuide.title: Alcohol-Free Romance
episodeGuide.summary: Geum-ju and Ui-jun enjoy some sweet, quiet moments together, but their secret doesn't stay hidden for long. Someone in the village spots them. Hyun-joo finds herself torn over Seon-wook's unexpected proposal: just three dates, no strings attached. Meanwhile, Seon-hwa is still barking up the wrong tree, convinced Seon-wook has feelings for Geum-ju.

episodeGuide.title: Please Take Care of Mom
episodeGuide.summary: Geum-ju and Ui-jun end up going on a date at Daecheon Beach. There, they unexpectedly run into Hyeon-ju and Seon-wook, and the four of them end up spending a joyful time together. Hyun-joo and Seon-wook try to keep their romantic relationship a secret, but can they really keep it hidden? Meanwhile, Geum-ju gets promoted at work, and both Gwang-ok and Jung-soo are thrilled to hear the news. However, Gwang-ok starts complaining of fatigue and dizziness...

episodeGuide.title: Birthday, Happy End
episodeGuide.summary: After relentless effort and exercise, Geum-ju is finally able to donate her liver to her mother, Gwang-ok, but Gwang-ok strongly opposes the idea. To celebrate Ui-jun's birthday, Ui-jun and Geum-ju go on a trip and spend a wonderful, happy time together. However, Ui-jun suddenly leaves in a hurry, leaving only a note behind, and Geum-ju begins to worry. Meanwhile, Sun-hwa suggests to Hyun-joo that she go on a blind date with a divorced man, and Seon-wook finds out about this.

episodeGuide.title: Untold Truth
episodeGuide.summary: To celebrate Gwang Ok's discharge from the hospital, the villagers gather at her home, but the absence of Gi Beom's mom raises eyebrows. Meanwhile, Seon Uk discovers that Seon Hwa know about his relationship with Hyeon Ju all along, a revelation that leaves him reeling. Elsewhere, Ui Jun digs deeper into the true identities of Nurse Oh and Nurse Baek, only to find himself plunged into greater confusion. Also, he inches closer to uncovering the whereabouts of his father.

episodeGuide.title: Cheering on Love
episodeGuide.summary: Ui Jun is overwhelmed and unsure how to feel when a mother who he's never had in his life suddenly appears. Seon Uk suddenly disappears, leaving behind only a note saying he's going to Seoul to clear his head. Seon Hwa is left heartbroken and anxious. Meanwhile, despite ongoing efforts, the police have yet to locate Ui Jun's father.

title: As You Stood By
overview: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su
episodeGuide.summary: When a watch goes missing, Jo Eun-su spots a mysterious customer and boldly tracks him down. She then visits her mother, who shows troubling signs at home.

episodeGuide.title: Hui-su
episodeGuide.summary: Jo Hui-su endures years of relentless abuse from Noh Jin-pyo, despite attempts to escape. When she reaches a breaking point, Eun-su steps into action.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su, Hui-su and Jin-pyo
episodeGuide.summary: After witnessing Hui-su's mistreatment, Eun-su teams up with her to stop Jin-pyo — recruiting one of Jin So-baek's employees to execute their plan.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su and Hui-su
episodeGuide.summary: A confrontation with Jin-pyo forces Eun-su and Hui-su to hurry and cover their tracks. But in trying to be thorough, they navigate several obstacles.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su and Hui-su and Jin So-baek
episodeGuide.summary: With their problem seemingly over, Eun-su and Hui-su attempt to rebuild their lives. But trouble soon finds Eun-su — and So-baek unexpectedly appears.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su, Hui-su and Jang Kang
episodeGuide.summary: An unexpected visitor terrifies Hui-su, forcing her and Eun-su to handle a new crisis. Meanwhile, So-baek begins to question their strange behavior.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su, Hui-su and Jin-young
episodeGuide.summary: With Noh Jin-young on Eun-su and Hui-su's tails, So-baek offers his help. But Eun-su takes matters into her own hands, putting everyone in jeopardy.

episodeGuide.title: Eun-su, Hui-su and Us
episodeGuide.summary: Pressured by Jin-young, Hui-su does the unthinkable. Can Eun-su find a way out of their hellish situation and finally break the cycle?

title: Head Over Heels
overview: Park Seong A is a high school student, but, at night, she is a shaman named Fairy Cheon Ji. When she works as a shaman, she covers her face partially to hide her identity. She is famous as Fairy Cheon Ji and she is busy working with her clients who come to ask about their future, fortune, illnesses, and other things. One night, Bae Gyeon U and his mother come to visit Fairy Cheon Ji. Park Seong A has a crush on him at first sight, but she sees that he is destined to die soon. The next day, Bae Gyeon U appears in front of her as a new transfer student in her class. She decides to save him from his destiny.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Just when the high-schooler shaman Seong-a is getting bored with life, handsome Gyeon-u walks into her shrine upside-down. But he's destined to die?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-a hangs around Gyeon-u even when he's suspected of arson. Another fire breaks out, and Seong-a jumps into the flames. All for one reason!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-a's the only one by Gyeon-u's side at the funeral. Her mission as a human amulet begins! Holding hands, linking arms - all to fend off the evil!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: "Let's stay moist," Weird love confession, but the heart flutters! But what if Seong-a's biggest secret is tied with Gyeon-u's deepest wound?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Gyeon-U loses trust in Seong-A when he realizes she's something he hates the most. Seong-A loses her human amulet power and wounds open up.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-A finds out Yeomhwa relished Gyeon-U's suffering. Seong-A decides to take Yeomhwa head on to save Gyeon-U while he comes across her past online.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: What? Gyeon-U is an evil spirit? Bong-su takes over Gyeon-U's body, wreaking havoc. But Gyeon-U himself pops out whenever his hand touches Seong-A's!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Gyeon-U and Seong-A's relationship is a secret at school! The relationship's more exorcism than love, but at a crucial moment, he confesses his love!

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-A cheers Gyeon-U on, and he wins gold. But then Seong-A falls ill. Gyeon-U decides to care for her, only for Bong-su to get in the way.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: People grow to like the new Gyeon-U, who's actually Bong-su. Bong-su realizes he wants to become human, and Seong-A decides to protect him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-A leaves everyone to protect Bong-su while Gyeon-U goes out every night for three years to find her. They reunite, but Seong-A has changed.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Gyeon-U believes he met Seong-A, but it's Bong-su that he kissed? The new, delinquent Seong-A returns. The three people's real story begins now.

title: A Hundred Memories
overview: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama, growth, human, comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

episodeGuide.title: How Beautiful Youth Is
episodeGuide.summary: Go Yeong-rye hustles through her hectic days as a bus conductor. At work, she crosses paths with the sharp-tongued Seo Jong-hee, forming an unlikely bond. When Yeong-rye is in trouble, Han Jae-pil rescues her from a dangerous situation. When the fellow conductors try to give Jong-hee a hard time, Yeong-rye steps in to help, and their friendship grows.

episodeGuide.title: Whatever We Become, Let’s Meet Again
episodeGuide.summary: Determined to change her life, Go Yeong-rye searches tirelessly for the mysterious Giant, only to end up in trouble at a nightclub. Meanwhile, Han Jae-pil negotiates with his father, gaining permission to continue boxing in exchange for studying under the elite tutor, Go Yeong-sik. With Seo Jong-hee, Go Yeong-rye enrols in a night school.

episodeGuide.title: Some Kind of Fate
episodeGuide.summary: Go Yeong-rye and Seo Jong-hee go on a group date, where Yeong-rye unexpectedly meets Han Jae-pil. The group heads to a roller-skating rink, and Sang-cheol invites Yeong-rye and Jong-hee to watch a boxing match. As Jong-hee watches Jae-pil fight, she is shaken when memories of past violence resurface. Overcome by her trauma, she abruptly stops the match.

episodeGuide.title: One Step Behind
episodeGuide.summary: After her mother's sudden surgery, Yeong-rye takes a few days off work with the help of her coworkers. Yeong-bae and Yeong-mi visit Sae-ri's house. Jae-pil, who has feelings for Jong-hee, grows closer to her, and Jong-hee begins to see his vulnerable side. When Yeong-rye notices their bond deepening, her own feelings become conflicted.

episodeGuide.title: A Bad Day
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-pil and Sang-cheol discover that Yeong-rye and Jong-hee are not university students, but bus conductors who attend Hwarang Night School. Feeling ashamed after being found out, Jong-hee begins to distance herself from Jae-pil. Jong-nam tracks down Jong-hee and causes a scene at Cheongah Bus, forcing Jong-hee to go into hiding.

episodeGuide.title: Timing
episodeGuide.summary: When Cheongah Bus refuses to compensate for a serious accident that leaves a conductor severely injured, the conductors organise a strike. Yeong-rye seeks advice from Hyeon and Yeong-sik about the strike. Meanwhile, Jong-hee learns of Yeong-rye's feelings for Jae-pil and makes up her mind. When Yeong-rye finds herself in danger, Jong-hee steps in to help, putting herself at risk.

episodeGuide.title: Destiny
episodeGuide.summary: Yeong-rye and Jae-pil's feelings for each other continue to deepen, but they both try to stay within the boundaries of friendship. Jae-pil is consumed by his hectic life at the hospital, while Yeong-rye balances her work at the salon with caring for her family. When Jeong Hyeon, who left seven years ago, suddenly returns, Jae-pil finds himself overcome with jealousy.

episodeGuide.title: Among So Many Stars
episodeGuide.summary: Jong-hee and Yeong-rye unexpectedly reunite at Juri Beauty Salon. Jong-hee tells her story of how she was adopted by a chairwoman, and with this encounter, she finally catches up with everyone she used to know back when she was a bus conductor. However, things become complicated as she sees how close Yeong-rye and Jae-pil have gotten during her absence.

episodeGuide.title: Fated Encounter That Had Left, Destiny That I Kept
episodeGuide.summary: Jong-hee gets hospitalised, and she meets Jae-pil as her doctor. They talk about their time together back in the day, and Jong-hee's heart starts to grow again. Mi-suk doesn't want Jong-hee to get along with her friends from the past, and this becomes an argument between her and Jong-hee. Meanwhile, Jong-hee takes Yeong-rye to Hwaran School and talks about their old days.

episodeGuide.title: Close to You
episodeGuide.summary: Yeong-rye gets a new job at a different beauty salon. She attends the beauty seminar on her first day, and something she'd never expected happens. Jong-hee discovers that Mi-suk caused Yeong-rye to lose her job. Hyeon confesses his feelings to Yeong-rye, and Yeong-rye feels sorry and thankful at the same time. Meanwhile, Jae-pil confronts his feelings toward Yeong-rye.

episodeGuide.title: Miss Korea
episodeGuide.summary: Director Michelle suggests that Yeong-rye enter the Miss Korea pageant. Yeong-rye has a lot of concerns, but thanks to her family and friends' support, she decides to join the pageant. Hearing the news, Jong-hee also decides to join the pageant. Meanwhile, Sang-sik finds out that Jong-hee was one of the Miss Korea contestants.

episodeGuide.title: The Unfinished Story
episodeGuide.summary: Jong-hee is worried after seeing Sang-sik at the pageant. After hearing about this, Mi-suk decides to take care of Sang-sik in her own way. Finally, it's the final day of the Miss Korea pageant, and everyone is gathered at the cultural center. Meanwhile, Sang-sik gets away from Mi-suk's scheme, and he plans to hurt Jong-hee. The winner of the 1989 Miss Korea is finally announced.

title: Idol I
overview: A romantic comedy drama and suspenseful mystery about a top star lawyer who has been a die-hard fan for 15 years, and an idol who hates his obsessive fans.

episodeGuide.title: Because I Can't Stop for Death
Empty From What I Couldn't Let Go
When the Bell Rings in the Dark

title: The Potato Lab
overview: In The Potato Lab , Mi Kyung's potato-centric life is upended by Baek Ho, a cold pragmatist. A whirlwind healing romantic comedy unfolds, as twisty as a tornado potato.

episodeGuide.title: That Wonhan Bastard
episodeGuide.summary: While facing some internal anger for his harsh corporate changes, So Baek-ho clashes with the fierce Kim Mi-kyung when he visits her potato research lab.

episodeGuide.title: The Hot Director
episodeGuide.summary: After Baek-ho unwittingly moves into Mi-kyung's guest house and sets up an office at her lab, she turns the village against him — resulting in a fiasco.

episodeGuide.title: The Price of a Kiss
episodeGuide.summary: After Mi-kyung panics to avoid running into Baek-ho, he comes to her aid during a potato cooking competition. She later runs into a figure from her past.

episodeGuide.title: This message has been deleted
episodeGuide.summary: Baek-ho deals devastating news to Mi-kyung, forcing her to figure out her next steps. But later, an emergency forces the two to work together.

episodeGuide.title: Person of Interest
episodeGuide.summary: Baek-ho and Mi-kyung see new sides of each other, and feelings begin to blossom. A new arrival at the guesthouse stirs jealousy in Mi-kyung.

episodeGuide.title: False Goat's Beard
episodeGuide.summary: After a shakeup at the potato lab, Baek-ho and Mi-kyung take a business trip together. But soon after, Baek-ho starts avoiding her, leaving her confused.

episodeGuide.title: Softie Sweetie
episodeGuide.summary: With their feelings made clear, Mi-kyung and Baek-ho head out on their first date. But shortly after, they realize that rumors spread quickly at work.

episodeGuide.title: Lethal
episodeGuide.summary: The sudden appearance of an unwelcome visitor wreaks havoc at the guesthouse. Mi-kyung later panics out after discovering a secret relationship.

episodeGuide.title: I Regret It
episodeGuide.summary: While Mi-kyung struggles with past wounds, Baek-ho worries about her well-being. Later, they share a tender and intimate moment in a potato flower field.

episodeGuide.title: Yes
episodeGuide.summary: After witnessing a surprising moment between Park Ki-se and Mi-kyung, Baek-ho learns the truth about her past — leading him to confess everything.

episodeGuide.title: Disaster
episodeGuide.summary: Feeling betrayed by Baek-ho, Mi-kyung shuts him out. But as the tension between the two escalates, their colleagues scheme to reconcile them.

episodeGuide.title: MK107
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-kyung's lab days dwindle, leaving her future with Baek-ho uncertain. What will their next chapter hold?

title: Pro Bono
overview: The story of Kang Da Wit, a successful judge with exceptional work efficiency and quick thinking, but he is also materialistic and obsessed with success. One day, he faces an unexpected crisis and, against his will, becomes a public defender.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Da Wit's rise as a judge comes to a crashing halt after a scandal. But a far less glamorous opportunity offers him an unexpected new start.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Initially reluctant to lead a scrappy team, Da Wit takes on a case involving a stolen stray dog — but his unconventional tactics leave everyone stunned.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: While they often clash, Da Wit and the pro bono team begin to find their rhythm. Soon, a young boy arrives as the next client with an impossible request.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: As the case of the boy with a disability unfolds, Da Wit puts the court to the test — while the question of the boy's very worth comes under scrutiny.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Kaya, a foreign bride facing domestic abuse, seeks the team's help in her divorce. But her credibility comes into question amid brutal questioning.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: As Kaya's past comes to light, the pro bono team faces an unexpected turn — pushing Da-wit and his colleagues to fight for her right to stay in Korea.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: When the pro bono team learns they're being disbanded, Da-wit wagers that they can be valuable. Soon, they handle a case involving a popular singer.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: A shocking discovery complicates Eliyah's case, prompting the pro bono team to challenge her contract — even as public opinion turns against her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: After the pro bono team narrowly avoids being shut down, a shadowy figure approaches Park Gi-ppeum — asking her to file a lawsuit against Da-wit.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Da-wit stands trial as a defendant, facing the very team he has mentored. Meanwhile, both sides hunt for the truth that could bring light to the turmoil.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Da-wit's fate lies in the hands of the pro bono team, whose allegiance begins to waver. But just as peace seems within reach, he faces a new lawsuit.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Da-wit finally brings Oh Gyu-jang — the mastermind behind the corruption of justice — before the court. Will he succeed in bringing the truth to light?

title: Ball Boy Tactics
overview: After retiring from gymnastics, Han Jiwon thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jungwoo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Jiwon thinks he has Jungwoo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

title: Queen Mantis
overview: A thriller that follows a woman who was imprisoned as a serial killer a long time ago, and someone begins a serial killing imitating her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: When a series of terrible murders ensues in a residential area, Cha Su-yeol is forced to seek help from Jung I-shin, a serial killer from the past.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: The culprit has been arrested, but the victim's whereabouts remain unknown. Su-yeol struggles to save a life as I-shin reveals her true intentions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: I-shin offers assistance with the investigation, but it's unclear why she would help a cop. Su-yeol unravels the origins of I-shin's murderous instinct.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: The culprit begins to close in on Su-yeol's family. I-shin pressures Su-yeol to take action — but she happens to be the one threatening his family.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Su-yeol finds I-shin in his home after she vanishes under police watch. The killer demands to speak to I-shin and gives her a hint about the plan.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Shaken by recent events, Su-yeol attempts to confide in Lee Jung-yeon. During a tense call, I-shin manipulates the killer into exposing a crucial lead.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: As Jung-yeon copes with the truth of Su-yeol's past, the killer reveals their identity — and takes a hostage, forcing Su-yeol into a dangerous bargain.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: After a tense hostage exchange, I-shin confronts her protégé. Su-yeol makes a grim discovery about his family's fractured past.

title: Tide of Love
overview: Han Jae-hoon is a wealthy heir who hides his pain behind cold indifference while Kim Hae-jun, a bright art student is burdened by life's weight. What begins as a transactional relationship gradually transforms into a tender bond. In their shared solitude and unspoken care, they slowly draw closer, yet the thing that binds them keeps them from confronting their true feelings. As the tide rises and secrets surface, they must decide: will they remain confined by the rules, or will they dare to love?

title: Our Golden Days
overview: A story about finding the true meaning of family through the process of the older generation, and their children understanding each other's pain.

title: Heo's Diner
overview: A fantasy romance that takes place 400 years later when Heo Gyoon, a problematic character from the Joseon Dynasty, moves to the modern world to open a restaurant.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Joseon's genius, Heo Gyun, gets entangled in a conspiracy while living in exile and is pursued by assassins. Just as he faces certain death, he finds himself in the heart of 21st-century Seoul.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Believing that 21st-century Seoul, where there is no class discrimination, is the authentic 'Yuldo-guk' of his dreams, Heo Gyun begins his chaotic adaptation at the grumpy Eunsil's small diner.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Heo Gyun saved Eun-sil's mother's life, but his identity is unknown and he is suspected by the police... Eun-sil, who can't cook, is in danger of having to close down her restaurant...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Heo Gyun, who is a genius even in cooking, seems to agree to Eun-sil's suggestion to open a restaurant together, but he is not sure if he will accept her offer... In the meantime, Heo Gyun is confused when he meets Mi-sol and an old woman who look just like his acquaintances in Joseon.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: The restaurant becomes more and more famous through word of mouth due to Heo Gyun's extraordinary cooking skills, and Heo Gyun and Eun-sil gradually become closer. Lee Hyuk, who runs the restaurant across the street, who has been coveting the restaurant, becomes increasingly impatient...

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Heo Gyun, offered the opportunity to work at Lee Hyuk's restaurant, cannot easily refuse due to Eunsil's mother's hospital bills. Lee Hyuk puts his plan into action to bring down Heo's diner..

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: The misunderstanding between Heo Gyun and Eunsil grows bigger and bigger. Heo Gyun struggles to protect Heo's Diner. The memories that are tangled with the reason why he came here begin to come to mind.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Heo Gyun, who has regained his memory, knows that he must return to Joseon to save his friends, but he cannot leave Eun-sil behind, and is conflicted. Meanwhile, Eun-sil, who has been appraised by Domun Daejak, learns of Heo Gyun's true identity.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Heo Gyun and Eun-sil, who realized their feelings for each other too late, spend happy times together. And finally, Heo Gyun, who revealed all of Lee Hyuk's evil deeds, accepts his fate of having to return to Joseon.

title: Motel California
overview: Ji Gang Hui grew up at Motel California because her father ran the motel in her rural hometown village. Her mother also came from a mixed-raced background. Due to Gang Hui's unusual family background, she was the object of whispers and gossip by the local residents. Gang Hui carried a deep wound in her heart from that time. She liked her childhood friend Cheon Yeon Su, who was her first love, but when she turned 20, she left her hometown and moved to Seoul. 12 years later, she works as an interior designer and is reaching the apex of her career, but, for some reason, she decides to return to her hometown. She reunites with her first love, Cheon Yeon Su. Cheon Yeon Su works as a veterinarian in the village. The only woman he has loved is Gang Hui, but he has received a lot of attention from the farmers who are eager to introduce him to their daughters. In order to avoid these kind of uncomfortable situations, he doesn't clarify the rumor that he is going to marry a fellow veterinarian. His first love Gang Hui appears again after 12 years.

episodeGuide.title: Because I Always Look at You.
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee, the daughter of a motel owner, leaves the boring countryside after spending a night with her first love Yeon-soo. She meets Yeon-soo again after 10 years...

episodeGuide.title: I Want to Get Away From That Man Now.
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee and Yeon-soo break up without being able to convey their true feelings to each other. As both of them feel regret, Kang-hee's birthday, which also falls on Christmas, is approaching.

episodeGuide.title: Who Told You to Show Up Unexpectedly?
episodeGuide.summary: Yeon-soo prepares for a perfect reunion with Kang-hee but Kang-hee wants to part ways from him. Then Kang-hee, who is only focused on work, suddenly gets an unexpected task.

episodeGuide.title: You Didn't Keep a Single Promise You Made to Me!
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee confirms the woman who will marry Yeon-soo. She gets angry and drinks alone until she passes out. Then someone picks Kang-hee up and takes her to Motel California.

episodeGuide.title: Cheon Yeon-soo, Do You Like Me?
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee explodes with resentment towards Yeon-soo. Yeon-soo does his best to help Kang-hee, but their true feelings are increasingly diverging.

episodeGuide.title: I'm Sorry, I Didn't Know.
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee acknowledges the relationship between Yeon-soo and Nan-woo. She congratulates them by giving them her grandfather's ring, but then she hears an unexpected truth from Yeon-soo.

episodeGuide.title: Can We Be Friends?
episodeGuide.summary: Yeon-soo started to counterattack after Kang-hee said that they should remain friends even after the kiss. Kang-hee is flustered by Yeon-soo's unfamiliar appearance that she saw for the first time.

episodeGuide.title: I Won't Be Friends with Kang-hee Anymore.
episodeGuide.summary: The two friends spend a night at Kang-hee's house. Who will cross the line first in this tightrope walk?

episodeGuide.title: It's the First Day from Today.
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee and Yeon-soo finally confirm their feelings for each other. But as things get more complicated, the two end up running away to Seoul...

episodeGuide.title: Whenever You're Cold and Tired, Come to Me.
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee and Yeon-soo get into a car accident while on their way to Seoul together. Kang-hee, who regains his lost memories, is caught up in great confusion and shock.

episodeGuide.title: Now, Are You Okay?
episodeGuide.summary: Kang-hee is overcome with guilt. Yeon-soo knows another secret and avoids Kang-hee. In the end, Yeon-soo comes to Kang-hee who is about to leave...

episodeGuide.title: Motel California is Leaving Us.
episodeGuide.summary: Yeon-soo comforts Kang-hee who is shocked to learn of Chun-pil's illness. Meanwhile, Motel California falls into crisis due to Chun-pil's unexpected decision.

title: Villains
overview: A bloody confrontation takes place between villains over super-notes, which is a counterfeit bill of extreme high quality.

title: Ms. Incognito
overview: A comical human romance about a female bodyguard from a poor family who enters a contract marriage with a terminally ill conglomerate chairman, and has to survive under a false identity for 3 months, while guarding from those who are after her huge inheritance.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Young-ran, a bottom-of-the-table woman with a criminal record and debt, is miraculously hired as the personal bodyguard of the 70-year-old chaebol chairman, Ga Sung-ho. Entering an unfamiliar mansion, she encounters the eccentric Chairman and gradually senses a suspicious atmosphere.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Ga proposes marriage to Yeong-ran. She accepts, mortgaging her life to escape her debts. To avoid his stepdaughter, Ga Sun-young, who is after his fortune, she assumes the false identity of "Boo Se-mi" and prepares to leave for the countryside, Muchang.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Young-ran, transformed into a complete opposite of her past self, disguises herself as a kindergarten teacher, Boo Se-mi, and sets foot in Muchang for the first time. As she adjusts to the unfamiliar routine, she encounters Dong-min, who happens to pass by her at the Gahoejang mansion, and a strange tension begins to flow between them.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Young-ran struggles to adjust to kindergarten life. Her first class and the theft of her kindergarten tuition deepen her conflict with the villagers. Amidst nationwide attention focused on the widow of a defunct conglomerate chairman, Young-ran hosts a welcoming party of her own to avoid the villagers' suspicions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: An unexpected guest appears at the welcoming party, and the crisis becomes an opportunity. While Yeong-ran gains the trust of the villagers, Lee Don, the headman's lawyer, faces a threat. Yeong-ran's plans are disrupted, forcing her to implement Plan B, which sparks unexpected national news coverage.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Yeong-ran, whose identity is revealed to single dad Dong-min, approaches his son Ju-won, his weak point. Meanwhile, Yeong-ran is arrested by the police after an unexpected incident at kindergarten. Lee Don heads to Muchang to help her, but someone is secretly following him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: An uninvited guest with knowledge of Yeong-ran's past appears in Muchang. As tangled family histories and childhood memories resurface, Dong-min's son, Ju-won, goes missing in the village. Yeong-ran instinctively sets out to find Ju-won.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Unidentified outsiders appear in the village. Yeong-ran and Dong-min track down the suspicious figure hovering around them. Meanwhile, sensing an approaching threat ahead of the village unity festival, Yeong-ran finally confronts the person who has been targeting her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: A shocking incident nearly resulted in the loss of a loved one. Determined to remain hidden, Yeong-ran heads to Seoul. At a press conference, she reveals her identity and declares a direct confrontation with Chairman Ga's stepdaughter, Seon-yeong. Amidst the chaos in Mu-chang, where Yeong-ran's true identity has finally been revealed, Dong-min yearns for her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: A full-scale confrontation with Ga Seon-yeong begins. An unexpected figure offers Yeong-ran a deal, offering clues to Seon-yeong's weakness. Dong-min, who had come to Seoul to help Yeong-ran, who only pushed him away, finds himself in a desperate situation to save her, and the two share a bittersweet farewell.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: At the edge of despair, a shocking figure appears before Yeong-ran. Holding the key to turning the situation around, Yeong-ran risks everything to save Dong-min. As Yeong-ran struggles to save her loved ones and fulfill her contract with Chairman Ga, another unexpected and shocking situation unfolds before her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: The long-awaited shareholders' meeting. Just as Seon-yeong is being appointed as the group's next CEO, Yeong-ran appears at the meeting and reveals Seon-yeong's ugly face to the world. Having fulfilled her contract with Chairman Ga and become the owner of a vast inheritance, Yeong-ran suddenly disappears from the mansion one day, filled with a strange sense of emptiness.

title: Melo Movie
overview: Even if hardship and misfortune always accompany life, the youths who have walked with their middle finger raised now seek someone to lean on wholeheartedly, wanting to find a person to rely on as if they were to fall. Dreaming of becoming a film director one day, Kim Moo Bi, an assistant director, wants to follow in her father's footsteps, who worked as a filming crew member. After entering the film industry, she quietly honed her skills, not drawing attention to herself in the eyes of others. On the other hand, Ko Gyeom rose from being a supporting actor to becoming a film critic. He meets Moo Bi on the set of an interview film, eventually starting their own love story.

episodeGuide.title: It Will Become Scenic When Dawn Comes
episodeGuide.summary: In love with all things cinema, Ko Gyeom attends an audition, where he meets Kim Mubee. As he slowly develops feelings for her, he tries to get closer.

episodeGuide.title: Why So Serious
episodeGuide.summary: Five years after vanishing, Gyeom reappears as a critic before Mubee, now a director. But his nonchalant attitude stirs complicated feelings in her.

episodeGuide.title: Keep Your Friends Close, But Your Enemies Closer
episodeGuide.summary: Living in close proximity, Mubee and Gyeom become obsessed with each others' every move. Hong Si-jun and Son Ju-a struggle to reconcile their past.

episodeGuide.title: It's Not Your Fault
episodeGuide.summary: After Mubee and Ju-a partner on a new movie, Ju-a seeks Si-jun's help for the film's music. Gyeom faces a dark consequence from one of his reviews.

episodeGuide.title: No One Can Prepare You for the Love and the Fear
episodeGuide.summary: Gyeom's confession preoccupies Mubee, even though she tries to ignore it. Meanwhile, Ju-a keeps visiting Si-jun, hoping he'll compose the film's music.

episodeGuide.title: Happy Ending is Mine!
episodeGuide.summary: Mubee gives in to Gyeom's persistence — until he fails to show up one night. Si-jun and Ju-a become trapped together, leading to a frank exchange.

episodeGuide.title: Thanks for the Adventure Now Go Have a New One
episodeGuide.summary: Ko Jun tries to hide a big secret, sparking Gyeom's suspicions. Ju-a and Si-jun reflect on the past — and where they went wrong.

episodeGuide.title: All You Need is Love
episodeGuide.summary: As Gyeom pretends to be okay, his loved ones worry for his well-being. But soon, Mubee helps him find the courage to confront his feelings.

episodeGuide.title: We Were like Strangers Who Knew Each Other Very Well
episodeGuide.summary: Si-jun and Ju-a wrestle with their emotions as they question their future. Meanwhile, Mubee's film encounters a hurdle, leaving her feeling at a loss.

episodeGuide.title: Life is a Beautiful, Magnificent Thing, Even to a Jellyfish
episodeGuide.summary: Shedding their past, Mubee and Gyeom resolve to live their life to the fullest. Si-jun and Ju-a make a final decision about their relationship.

title: A Graceful Liar
overview: After a difficult childhood with a father who was falsely accused and an absent mother, Jeong-won, now an adult, begins living as the "fake Yeong-chae" at the suggestion of her old friend Yeong-chae at a gathering of rich families. One day, Yeong-chae tries to escape to Paris to avoid an arranged marriage and asks Jeong-won to stand in for her for a month. Living as the "fake Yeong-chae," Jeong-won grows close to Se-hun, the heir to the Jinseong Group. Amidst this, Jeong-won discovers that Yeong-chae stole her designs to achieve success, and that her future mother-in-law is her biological mother. Jeong-won resolves to become the real Yeong-chae and reclaim her life.
broadcast: KBS2 · Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday · 19:50

title: You and Everything Else
overview: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart -- until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: In 1992, Ryu Eun-jung clashes with new student Cheon Sang-yeon out of envy. Years later, Sang-yeon returns with news of her illness — and a final request.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Upon rejecting Sang-yeon's request, Eun-jung revisits their past — from her complex friendship to her fondness for Cheon Sang-hak, Sang-yeon's brother.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-jung meets Kim Sang-hak in her college photography club — a man who shares a name with someone from her past. Her timidness soon turns things awkward.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After years of no contact, Eun-jung and Sang-yeon meet again in college. But old shadows of insecurity soon resurface — rekindling old pain between them.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Sang-hak's enlistment sparks distance — for Eun-jung, ignored calls and secrets online begin to emerge, putting her friendship with Sang-yeon in danger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Sang-yeon and Sang-hak grow closer as they bond over her brother, and Eun-jung's suspicions grow — leading her to a truth that changes how she sees them.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: After Eun-jung confronts her about Sang-hak, Sang-yeon tries to ease the tension — but soon discovers a shattering secret about her brother.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Left out by Sang-hak and Sang-yeon's secret, Eun-jung feels alone and adrift — until heartbreak and hardship scatter all three in different directions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Now a film producer, Eun-jung crosses paths with Sang-hak once again — but when disastrous news hits their project, Sang-yeon reappears.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: As filming begins, Eun-jung and Sang-yeon clash over scripts, budgets, and creative style — while both hope to land Sang-hak as their cinematographer.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: A remote location scout leaves Eun-jung and Sang-yeon isolated, and small setbacks and creative clashes spiral into an unresolved, tense standoff.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: An on-set accident puts filming in jeopardy. Eun-jung and Sang-yeon must pull together to keep the project on track — relying on Sang-hak's expertise.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: Sang-yeon's resentment for Eun-jung boils over, just as a violent on-set crisis throws the production — and their partnership — into chaos.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: After their friendship ends in anger, Eun-jung shuts Sang-yeon out for good. Years later, Sang-yeon returns, hoping Eun-jung will grant her last wish.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 15
episodeGuide.summary: As Sang-yeon nears her final journey, Eun-jung grapples with a difficult promise. On the eve of goodbye, they share memories from a lifetime of friendship.

title: My bias is Showing!
overview: When high school teacher Na Aejoon shows up for work on an ordinary day, he never expects to bump into his favorite celebrity in the hallway. But when his school becomes a filming location for a show starring Choi Siyeol, his bias from the idol group A-One, that's exactly what happens! If that's not enough to give a fanboy a heart attack, Siyeol takes an interest in Aejoon and asks him to join the show as his "co-teacher." Desperate to keep his fan life a secret, Aejoon is forced to put his acting skills to the test, and not just on camera. But as he spends more and more time with Siyeol, the deception becomes harder to keep up. Not to mention, he might not be the only one keeping secrets…

title: Mary Kills People
overview: Based on a Canadian series, this dark comedy is the story of a doctor who is illegally helping terminally ill patients end their life, and a detective who is investigating these illegal activities.

episodeGuide.title: Do You Want to Finish?
episodeGuide.summary: A patient named Hyun-woo appears in front of doctors So-jeong and Dae-hyun, who secretly provide assisted dying to terminally ill patients, and requests assisted dying.

episodeGuide.title: Why do You do This?
episodeGuide.summary: Because of Woo-mi, So-jeong's secret is in danger of being revealed. Meanwhile, So-jeong's feelings for Hyun-woo cross the line as a doctor.

episodeGuide.title: I'll Send You Wherever You Want
episodeGuide.summary: Dae-hyun accepts Soo-young's request to assist him in his death and grants his final wish. Meanwhile, So-jeong is caught in a police trap while trying to help Hyun-woo.

episodeGuide.title: What You are Doing Now is Murder!
episodeGuide.summary: So-jeong makes a dangerous deal with drug dealer Gwang-chul to obtain assisted death drugs. The police investigation into So-jeong is becoming increasingly pressing.

episodeGuide.title: Over Time, it May Become a Human Right
episodeGuide.summary: So-jeong, who brought Si-hyeon out of the hospital, is found injured and abandoned on the street. Dae-hyun, who finds out about this, goes to find Gwang-chul.

episodeGuide.title: You are Being Arrested on Suspicion of Murder
episodeGuide.summary: When patient Yun-hee suddenly dies at Maria Welfare Hospital, So-jeong and Father Yang are investigated by the police as suspects of murder.

episodeGuide.title: Can We Turn Away from Such Pain for Fear of Criticism?
episodeGuide.summary: Dae-hyun is offered a judicial deal. Meanwhile, Ye-na's older brother, Geon-su, visits So-jeong and asks her to help him.

episodeGuide.title: Are You Saying We Should Have a Funeral Before We Die?
episodeGuide.summary: Ye-na goes on a final trip with Geon-su, and Gwang-chul starts a business of assisted death targeting the rich, which brings him into conflict with So-jeong.

episodeGuide.title: Please, Save Me From This Pain
episodeGuide.summary: Dae-hyun declares that he will not assist in assisted dying, and Hyun-woo finds Dae-hyun strange and goes to see him at Maria Welfare Hospital.

episodeGuide.title: The Situation is Getting Out of Control and Dangerous
episodeGuide.summary: So-jeong is attacked by the police at the scene of an assisted death due to Gwang-chul's scheme. Unable to stand by and watch, So-jeong steps in herself.

episodeGuide.title: There is No Place to Run Anymore
episodeGuide.summary: So-jeong decides to save Mi-young and asks Hyun-woo for help. Hyun-woo demands she confess everything...

episodeGuide.title: There are definitely patients who need euthanasia.
episodeGuide.summary: Dae-hyun, who has just been released from prison, visits So-jeong, who works at Maria Welfare Hospital. Meanwhile, Seon-ju, a terminally ill breast cancer patient, appears before them.

title: Last Summer
overview: A work that depicts a three-dimensional romance between a woman who 'hates summer' and a man who 'waits for summer every day' as they reunite after two years. The two people who complete their romance by examining each other from the inside out will unfold against the backdrop of summer.

episodeGuide.title: One Heck of a Summer Guest
episodeGuide.summary: Ha-gyeong's first love, Do-ha, reappears in the midst of summer. A property sale goes awry, and old wounds reopen as their summer ignites once more.

episodeGuide.title: The Reason I Returned
episodeGuide.summary: Back from a 2-year hiatus, Do-ha refuses defeat and attempts to win back Ha-gyeong's heart. Old memories from a summer past unlock as the rain pours.

episodeGuide.title: The Big Triangle of Summer
episodeGuide.summary: The Patan High School Project reunites the two. Under the Summer Triangle, first love emerges once more as Do-ha reveals his heart to Ha-gyeong.

episodeGuide.title: The 100th War Has Begun
episodeGuide.summary: As secrets unfold, past grievances reach a breaking point. Do-ha and Ha-gyeong begin a long and arduous battle over her beloved Peanut House.

episodeGuide.title: A House Needs People
episodeGuide.summary: Ha-gyeong and Do-ha settle into a new living situation and continue working on the Patan High project. But their mutual rival Nam-jin causes trouble.

episodeGuide.title: 21 Days to Get to Know You
episodeGuide.summary: Memories resurface as a shooting star lights the sky. Past and present collide as a confession is evaded. The name Baek Do-yeong casts a long shadow.

episodeGuide.title: The Dog-like Summer Guest
episodeGuide.summary: Do-ha's resentment over Ha-gyeong's new relationship grows. Seul becomes concerned after Seung-taek experiences pain during his hockey match.

episodeGuide.title: The Last Stage
episodeGuide.summary: Do-ha takes a confused Ha-gyeong out for the day. But while struggling to express her feelings, her drinking leads to a series of embarrassing errors.

episodeGuide.title: Summer Behind Scenes
episodeGuide.summary: Secrets unfold as Ha-gyeong breaks up with Su-hyeok and finds herself entangled with Do-ha. A double date at an amusement park deepens their rapport.

episodeGuide.title: A House Needs People Part 2
episodeGuide.summary: Do-ha's long-kept secret, Baek Do-yeong makes a comeback. Tears override laughter at the Peanut House, and the residents are at another crossroads

episodeGuide.title: Our Remodeling
episodeGuide.summary: Even if the peanut house collapses, the hearts of two people must be rebuilt. Unspoken truths, confessions of love spilling out like sleep talk. The moment when the true betrayer surrounding the solar power project is revealed. Two people standing together in the fight to protect their neighbors and village. "What will the model we will create in the future look like?"

episodeGuide.title: Our Last Summer
episodeGuide.summary: In the final summer, the two finally become true lovers. In a world where every day felt like war, they now promise to protect each other. They spend birthdays, anniversaries, and even the smallest moments together. Their love, sometimes cheerfully, sometimes seriously, continues. "Summer is over, but our story is just beginning".

title: The Defects
overview: ‘The Defects' is an action thriller depicting the desperate survival and revenge of children who barely survived on the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

episodeGuide.title: Eye Shopping
episodeGuide.summary: Ahyeon and the children, who live as if they were dead after being abandoned, repeat harsh training to protect themselves. Taesik, who has been rescuing children without the organization knowing, makes a decision to save the new 'recall' target.

episodeGuide.title: Quality Dissatisfaction
episodeGuide.summary: Ah-hyun and the kids try to run away as Tae-sik has planned for them. However, Jung-hyun, who had been keeping an eye on them, picks up their trail, putting them in danger. As the truth behind the brutal "refund" system comes to light, the kids vow to take revenge on the adults. Their first target is So-mi's adoptive parents.

episodeGuide.title: Survivors
episodeGuide.summary: After being disowned by their adoptive parents, Ah-hyun and the kids live as if they are dead. They endure brutal training, determined to protect themselves. Meanwhile, Tae-sik, who has been secretly rescuing children from the malicious organization, makes a bold decision to save a new "refund" target.

episodeGuide.title: Mom
episodeGuide.summary: To put an end to the inhuman adoption and refund system, Ah-hyun and the kids set out on a daring mission to confront the head of the evil organization. With fierce determination and a carefully crafted plan, they infiltrate the organization's bunker to strike from within. But once inside, Ah-hyun uncovers a devastating truth behind the system.

episodeGuide.title: Useful Child
episodeGuide.summary: The kids risk their lives to save their guardian, Ah-hyun. To do so, they're in desperate need big money, forcing them to confront Ju-an's adoptive father. Their plan is to steal offerings from his church. Meanwhile, Se-hee's ambition to seize even greater power pushes her toward devastating choices that could change the world.

episodeGuide.title: Real Name
episodeGuide.summary: Framed for murder, Ah-hyun and the kids turn to the only adult they trust, Detective Choi. Meanwhile, the unexpected and unwanted return of of Seok-su, the adoptive son who was believed to be dead, throws Kwon Kang-man into a crisis, leading him to seek ways to put an end to the adoption on his own.

episodeGuide.title: D-Day
episodeGuide.summary: The kids barely make it out alive from the fire, but with a tragic loss. Fueled by grief and rage, they vow revenge against the monster once more. Meanwhile, Kim Se-hee sets her sights on a refund project that is far more massive, ruthless, and shocking than Ah-hyun and the kids could have ever imagined.

episodeGuide.title: Final Refund
episodeGuide.summary: What begins as a camping trip soon turns into a living nightmare. Kim Se-hee's inhumanity reaches its peak as she executes her plan to massacre the "defects." To stop her once and for all, Ah-hyun and the kids rise up against her and her team, risking their lives for all the lives to avenge the ones already lost and protect those who could be next.

title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
overview: What happens when a Michelin-worthy chef from Paris accidentally time-slips to the Joseon dynasty? She meets the King, a fearsome tyrant with an unexpectedly refined palate. In a bid to survive palace intrigue and royal appetites, she whips up dazzling fusion dishes that tempt even the coldest heart. But as sparks fly in the royal kitchen, a slow-burn romance simmers beneath the surface.

episodeGuide.title: Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
episodeGuide.summary: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
episodeGuide.summary: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
episodeGuide.summary: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 5 Snowflake Schnitzel
episodeGuide.summary: After an intimate moment together, Yi Heon begins rejecting Ji-young's meals — but soon find their minds wandering toward each other amid the distance.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 6 Black Sesame Macaron
episodeGuide.summary: When the Ming envoy demands a cooking contest, Ji-young rises to the challenge to represent Joseon — and win what Yi Heon has promised her.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 7 Dongnae Pajeon on a Rainy Day
episodeGuide.summary: In order to gain an edge in the cooking competition, Ji-young sets out to create a unique pot. However, finding the right craftsman proves difficult.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 8 Rice Wine Beef Bourguignon
episodeGuide.summary: Barely making it to the competition, Ji-young begins cooking — only to find her crucial ingredients missing. Can she overcome the crisis?

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 9 Pressure-Cooked Ogyetang
episodeGuide.summary: Yi Heon shocks everyone by asking chefs to judge their own dishes. As time slips away in the intense battle, Ji-young considers plan B for her recipe.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 10 Joseon Restaurant
episodeGuide.summary: Yi Heon and Ji-young's bond deepens as he fights to prove her innocence — but can they uncover the cause of Grand Prince Jinmyeong's illness in time?

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 11 Soy Meat Gujeolpan & Eggplant Pie
episodeGuide.summary: Yi Heon unravels after discovering the truth about his mother, the deposed queen — leaving Ji-young to fight against history repeating itself.

episodeGuide.title: Course N° 12 Hwanseban
episodeGuide.summary: Trapped by Grand Prince Jesan's coup, Yi Heon and Ji-young fight to survive. But can their love endure against the forces of history and time?

title: History Of Losers
overview: A story about love and relationships that could turn anyone into a loser. It will be portrayed in the form of a romantic comedy that shows the inherent pathetic sides of people and diverse thrilling moments that come with various forms of love. The hyperrealistic depiction of humans at their lowest will be accompanied by laughter and empathy that goes beyond discomfort. Seo Min Ki is a freshman in college who is majoring in Korean literature. He is a hesitant person with a lot on his mind who sometimes makes bold actions. Being a 20-year-old, the result of his actions are always a series of clumsiness and mistakes. However, because he's someone who thinks a lot and has an ideological personality, he always self-reflects. He is a simple outsider whose only wish is to drink with his friends and play games at internet cafes.

title: Undercover High School
overview: A comic drama about the activities of an NIS agent who hid his identity and infiltrated as a high school student to track down the whereabouts of the missing gold bullion of Emperor Gojong

episodeGuide.title: The Emperor's Lost Gold
episodeGuide.summary: After a botched operation puts Hae-sung and his team in serious jeopardy, the only way for him to salvage his career at the NIS is to accept an assignment that seems almost hard to believe. Hae-sung and his team must infiltrate Byeongmun High School, one of Korea's most elite private institutions, to recover ten tons of gold bars worth a staggering 80 million dollars. With everything on the line, Hae-sung puts on a school uniform, and "Operation Undercover High School" begins.

episodeGuide.title: Spooky Stories
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-sung comes dangerously close to blowing his cover while searching for the hidden gold in Byeongmun High School's eerie old building, barely escaping detection by Soo-ah, his sharp-eyed homeroom teacher. As he hears chilling rumors and faces tight security surrounding the building, he believes that's where he'll find the gold. While dealing with school bullies, Hae-sung begins plotting his next move to uncover the dark secrets lurking inside the old building.

episodeGuide.title: Ghost Story Riddles
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-sung uncovers a crucial clue hidden within the old building, but Chairwoman Seo quickly learns its potential connection to the elusive gold bars. Sensing the connection, she keeps Hae-sung under close watch. Meanwhile, as Hae-sung delves deeper into the ghost stories surrounding the school, he finds himself caught in the escalating tension between Tae-soo and Dong-min, whose conflict ignites chaos throughout the school.

episodeGuide.title: Joining the Student Council
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-sung attends the anti-bullying committee session with a key witness who clears his name, while Dong-min finally finds the courage to stand up for himself. With his name vindicated, Hae-sung uncovers the existence of another grandfather clock hidden in the student council room, and the only way to get closer to it is by joining the student council. With the help of his team, he tries to meet the strict requirements.

episodeGuide.title: Student Council
episodeGuide.summary: Hae Seong and the team grow increasingly concerned that Su A's suspicions could threaten his undercover mission. However, Hae Seong defies the odds and successfully gains a spot in the student council. With this new role, his focus shifts to unraveling the mystery behind the old clocks. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure emerges, threatening to expose Hae Seong's true identity.

episodeGuide.title: Hae-sung's Father's Notebook
episodeGuide.summary: The school's security guard dies, leaving Hae-sung a notebook belonging to his missing father. The revelation is shocking, and he storms the NIS for answers. The answer pushes him away from the mission, and he takes time off. However, he resolves to continue but returns only to discover Soo-ah witnessed it all.

episodeGuide.title: The 24th Anniversary of Byeongmun High School
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-sung is caught off guard when he recognises Soo-ah's childhood name, Bong-ja, which stirs memories of his first love and distracts him from his focus. Despite the emotional turmoil, Hae-sung pushes forward with the mission to uncover the secrets behind the third ghost story. However, a missing key component forces Soo-ah to join the mission despite Hae-sung's strong opposition to her involvement.

episodeGuide.title: The Plan for VIP Students
episodeGuide.summary: After uncovering the possibility of a mole within the NIS, Hae-sung becomes increasingly distrustful of those around him, causing him to question the mission's integrity. Meanwhile, Soo-ah exposes a secretive scheme within the school that guarantees top grades for VIP students. As the web of secrets deepens, Hae-sung uncovers the connection between the gold bars and Chairwoman Seo, prompting him to vow to end her sinister plans.

episodeGuide.title: The Mathematics Teacher
episodeGuide.summary: As Soo-ah recovers in the hospital following the attack during the break-in, Hae-sung and the team uncover the culprit: Lee Jun-ho, the mathematics teacher. When Hae-sung detects his father's notebook missing, he realizes that Seo Myung-joo orchestrated the break-in. After Lee Jun-ho's arrest and confession, the revelation of the school's grade-rigging scandal throws the institution into chaos. Amid the turmoil, Hae-sung stumbles upon a crucial clue to the final scary story.

episodeGuide.title: Retribution
episodeGuide.summary: To everyone's shock, Seo Myung-joo returns to the school. Unimpressed by Hae-sung, she expels him and demonstrates her power by dismantling his team. However, refusing to back down, Hae-sung and the team, including Soo-ah and her mother, devise a daring plan to infiltrate the school once more to retrieve the hidden gold bars.

episodeGuide.title: The Devastating Truth
episodeGuide.summary: The gold bars vanish just as they are within reach, and Seo Myung-joo suspects Hae-sung has them. In the vault, Hae-sung makes a heartbreaking discovery of his father's remains. Overcome with grief, he finally finds closure, but a shocking truth emerges. He learns Director Kim Hyung-bae was behind it all. Determined to uncover the whole story, Hae-sung heads to confront him alone.

episodeGuide.title: Where the Stars Lead
episodeGuide.summary: Despite getting badly injured, Hae-sung manages to call Soo-ah and his team. They conclude that the only evidence they can secure is the flash drive that contains the voice recording of Principal Park murdering Director Kim Hyung-bae. After finding out that an arrest warrant had been issued for her, Seo Myung-joo decides to take a special measure to end everything.

title: Twelve
overview: Inspired by the 12 zodiac animals of the East, Twelve tells the story of 12 angels living in the human world in human form to protect the Korean Peninsula from evil spirits. Long ago, the angels barely managed to seal the forces of evil in the gates of hell through their sacrifice, bringing peace. However, with the evil spirits awakening, chaos returns.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Taesan and the angels live in disguise among humans. Samin discovers Ogwi, who has been sealed away.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: While Tae-san is haunted by his past guilt, Sa-min seeks O-gwi's help to steal Mirr's power. An odd light signals the evil's return.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: After evil spirits strike, Tae-san worries for the injured angels. O-gwi, with the soul stone, vows revenge as Ma-rok secretly hunts Sa-min.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Ma-rok warns Tae-san of O-gwi and Sa-min's return. As they sense the evil at their gathering, Geum-soon, the only human Tae-san cares for, becomes a target.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-san protects the angels and Geum-soon, while Sa-min kidnaps Mirr. O-gwi takes the power of Mirr and the soul stone. Ma-rok unleashes his wand's power.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: O-gwi battles Sa-min for the soul stone and escapes with Mirr. Tae-san opens the Hellmouth, restoring the angels' powers but unleashing evil worldwide.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Ogwi prayed to God, but a different entity answers him. To stop Samin from stealing Mirr's dragon soul, Taesan storms an underground temple in fury.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: As angels clash with Samin's fallen angels, Taesan falls defending Mirr, only to rise again to seal away the evil and save the angels.

title: My Girlfriend Is the Man!
overview: Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

episodeGuide.title: The Change
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Jae and Ji Eun, a couple from Yeonhee University, plan to go on a two-day trip together. However, just before the trip, Ji Eun turns into a good-looking man. Ji Eun and Ji Hye try desperately to hide this fact from Yoon Jae by pretending to be sick while Ji Eun contemplates whether to tell her boyfriend the truth or not.

episodeGuide.title: Kim Ji Hoon
episodeGuide.summary: While Yoon Jae struggles to love Ji Eun the same with her masculine looks, Yu Ri and Ji Eun discuss tactics to keep the relationship going. Meanwhile, Yoon Jae's sister, Yoon Ah, falls for Ji Eun's new appearance and Yoon Jae's junior, Min Hyuk, becomes acquainted with Ji Eun's new male self, pushing Ji Eun to come up with a temporary alter ego, Kim Ji Hoon.

episodeGuide.title: The Selfish Gene
episodeGuide.summary: Suddenly, Ji Hoon is back to looking like Ji Eun, relieving Yoon Jae. At the same time, Kang Min Joo, a junior of Yoon Jae's, comes back to Korea from her studies abroad and invites Yoon Jae to a welcome-back party, irking Ji Eun. While Ji Eun plans to go to the party with her boyfriend to keep an eye on Min Joo, she faces an unexpected crisis.

episodeGuide.title: Confession Gone Too Far
episodeGuide.summary: Ji Eun and Ji Hye visit their parents, who believe Ji Hoon is Ji Hye's boyfriend, in order to tell them the truth about Ji Hoon. Meanwhile, Ji Eun invites Yoon Jae, Min Hyuk, and Yu Ri over to make up for the drunken trouble Yoon Jae caused. While Yu Ri tries hard not to fall for her friend's new looks, Min Joo begins to disrupt Ji Eun and Yoon Jae's relationship in earnest.

episodeGuide.title: Breaking Orbit
episodeGuide.summary: The love triangle between Yoon Jae, Ji Hoon, and Min Joo deepens, and the competition to win over Yoon Jae's heart begins in earnest. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon becomes Yoon Ah's tutor, satisfying her need for handsome men. He also becomes Yu Ri's knight in shining armour at her friend's birthday party, causing an unforgettable scene for all.

episodeGuide.title: Utter Chaos
episodeGuide.summary: Ji Hoon suddenly becomes a sensation on social media as Doe Eyes of Yeonhee University. To help Yoon Jae and Ji Hoon, Yu Ri decides to reveal her face and do a fan sign event. Ji Hye and her old school friend, Young Seok, finally meet properly and exchange numbers. Yoon Jae is suspected of cheating on Ji Eun as he is seen coming out of a motel.

episodeGuide.title: Sleeping with the Enemy
episodeGuide.summary: Min Joo moves in next to Ji Hoon, deepening the rivalry between the two over Yoon Jae. However, they also find common ground in their pursuit to make money and collaborate temporarily. Meanwhile, Ji Hye decides to pretend to be hurt to get Young Seok's attention.

episodeGuide.title: Sleeping with the Enemy 2
episodeGuide.summary: As his parents go away on a trip, Yoon Jae plans to spend the evening at home with Ji Hoon. Ji Eun's family secret is revealed, leaving her shocked. Min Joo finds the disheartened Ji Hoon and helps him lie down, causing a huge misunderstanding between them and Yoon Jae. Meanwhile, Young Seok's two pursuers finally find out about each other.

episodeGuide.title: Grandpa and Pink
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Jae, Ji Hoon, Yu Ri, Min Joo, and Min Hyuk go to meet Ji Eun's grandfather to go on vacation and help him out with his work. While Ji Hoon has many questions to ask about his condition, Min Joo begins to seduce Yoon Jae earnestly, leading to multiple misunderstandings between Yoon Jae and Ji Hoon.

As Ji Hoon switches back to Ji Eun, Min Joo begins to doubt her identity. While Yoon Jae is relieved to see his girlfriend again, he is torn about going to Corning University with Min Joo to pursue his dreams in astronomy. Meanwhile, Min Joo's suspicions about Ji Hoon and Ji Eun grow uncontrollably as Ji Hye slips up while drunk.

episodeGuide.title: Yoon Jae’s Prayer
episodeGuide.summary: Yoon Jae and Ji Eun, a couple from Yeonhee University, plan to go on a two-day trip together. However, just before the trip, Ji Eun turns into a good-looking man. Ji Eun and Ji Hye try desperately to hide this fact from Yoon Jae by pretending to be sick while Ji Eun contemplates whether to tell her boyfriend the truth or not.

episodeGuide.title: Love, the Miracle of the Universe
episodeGuide.summary: After his breakup, Yoon Jae decides to go to Corning University with Min Joo. Meanwhile, Ji Hye cheers on Young Seok with his upcoming exam, and Ji Eun begins to pursue her dreams and enters a writing contest. Yoon Jae happens to read Ji Eun's story and reflects on their happy days together.

title: Dynamite Kiss
overview: A romance between a single woman who pretends to be a married mom in order to get a job, and the team leader who falls in love with her.

episodeGuide.title: Nitric Acid, Sulfuric Acid, and Dynamite
episodeGuide.summary: Ahead of her sister's wedding, Go Da-rim heads to Jeju Island, where a sudden encounter leaves her reeling — until she meets Gong Ji-hyeok by a cliff.

episodeGuide.title: Gone with a Kiss
episodeGuide.summary: As their ruse turns into a real spark, Da-rim and Ji-hyeok go on an actual date. Meanwhile, Da-rim's mother collapses after a shocking confrontation.

episodeGuide.title: Ping, Pong, Ping, Pong
episodeGuide.summary: Da-rim and Ji-hyeok's unexpected reunion at work takes a tense turn when he learns of her "marriage" — becoming a ruthless boss as punishment.

episodeGuide.title: His Black Card
episodeGuide.summary: A tense escape from loan sharks brings Ji-hyeok and Da-rim closer, reigniting their spark. Later, Da-rim makes a heartfelt plea to keep her job.

episodeGuide.title: Go Da-rim Is Mine! From Head to Toe!
episodeGuide.summary: After Ji-hyeok pays off Da-rim's debt, he starts meddling in every part of her life — leaving her torn between frustration and affection.

episodeGuide.title: Swayed, Driven Mad
episodeGuide.summary: After witnessing Kim Seon-u's apparent romantic rendezvous with Yu Ha-yeong, Ji-hyeok debates telling Da-rim while caring for Da-rim during her illness.

episodeGuide.title: I Want to Get Married, As Soon as Possible.
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-hyeok and Da-rim's bond deepens as they team up at a company event for newlyweds. Later, Da-rim falls in the mountain amid an unexpected crisis.

episodeGuide.title: Love Is Hell
episodeGuide.summary: News of Ji-hyeok's engagement shocks Da-rim — and his coldness only deepens the hurt. But a company trip soon forces them back into close proximity.

episodeGuide.title: Don't Go. I Don't Want You to Go.
episodeGuide.summary: When Ji-hyeok learns the truth about Da-rim, he feels relieved yet deceived — and his unpredictable behavior pushes her to confess everything.

episodeGuide.title: The Reason I Like You
episodeGuide.summary: Da-rim grows wary of Ji-hyeok's constant affection. Later, when their mothers gather at Seon-u's home, Ji-hyeok's competitive streak flares up.

episodeGuide.title: Master of the Poker Face
episodeGuide.summary: After a confession, Ji-hyeok and Da-rim begin a secret romance — but not without close calls. Meanwhile, someone at work learns that Da-rim is unmarried.

episodeGuide.title: Very Sweet
episodeGuide.summary: Racked with guilt, Da-rim decides to resign — but Ji-hyeok won't let her go. When a colleague catches their affection, Da-rim decides to tell the truth.

episodeGuide.title: Flirting Master of the Orchard
episodeGuide.summary: After being forced to admit she was spying, Da-rim says goodbye to Ji-hyeok before disappearing. Heartbroken, he focuses on clearing her name.

episodeGuide.title: Dynamite Kiss
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-hyeok makes his final move to take down his foes, but a vengeful act puts him in danger and erases his memory. Can he and Da-rim find happiness?

title: Beyond the Bar
overview: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

episodeGuide.title: Induction
episodeGuide.summary: Despite a rocky start at Yullim Law Firm, Kang Hyo-min joins Yoon Seok-hoon's team — and impresses him when she finds a discrepancy in their first case.

episodeGuide.title: Hot Water Is the Test for Tea and Love
episodeGuide.summary: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min take on a case involving a man who broke into a fertility clinic — earning trust in a tangled battle of love, health and injustice.

episodeGuide.title: Butterfly Chrysalis
