episodeGuide.summary: A complex no-contact car accident involving a child sends Seok-hoon and Hyo-min digging for clues. Seok-hoon receives a bold offer from Yullim's founder.

episodeGuide.title: Lex Talionis
episodeGuide.summary: While defending a CEO accused of child abuse, Hyo-min and Seok-hoon clash over their morals. Soon, Seok-hoon's sudden disappearance worries her.

episodeGuide.title: Salieri's Monologue
episodeGuide.summary: Hyo-min takes on her first solo case over a painting's copyright, leaning on Seok-hoon for mentorship — until a mid-trial revelation shakes her stride.

episodeGuide.title: Love Is an Impairment
episodeGuide.summary: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min handle a tricky consent case for a client suing her ex. Meanwhile, Kwon Na-yeon's sudden appointment creates waves at Yullim.

episodeGuide.title: Love in All Its Colors
episodeGuide.summary: After a man is arrested for aiding his wife's assisted suicide, Seok-hoon takes on the case. Meanwhile, Yullim's new performance system sparks fury.

episodeGuide.title: Wonder Woman
episodeGuide.summary: At Yullim, Ko Tae-seop's plot to oust Seok-hoon escalates. When a famous news anchor is charged with assaulting her husband, Hyo-min digs for the truth.

episodeGuide.title: The Right to Life
episodeGuide.summary: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min defend a doctor who faces possible murder charges for failing to save a man she abhors. Meanwhile, Na-yeon looks into a shady deal.

episodeGuide.title: Bystander
episodeGuide.summary: After a murder suspect blames her for the crime, Hyo-min hunts for their connection. Na-yeon and Seok-hoon pursue the truth behind Yullim's CEO's ploy.

episodeGuide.title: The Two-legged Beast
episodeGuide.summary: When a personal privacy case spirals, Seok Hun's fury grows as the client crosses the line. Meanwhile, Na Yeon uncovers proof to back her suspicions.

episodeGuide.title: Beyond Loves Vow
episodeGuide.summary: A divorce case turns complicated when the court contemplates their unusual relationship. Seok Hun and Na Yeon make their final move for justice.

overview: Suddenly red lines appear above people's head. These red lines connect people who have had sex relations. Due to this, embarrassing or secret sides of people are revealed. People call these red lines "S Line." Han Ji-Wook (Lee Soo-Hyuk) is a detective with an attractive appearance and free spirit. He chases after the truth of the S Line. Kyu-Jin (Lee Da-Hee) is a high school teacher with unique charm. Hyun-Hob (Arin) is a high school student. She has been able to see the red lines since she was born.

episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon -suk, a girl who was able to see the S -line that shows sexual relationships since birth. Then one day, a mysterious serial murder occurred around the Hyunsim, and Hyunsux traces the case with the ability to see the S -line.

episodeGuide.title: Animal kingdom
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeon -suk to go to school after receiving a question in question. There, he reunites with Sun -ah, a middle school alumni and a nephew of Ji -wook. However, Sun -ah is a bullying who is harassed by Iljin. One day, when the harassment of the Iljin reached its extreme, Sun -ah found a mysterious glasses in his locker ...

episodeGuide.title: Apartment
episodeGuide.summary: Sun -ah falls out of the rooftop and falls into a coma. Because of this, Ji -wook is enthusiastic with self -reproach and anger, and cooperates with Hyun to find the culprit. Meanwhile, Jung -woo, an English teacher, witnesses the affair of his girlfriend ahead of marriage. And after a while, I find glasses on my desk ...

episodeGuide.title: Immature
episodeGuide.summary: Ji -wook, who continued to investigate to find the culprit of Sun -ah, hears about the S -line from the Hyunsuk, but increases. episodeGuide.title: Glasses

title: Resident Playbook
overview: Set at the Jongno branch of Yulje Medical Center, the series follows the hospital lives and turbulent friendships of young obstetrics and gynecology residents who proudly enter the unpopular department in an era of low birth rates.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Struggling with her finances, Oh Yi-young reluctantly returns to resident life — making blunder after blunder. Soon, she faces her first patient crisis.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: The first-year residents contemplate quitting after burning out from hospital life. When Yi-young is backed into a corner, Ku Do-won comes to her aid.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: As Um Jae-il receives constant compliments, Yi-young, Pyo Nam-kyung and Kim Sa-bi try to find ways to bring comfort to their own patients and families.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-young gets roped into a research paper with Professor Seo, sparking Sa-bi's jealousy. Nam-kyung misguidedly creates tension on the hospital floor.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Though Yi-young's bluntness gets her in trouble, she uses it to comfort a patient's child. Jae-il's need to overachieve becomes a nuisance to others.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Witnessing Do-won being snubbed, Yi-young finds herself getting defensive. Meanwhile, Sa-bi and Nam-kyung can't stop clashing over their differences.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Frustrated by the other departments, the OB-GYN residents decide to push back. Meanwhile, Nam‑kyung finds herself irritated as she oversees an intern.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: After being hospitalized at work, Sa-bi struggles with the fear of missing out. A new patient's arrival tests Nam-kyung's patience — and her compassion.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: As a TV crew films the OB-GYN department, Yi-young's superior torments her. Meanwhile, an intern takes advantage of Jae-il and Sa-bi undermines a senior.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Nam-kyung and Yi-young find themselves in the middle of two competitive professors. Sa-bi endures an abusive superior but finds solace in a kinder boss.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: While trying to keep her relationship with Do-won secret from the hospital, Yi-young gets hands-on OB-GYN experience with a demanding professor.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As their first year nears its end, the residents face the hospital's never-ending bustle — especially Yi-young, who finds herself at a crossroads.

title: Would You Marry Me?
overview: A sweet and thrilling, 90-day fake honeymoon survival romantic comedy about a man and a woman who are trying to win the ultimate newlywed prize.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: After betrayal leaves Meri broke and homeless, she asks stranger Kim Wooju - who shares her ex's name - to pose as her husband for a luxury townhouse.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Wooju refuses Meri but later agrees to be her husband. When Meri learns of the condition to get her prize, she seeks Wooju to reprise the role.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: After losing her home, Meri moves into a motel. Wooju's help backfires and their fake marriage faces new risks when neighbour Sanghyeon grows wary.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: As Meri and Wooju prepare for the department store president's visit, she opens her heart but family matters push Wooju to reveal the reason he helps.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Meri hides her ex's call, but facing Sanghyeon at work stirs tension. Wooju visits Meri but is shaken to learn their link as her ex circles closer.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: After a risky rooftop moment, Meri and Wooju grow closer. As her ex looms and a VVIP scandal erupts, they work together, bringing them even closer.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Wooju confesses his feelings, but Meri hesitates. As he shares his past to prove his sincerity, a stormy night at Beauté Palace changes everything.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Wooju opens up about his past, and Meri begins to understand him better. They grow closer under the starlight and start to imagine a future together. Wooju gains warmth from Meri's family, while Meri resolves to face truths she has avoided. Yet ambition and obsession cast shadows over their future.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Meri's ex threatens to expose her secret, forcing her to protect Wooju. Meanwhile, Wooju senses trouble at work and plans a date to cheer her up.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: At Myungsoondang's 80th anniversary event, Sanghyeon notices something between Wooju and Meri, but an unexpected ally comes to their aid. Meanwhile, Myungsoondang faces troubling rumors, and Wooju follows a suspicious lead that uncovers a major secret.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Wooju uncovers the 25-year-old truth to save Myungsoondang, facing the one behind it all. Meri turns to Sanghyeon as a scandal shakes Beauté Group.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Meri's ex publicly accuses her and Wooju, igniting a media frenzy as the Myungsoondang scandal peaks. Refusing to back down, they confront the chaos.

title: To the Moon
overview: A comedic survival investment story of three poor office workers who can't get by on their salaries alone, and dream of making a fortune.

episodeGuide.title: The Average Girls' Taste of Red
episodeGuide.summary: At the year's end comes Marron Confectionery's inevitable employee evaluations. Third-year non-regular employees Jung Da-hae, Kang Eun-sang, and Kim Ji-song are no exception. As the results bring joy for some and disappointment for others, Eun-sang is oddly cheerful, even humming to herself. Meanwhile, with Da-hae's birthday approaching, her boyfriend Byeong-jun suddenly goes missing, plunging her into extreme anxiety.

episodeGuide.title: Between Diligence and Inferiority
episodeGuide.summary: After hearing about investing in crypto from Eun-sang, Da-hae and Ji-song are intrigued. But Da-hae, reminded of her father, who ruined his life chasing a single big break, forces herself to stay grounded. Meanwhile, the in-house project proposal she submits makes it to the final round of evaluations. Convinced she's finally earning recognition at the company, she devotes herself day and night to preparations until someone breaks into her home.

episodeGuide.title: A Taste for the Averages
episodeGuide.summary: After causing a scene at the company dinner, Da-hae is gripped with fear the next day. Meanwhile, Eun-sang is always scheming to make money, and Ji-song, who only thinks about spending it, goes their separate ways. Eun-sang devises a clever money-making plan at work, while Ji-song buys a ticket to China to meet her unfaithful boyfriend Wei Lin.

episodeGuide.title: The Reason I Want to Be Rich
episodeGuide.summary: By chance, Da-hae gets caught up in a motel fire incident and ends up getting interviewed on the news. But when her face gets aired without proper mosaic blurring, she suffers great embarrassment. In the aftermath, Eun-sang protests at the TV station on her behalf, only to receive an unexpected phone call. Meanwhile, Da-hae is shocked when she realizes that it was Dr. Ham she spent the night with at the motel.

episodeGuide.title: Star Quality
episodeGuide.summary: With Marron Confectionery's 30th anniversary event approaching, Da-hae is busy with preparations when she notices Dr. Ham and Da-hee starring in the company's promotional video, leaving her with mixed feelings. Meanwhile, thanks to Dong-gyu, Ji-song gets added to the accounting team's group chat, and for the first time, she feels the thrill of belonging to the team.

episodeGuide.title: The Art of the Flex
episodeGuide.summary: The cryptocurrency surges! To celebrate, Da-hae and Eun-sang decide to take Ji-song on a trip. But their sense of freedom from work doesn't last long. Soon, the obsession with crypto drives their journey toward disaster. Meanwhile, Dr. Ham suddenly asks Da-hae, "What are we to each other?" leaving her extremely flustered.

episodeGuide.title: The Art of Buying the Dip
episodeGuide.summary: The crypto crashes. But now's the perfect time to buy more, or so they think. Da-hae, Eun-sang, and Ji-song take on part-time jobs, hoping to fund their rebound. One day, Dae-young unexpectedly shows up as a customer at their part-time gig, but wait a minute, Marron Confectionery has a no side-job policy! With that, the three scramble desperately to hide their secret from Dae-young.

episodeGuide.title: Mother and Daughter
episodeGuide.summary: After more than a decade in hiding, Da-hae's father suddenly returns, clutching a crypto mining machine. Not wanting to ruin her mother's upcoming 60th birthday celebration, Da-hae hides the fact that he's back. Meanwhile, Eun-sang crosses paths with her ex-husband, Dong-jun, sparking tension, and Ji-song grows excited thinking about marriage when she hears that Wei Lin is coming to Korea.

episodeGuide.title: The Turning Point
episodeGuide.summary: Everything in Da-hae's life seems to be going smoothly, including her work, crypto, and even romance. But when she secretly tries to give Dr. Ham a cookie gift, she runs into an unexpected obstacle. Meanwhile, in the sales team, Eun-sang faces pressure to close a deal tied to a performance bonus and takes drastic action. After breaking up with Wei Lin, Ji-song spends the entire day avoiding Dong-gyu for reasons unknown.

episodeGuide.title: Our Share
episodeGuide.summary: As the crypto value plummets, Da-hae, Eun-sang, and Ji-song grow increasingly anxious. Around the same time, the company announces a chance for employees to apply for an early severance payout. Tempted to invest more in crypto, Da-hae wrestles with whether to take it. Meanwhile, rumors spread through the office that someone sold their crypto right before the crash, making over a million dollars in profit.

episodeGuide.title: Out Into the World
episodeGuide.summary: As the saying goes, "Life's ups are followed by downs". With the crypto's value at its peak, Dr. Ham shocks Da-hae by announcing his resignation. Meanwhile, Eun-sang faces disciplinary action over issues with the Kang Eun-sang Store, and Ji-song's heart races when she sees a former coworker thriving after leaving the company.

episodeGuide.title: To the Moon
episodeGuide.summary: As the shocking truth about Hoppang Bite comes to light, Marron Confectionery gets thrown into chaos. Amid the commotion, Eun-sang is busy wrapping up handovers before leaving the company, and Da-hae stands at the threshold of a new path. Ji-song, too, grows disillusioned with office life, lost in thought. Meanwhile, the three carefully weigh the perfect moment to sell their crypto, a decision that could change their lives forever.

title: Running Mate
overview: Se Hoon is a model student with good grades, but an unfortunate incident on the bus one day earns him the humiliating nickname of ‘Erector.' The choir director, Won Dae, asks him to be his running mate for the upcoming student council election. Needing to rehabilitate his image, Se Hoon agrees, only to find out that he is Won Dae's twelfth running mate. With his pride bruised, Se Hoon decides to join Sang Hyun, a walking luxury man known as the local social butterfly.

title: Checkered Shirt
overview: A casual purchase of a Checkered Shirt through Karrot Market leads to an unexpected connection with a mysterious man, sparking curiosity and unspoken emotions. Jungwoo experiences lingering feelings and encounters new possibilities.

title: Secret Relationships
overview: Daon, a smart and handsome salary man, often clashes with his colleague Sunghyeon. Their relationship becomes more and more ambiguous as time progresses, while other figures like Jaemin, a former tutor, and heir to the company Suhyeon make their way into his life. What shape will this love square end up turning into?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Daon is a rational and calm person in his company and known for often fighting with his colleague Sunghyeon. One day Daon once again sees Jaemin, the senior he admired in university, along with Suhyeon, the heir to the company, and a relationship emerges between the four.

title: Don't Confess Next to a Corpse
overview: Late at night, Gunha and Gwangmin are left alone, bickering over an assignment, and end up dozing off. When they wake up, there's a dead body lying next to them! An assignment, a body, and a confession—how much more can they handle in one night?

title: Law and the City
overview: A cheerful and passionate youth drama about associate lawyers who go to work at Seocho-dong Law Town every day. It is a realistic story of 'real' lawyers who have stepped into the real world and will portray the coming of age of lawyers in charge of cases that can happen in and around our daily lives. An Ju Hyeong is a 9th-year lawyer with a high level of fact-violence logic. He became a lawyer simply because he found logic and cases interesting. From the beginning, he did not have the 'meaning' that lawyers protect the weak, implement justice, and change the world. He is just a 9th office worker. He has been a regular at the same company for 9 years without changing jobs, and his work is at its peak as his seniority. He is a veteran in the associate industry who has set a new associate salary record but does not open a practice because it is too much trouble. For Ju Hyeong, the peaceful wall of the 'workplace' begins to crack. Kang Hui Ji is a 2nd-year lawyer at Johwa Law Firm. She believes that " if you change one person's life, you have changed that person's world." Whether she is lacking or overflowing, she is confident and honest.

episodeGuide.title: Seocho-Dong
episodeGuide.summary: Hui-ji joins the lunch crew of the Hyungmin Building associates. She seems to recognize Ju-hyeong.

episodeGuide.title: More Than Meets the Eye
episodeGuide.summary: Hui Ji remembers Ju Hyeong, but he doesn't remember her. They clash over opposing sides of an issue.

episodeGuide.title: How to Separate Work From Personal Life
episodeGuide.summary: Ju Hyeong and Hui Ji make peace. The firms merge, and Hui Ji grapples with a medical malpractice case.

episodeGuide.title: None of My Business
episodeGuide.summary: Hui Ji learns the opposing side in Ju Hyeong's case is his ex. The group faces troubling situations.

episodeGuide.title: The Courage to Face It
episodeGuide.summary: Ju-hyeong admits post-divorce feelings to Hui-ji but Chang-won's help with her job irks him. Mun-jeong doubts pregnancy. Sang-gi gets odd texts post-leak.

episodeGuide.title: A Few Words of Kindness
episodeGuide.summary: Sang-gi's exposé creates group tension, he reveals his past. Ju-hyeong and Hui-ji bond, seeing Hyeong-min anew. Mun-jeong dreads telling Ji-seok of the baby.

episodeGuide.title: The One Who Truly Understands Me
episodeGuide.summary: Ju-hyeong finds ease in familiar faces, grows love for Hui-ji. Hyeong-min mentors while Sang-gi enjoys teaching law students. Chang-won questions justice.

episodeGuide.title: The Others I'm Close To
episodeGuide.summary: Hui-ji's world shatters as her father is jailed for fraud. Old wounds reopen. She turns to Ju-hyeong for help. The group unites to stand by her side.

episodeGuide.title: If You Ask What My Dream Is
episodeGuide.summary: Mun-jeong finds purpose in a case. Hyeong-min hits limits helping a scam victim. Sang-gi faces PhD reality. Chang-won questions being an advocate.

episodeGuide.title: Difference in Perspective
episodeGuide.summary: Chang-won finds hope in a trial. Mun-jeong resists quitting. Ju-hyeong takes an unwanted case, facing discomfort. Hui-ji defends a child's life.

episodeGuide.title: Being an Adult
episodeGuide.summary: Man-su asks Ju-hyeong to help reclaim land. Sang-gi meets someone who's just ike his past self. Hui-ji defends a murder suspect. Change stirs in Hyeong-min.

episodeGuide.title: See You in Seocho-dong
episodeGuide.summary: After Man-su's funeral, Ju-hyeong questions the case. Chang-won and Sang-gi share news. Hui-ji and Hyeong-min face choices. The five choose their paths.

title: Love Me
overview: A drama that portrays the story of a family that is a little selfish and perhaps more ordinary than their own, who cherished each other's lives as they grew to love each other.

episodeGuide.title: The Feeling of Love Has Arrived
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-kyung says that she's not into dating or seeing new people. It seems that she's living a perfect single life, but actually, she's struggling with loneliness every day. Jin-ho quits his job and decides to spend more time with the family. Jun-seo is a grad student who's worried about his future. He wants to be loved and love others, but a shocking incident changed him.

episodeGuide.title: Life Goes On
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-ran was a big part of the family's life. She was the center who gathered the family together. Ever since the accident, the family couldn't move on and just stayed there, hurt emotionally. Now that Mi-ran is gone, the lives of the remaining ones move on again. Jun-kyung runs into a man, Jun-seo's relationship is at a crisis, and Jin-ho decide to go on a trip by himself.

episodeGuide.title: The Sorrow
episodeGuide.summary: After the funeral, the family is back to their lives. While they are still absorbing the grief and sorrow, new people and events enter their lives. Jun-kyung gets closer to Do-hyun, and she even does something she'd never do. Jin-ho slowly opens up to Ja-yeong, who has taken care of him, as he is travelling alone. Jun-seo reproaches himself, thinking he's wasting his time.

episodeGuide.title: New Relationships
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-kyung finds out about Do-hyun's secret. She's shocked and disappointed, but she can't get over him right away. Jin-ho knows that Ja-yeong is a nice person, and she's even interested in him. However, he questions himself if it's the right time for him. Meanwhile, Jun-seo starts to have questions about his relationship with Sol.

episodeGuide.title: Thinking About Happiness
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-seo feels insecure because he believes he's not good enough for Sol. He receives an offer for an internship at a station, and he's happy to share the news with everyone. Meanwhile, Jun-kyung wants to become close to Daniel, Do-hyun's son, but things don't turn out as expected. Jin-ho makes up his mind and decides to pursue his happiness no matter what others say.

episodeGuide.title: Telling the Truth
episodeGuide.summary: An unexpected guest visits the house, and Jun-kyung finds out about Jin-ho and Ja-yeong. She tells harsh things to Jin-ho, and Ja-yeong calls her to apologise. Jun-seo is frustrated as he breaks up with Sol, and Hye-on finally acknowledges her feelings toward Jun-seo. Meanwhile, Jin-ho tells his children about Ja-yeong and makes it official.

episodeGuide.title: Meeting the Family
episodeGuide.summary: Jin-ho visits Mi-ran's sister and apologises for dating someone new. Daniel tells Do-hyun that he doesn't like the fact that Do-hyun is seeing Jun-kyung. Beom-jun announces to the team that he'll quit for a Europe trip with his girlfriend, and Hye-on is at a loss for words. Meanwhile, Jin-ho asks his kids to meet Ja-yeong.

episodeGuide.title: Moments of Coincidence
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-kyung becomes flustered upon seeing Yoon-ju, Daniel's birthmother, after Daniel's performance. She leaves the venue, leaving the family to have a good time. Jin-ho plans to buy a campground, so he visits it with Ja-yeong. Then he tells his kids that he'll sell the house, which leaves Jun-seo dumbfounded.

episodeGuide.title: What Spring Means
episodeGuide.summary: Even after listing the house, Jin-ho is torn, thinking it's a shame to sell the house filled with his children's memories. Do-hyun comes up with an idea that would stop Jin-ho from selling the house and living together with Jun-kyung. Meanwhile, Yoon-ju visits Jun-kyung at her workplace, hinting that she could get back with Do-hyun.

episodeGuide.title: Finding Your Own Way Out
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-kyung feels conflicted after seeing Do-hyun leave his studio with Yoon-ju. Despite that, Do-hyun decides to propose to Jun-kyung. Jin-ho invites all his family to the campground, and they have a nice bonding time. Meanwhile, Jun-kyung and Do-hyun visit an OB-GYN, and they receive shocking news.

episodeGuide.title: When Life Tests You
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-kyung ends up asking Yoon-ju if Daniel is Do-hyun's biological son. She regrets it immediately, thinking she's hurt everyone. Ja-yeong gets diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, devastating Jin-ho. Meanwhile, Do-hyun secretly gets a DNA test done on himself and Daniel.

episodeGuide.title: Learning to Be Brave in Love
episodeGuide.summary: Ja-yeong sees Jin-ho struggling, so she decides to leave him and admit herself to a nursing home. Daniel finds out that Do-hyun isn't his biological father and becomes dejected. Yoon-ju decides to leave Korea with Daniel. Meanwhile, the family holds a birthday party for Ja-yeong, and she confesses that she has Alzheimer's disease.

title: Sexual Lessons
overview: After a harsh breakup, Seong-ho seeks skinship lessons to understand what went wrong—only to find his tutor is a man. What begins as a lesson in touch soon turns into something deeper, blurring the lines between teacher and student, friendship and something more.

title: My Youth
overview: Sunwoo Hae was a popular child actor, who shined in his youth. Due to the greed of the adults around him, he lost his shining light. He barely made it through the turmoil and now lives peacefully as a novelist and florist. Suddenly, Seong Je Yeon appears in front of him. Sunwoo Hae and Seong Je Yeon were each other's first love and they helped each other get through the darkest times of their lives. They reunite after 10 years. The appearance of Je Yeon also reminds him of his past. Meanwhile, Je Yeon works as a team leader for Feel Entertainment. She grew up in a wealthy family, without any worries, but her family suddenly fell into ruin. She now lives more fiercely than anyone else around her. She is driven by reality and only looks for success in her life. To achieve her goal, she finds Sunwoo Hae, who was her first love, and breaks his peace. As she gets involved with him, she also experiences change by confronting her innocent past self.

episodeGuide.title: The Reunion
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Sung Je-yeon begins to look for Sun Woo-hae, the former child actor who has left the scene, to secure a role for her talent, Mo Tae-rin, on TV. She visits Woo-hae's flower shop and reunites with her first love from high school after 15 years, while also being tasked with finding the mysterious novelist, Jin Mu-yeong, for Producer Je-il.

episodeGuide.title: The Parting
episodeGuide.summary: As Je-yeon and Woo-hae share drinks, they reminisce about when Woo-hae first transferred to Je-yeon's high school as a student talented in writing. As the class president, Je-yeon looked out for Woo-hae and began to fall for him. However, due to his complicated familial circumstances and his responsibility to care for Eun Nu-ri, Hae failed to properly reciprocate her love.

episodeGuide.title: Beat and Bebop
episodeGuide.summary: Woo-hae accepts Je-yeon's offer, and Tae-rin and Woo-hae finally reunite for their two-part documentary. As they reminisce about their days as Beat and Bebop, the former national siblings, Je-yeon is tasked with creating a buzz for Tae-rin, who is starting to fade in the industry. However, an article is released regarding Woo-hae's past, causing chaos.

episodeGuide.title: On the Island
episodeGuide.summary: Even after his videos cause a stir, Woo-hae decides to continue with the shoot. The crew heads to an island to shoot a scene of Woo-hae and Tae-rin on the beach. However, the ferries are cancelled due to bad weather, and Woo-hae and Je-yeon happen to stay the night on the island with just one vacant room remaining and no other staff members around.

episodeGuide.title: Finding Jin Mu-yeong
episodeGuide.summary: After their kiss, Woo-hae and Je-yeon grow awkward as Je-yeon is unsure about her feelings. Meanwhile, Tae-rin and Seok-ju reminisce about their high school days together. As Feel Entertainment looks for the mysterious author, Jin Mu-yeong, to renew their license of the novel, "World Made of Ash," Je-yeon steps up for the task.

episodeGuide.title: Je-yeon’s Feelings
episodeGuide.summary: Je-yeon is confused about her emotions toward Woo-hae, and Tae-rin doesn't know how she feels around Seok-ju. Woo-hae and Seok-ju continue their brotherhood amid the awkwardness between them and Pil-do. Meanwhile, Woo-hae gets an extra checkup as an anomaly shows up in his blood work, and the results come out at the worst possible time.

episodeGuide.title: Woo-hae’s Misfortune
episodeGuide.summary: Both Je-yeon and Tae-rin develop feelings for their own love interest, and Je-yeon decides to take her shot with the perfect plan. However, things start to go awry as Je-yeon loses her job, and Woo-hae misses his date with Je-yeon as he collapses and is sent to the ER.

episodeGuide.title: Woo-hae and Je-yeon’s Paths
episodeGuide.summary: Upon hearing that Woo-hae is ill, Je-yeon feels lost and returns to her parents' home. Meanwhile, Woo-hae doesn't want to hurt Je-yeon and tries to distance himself from her. He also prepares for the worst and becomes cold to Nu-ri and demands that she meet her birth mother and reconcile.

episodeGuide.title: Between Decisions
episodeGuide.summary: When Jae-yeon is rushed into surgery, Woo-hae searches through hospitals to find her. Meanwhile, Nu-ri prepares for her photography practical exam while struggling with the decision of whether or not to meet her birth mother. Tae-rin unexpectedly crosses paths with Seok-ju.

episodeGuide.title: Facing the Truth
episodeGuide.summary: Woo-hae, whose health is deteriorating, hides his condition while growing closer to Je-yeon. Meanwhile, Nu-ri feels conflicted as she takes her practical exam and prepares to meet her birth mother. Seok-ju discovers Woo-hae's illness, leaving him in shock and guilt. Woo-hae is urged to join a clinical trial, forcing him to face the reality of his condition.

episodeGuide.title: Ordinary Days
episodeGuide.summary: Woo-hae and Je-yeon decide to spend their time as an ordinary couple, not thinking about the hardships that might come to them. Tae-rin and Seok-ju still need to adjust to each other, but their affections grow as they do so. Woo-hae is scared about his future, but for now, he tries to live an ordinary life like everyone else.

episodeGuide.title: New Book
episodeGuide.summary: Woo-hae's family and friends find out about Woo-hae's condition. Woo-hae says that he doesn't want to leave the people he loves to get treatment, but everyone, including Je-yeon insists and tells him to do so. Woo-hae is away, but everyone is living their lives to the fullest. Je-yeon takes care of the flower shop while Woo-hae is away. Meanwhile, Woo-hae's new book has finally been published.

title: The 4th Love Revolution
overview: A youth romance that takes place when the Department of Computer Engineering and the Department of Modeling are merged.

title: Share house
overview: Yun Su, a new resident from Cheonan, moves into a shared house and tries to hide his identity, but his roommate, Ha Jin, catches him out, sparking a delicate emotional battle. Through punishment dates and casual flirtations, the two move beyond pranks and threats, becoming drawn to each other. However, Ha Jin's sudden departure and public confession spark a conflict, forcing Yun Su to choose between secrecy and honesty.

title: Connect
overview: TRUE FILM's BL web drama

title: Prince Barbershop
overview: Gyu-hyun and Ji-seok run the beloved Prince Barbershop. With their handsome looks and outstanding skills, they've gained quite the following. But when the adorable and charming Eun-seok shows up, a tug-of-war of love begins between the three.

title: Heavenly Ever After
overview: Upon arriving in heaven at the age of 80, Hae Sook reunites with her rejuvenated husband, Nak Joon, leading to a romance that transcends their earthly lives.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Devoted to caring for her beloved Ko Nak-joon, Lee Hae-sook performs a detested job daily. But when he passes, she prepares to meet him again in Heaven.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Upon reuniting with the young Nak-joon, Hae-sook struggles to get used to their age gap. Furthermore, she finds herself haunted by a mysterious woman.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: The arrival of a mysterious, beautiful woman looking for Nak-joon upends Hae-sook's bliss. Later, Hae-sook embarks on a journey to revisit her past.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-sook slowly gains sympathy for Som-i, thinking that she reminds her of someone dear. Later, Hae-sook and her pastor welcome a new attendee.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: After receiving another infraction, Hae‑sook descends into Hell, where she encounters a familiar face. Nak‑joon makes his way into Hell to save her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: As Hae‑sook suddenly returns to Heaven with Lee Young‑ae, Som‑i questions her own identity. Soon, Hae‑sook meets folks whose lives she impacted on Earth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Overwhelmed by nagging anxiety, Hae-sook welcomes an intimidating guest. Som-i tries to make sense of the ominous man she's been seeing in her visions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-sook throws herself into church life as tension at home mounts. Som-i begins to experience forbidden emotions while trying to regain her memories.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Nak-joon wonders if his past is connected to Som-i's memories. Young-ae encounters an unwelcome man in Heaven — sending her into a panic.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Som-i reveals a strange memory to Nak-joon, triggering a deeply buried trauma. Hae-sook enters Heaven's Lotto Festival, hoping to help Young-ae.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Som-i's agonizing memories and ties with Nak-joon begin to turn into resentment toward Hae-sook — but she soon learns her memories aren't what they seem.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: After weathering their biggest storm in Heaven, Nak-joon and Hae-sook face a special opportunity — but Nak-joon carries a heavy truth.

title: No Dating at Boarding School
overview: Set in a strict boarding school, the coming-of-age romance follows students searching for love and identity.

title: Dead-End Job
overview: Dead-End Job follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.

episodeGuide.title: Convenience Store Rules
episodeGuide.summary: In debt and out of options, Byeon Hyeok-jun accepts a suspicious convenience store job paying 50 times minimum wage — and quickly learns why.

episodeGuide.title: A Journey with a Pierrot
episodeGuide.summary: Scared and confused after his last job, Hyeok-jun is now offered a new opportunity with one bizarre rule: Never lose sight of the clown.

episodeGuide.title: Milkman Vlog
episodeGuide.summary: Hyeok-jun swears off risky jobs — until a milk delivery gig pays 200 times minimum wage. This time, he's fully prepared for whatever comes his way.

episodeGuide.title: Midnight Fantasy Cinema
episodeGuide.summary: After learning about Hyeok-jun's new job and the agency, his sister Ji-yoon's curiosity leads her to a night shift where her worst fears come to life.

episodeGuide.title: Clinical Trial
episodeGuide.summary: Posing as another applicant, Hyeok-jun joins a clinical trial where an unexpected encounter with his friend turns the job into a rescue mission.

episodeGuide.title: The Walls Don't Talk
episodeGuide.summary: With more questions than answers, Hyeok-jun accepts a night-shift job at a construction site and uncovers the real horror behind the mysterious agency.

episodeGuide.title: Neo World After Dark
episodeGuide.summary: Warned that this final gig will be unlike any before it, Hyeok-jun joins a fairy-tale parade at a theme park where the answers he seeks await.

episodeGuide.title: Last Carnival
episodeGuide.summary: A nightmarish carnival brings everyone together as Hyeok-jun faces a life-changing decision. Can he finally quit his dead-end job for good?

title: Teach You a Lesson
overview: When respect collapses in schools, a special unit arrives to set things right — with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Inspector Na Hwa-jin steps into the chaos and takes control of a school plagued by the spoiled son of a powerful politician — to teach him a lesson.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: With unassuming Bong Geun-dae on his side, Hwa-jin uses his special ops skills to handle a school gang and defend a student who just wants to study.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: When a teen influencer spreads false claims about her teachers, the team's loose-cannon Inspector Im Han-rim steps in to set the record straight.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Choi Gang-seok weathers a political attack on his bureau. Hwa-jin's team visits an elite school to uncover why a student attacked a respected teacher.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: When an elementary school teacher's spirit wears down under pressure, Hwa-jin steps in to be her substitute — turning the tables to solve the case.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Four juvenile delinquents think they're above the law — until the team takes an interest in their extracurricular crimes and gives a harsh reality check.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Geun-dae goes undercover to help a father find his gambling addict son. To undermine the bureau politically, Hwang Gi-tae visits a juvenile inmate.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: After a pre-med student collapses in class, Hwa-jin investigates his obsessive mother, whose access to illicit pills hints at a larger conspiracy.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: To help a student escape his exploitative friends, Han-rim adopts a new persona to join his circle. Cho Gyu-cheol's return puts the bureau in danger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: After public backlash hits the bureau, Hwa-jin and his team go rogue to expose a deadly conspiracy led by a violent student-run gang.

title: The Remarried Empress
overview: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Sovieshu and Navier's lives are flipped upside down when runaway slave Rashta enters the palace.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Sovieshu's actions shake Navier as Prince Heinrey's upcoming arrival stirs excitement in the palace.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: As the New Year's Ceremony begins, Rashta grows bolder, and Heinrey's arrival heightens tension.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: As Navier and Heinrey grow closer, Rashta plots to throw the palace into chaos.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: As Navier and Heinrey grow closer, a subtle shift happens in their relationship.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: As Sovieshu and Navier share a rare moment alone, unexpected news arrives.

title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: On her first day at the hospital, Gye Su-jeong quickly ruffles feathers when she weighs in on an upcoming surgery — only to jump in when a crisis arises.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Faced with two pancreatic cancer patients — a wealthy chairman and a teenager — hospital staff clash over who to prioritize. But Su-jeong wastes no time.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: The hospital staff grow suspicious of Su-jeong's past. When a cleaner suddenly collapses, Su-jeong must make a decision as no surgeon is available.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After a new surgeon arrives at the hospital, Jang Hui-suk and Su-jeong keep a close eye on him. Meanwhile, a pharmaceutical rep suffers an emergency.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jeong makes a disturbing discovery about Na Dae-il and a patient. As her colleagues debate their next move, she gets a chance to make him pay.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: A patient struggling with trauma from an old brain injury refuses surgery, pushing Su-jeong and her team to convince him to undergo treatment.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jeong remains determined to save her patient, but a sudden disappearance complicates matters. A VIP code-blue crisis hits the hospital.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: A young patient with an extreme diagnosis catches Su-jeong's attention. Hospital director Bu Seung-gwon remains doubtful of Su-jeong's true identity.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jeong attempts a bold, unprecedented surgery to save Lee Hyeon-a's life. But when no one agrees to assist, Su-jeong calls for some unexpected backup.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: With assistance, Su-jeong's risky surgery moves forward, earning the admiration of her fellow doctors. Later, someone from her past unexpectedly reappears.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Gye Su-jeong faces her past when a girl arrives at the hospital, while Park Tae-gyeong begs her to fail surgery amid a growing conspiracy surrounding the Magnolia network.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As past abuse and Baraka's fire surface, Gye Su-jeong fights to save Bu Seung-gwon and expose the hospital's corrupt "White Mafia."

title: Perfect Crown
overview: Welcome to 21st-century Korea, a constitutional monarchy where tradition and modernity intertwine in style, and glamour masks a rigid social hierarchy. Seong Huiju, a brilliant chaebol heiress and CEO, seems to have everything. Yet as a commoner by birth, she is always denied the respect she deserves. When her family begins relentlessly pushing her toward future marriage prospects, Huiju grows determined to take control of her own future after she crosses paths with Grand Prince lan at the Imperial Birthday Banquet. She has everything but status, whereas he has nothing but status. Together, they enter a contract marriage of the century. But can they break societal barriers and carve out their own destinies?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: After a chance encounter with Grand Prince I-an, chaebol heiress Seong Huiju schemes to rise higher.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Huiju is pushed to meet with potential suitors. Grand Prince I-an considers accepting her proposal.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: A secret rendezvous scandal rocks the royal family, and Grand Prince I-an makes a public statement.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: When Huiju moves into Grand Prince I-an's residence and proves to be a handful, a conspiracy awaits…

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: As Huiju digs for the truth, Grand Prince I-an distances himself thinking it is safer to stay away.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: The celebrated pair makes a dazzling return at the banquet, waltzing and professing their fake love.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: With the wedding looming, everyone begins to realize a strange turn in the couple's relationship.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: The 21st-century Grand Prince's wife arrives. Amid cheers and wary eyes, two men make a bold choice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Facing a political crisis, the couple choose to fight to protect one another, each in their own way.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Others step in for the couple who struggle to be honest, and a new era begins to stir at the court.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Like that day, fire engulfs Council Hall. Huiju protects Grand Prince I-an while fighting an enemy.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: No barrier is unbreakable, only those who wish it so. Can they leap beyond and shape their destiny?

title: Road
overview: The original work is the Korean-Japanese co-produced comic "Blue Road." The original story follows Korean detective Kang Cheong-do and Japanese detective Ino Se as they investigate bizarre murders that occurred in both Korea and Japan.

title: Love in Disguise
overview: An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover. Yun I Jun is a quirky third-generation chaebol raised in a sheltered environment who becomes a prime suspect in the mysterious murder of his previous secretary. When a new "male" secretary arrives to take the position, he has no idea that she's hiding a major secret. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae Hui, a former special forces officer turned police officer renowned as a "human weapon" for her exceptional strength and combat skills, disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yun I Jun's personal secretary and bodyguard. While protecting him, she secretly investigates him, setting the stage for unexpected chemistry, hidden identities, and plenty of comedic tension.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is suspected of murdering his secretary, but the group's power and lack of evidence impede the investigation. To find key evidence, special forces-turned-detective Kang Jae-hee applies to be his secretary, not as a woman but as a man! She manages to get the job, but Yi-jun doesn't let his guard down. Jae-hee risks getting exposed on her first day at work.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Jae-hee's double life begins. She's Yoon Yi-jun's secretary by day and a detective by night. Yi-jun keeps testing her, but Jae-hee relentlessly keeps an eye on him and searches for the missing phone. She plans to infiltrate the room that's banned from entering, but Yi-jun doesn't let his guard down easily. Their relationship takes a strange turn through unexpected physical contact.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-jun stays prickly but starts trusting Jae-hee. Jae-hee notices something suspicious about the milk Yi-jun was drinking and realizes he is being threatened. The investigating team thinks the perpetrator could be someone else. Jae-hee finally gets the chance to enter the room that's been banned from entering. She searches for the missing phone in the room but immediately faces danger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: The investigating team finds traces of herbicide in the milk and suspects that someone is after Yi-jun. Jae-hee keeps an eye on Yoon Na-jung, the ambitious second daughter of Taekang, and follows Yi-jun to the family dinner, which is full of tension. Chairman Yoon makes an unexpected decision, causing a stir. Jae-hee joins Yi-jun for a drink and her drinking habit starts coming out.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-hee can't remember what happened the previous night and is anxious if Yi-jun is crabby because he got wind of her true identity while drunk. What's worse, Yi-jun's fiancée, Lee Si-a, returns from France. Yi-jun feels confused but stays cold toward Jae-hee, and Jae-hee is upset when Yi-jun goes to have dinner with Si-a. After much searching, Jae-hee finally gets hold of the key evidence.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-jun kisses Jae-hee but insists that he sees Jae-hee as a little brother and continues to nitpick. Meanwhile, the investigating team summons Hye-jung as a witness, shocking Yi-jun and Si-hyun. To make matters worse, Chairman Yoon is putting pressure on Yi-jun as well. Overwhelmed by the pressure and confusion, Yi-jun pushes away Jae-hee, who eventually has enough and says she will quit.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-jun acknowledges his feelings as unrequited love. Jae-hee returns as his secretary and is confused as Yi-jun is suddenly being nice to her. Si-a's presence makes them keep their distance from each other. Hye-jung gets involved in the investigation on Han Eun-young's death, and she reveals she is being threatened and followed. The culprit is on the move, and Yi-jun and Jae-hee fall into danger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-jun can no longer hide his feelings for Jae-hee, but Jae-hee must keep her identity hidden until the culprit is found. In order to quell the rumors about them, Jae-hee goes on a blind date with a female Taekang employee. Unable to hold back, Yi-jun confesses, but Jae-hee turns him down despite feeling the same way. On the way to the memorial service, they face their greatest danger yet.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-jun feels betrayed that the person he was closest to lied to him. Jae-hee tries to apologize to him but is unable to get the chance. Meanwhile, the culprit dies behind bars. A photo of Yi-jun and Jae-hee kissing is leaked, causing a stir. Yi-jun writes a prenuptial agreement with Si-a to stop the furious chairman. Yi-jun reveals something unexpected in front of the journalists.

title: 100 Days of Deception
overview: Set in Gyeongseong during the Japanese colonial period, the drama follows Ga Gyeong, the city's most talented pickpocket, who strikes a dangerous deal with the independence army and goes undercover at the Japanese Government-General of Joseon. Disguised as an employee, she is tasked with acting as a "fake spy" for just 100 days, but her mission slowly turns her into a real informant caught between survival, loyalty, and conviction.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Pickpocket Lee Ga-kyung has just one goal — to flee colonial Joseon. But she soon ends up unexpectedly entangled with the Korean independence movement.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Ga-kyung's language skills shock Yoo Philip and Yoo So-ran. Meanwhile, Kim Tae-ung's insistence that Ga-kyung return his wallet raises her suspicions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Despite Ga-kyung's initial reservations about So-ran, the two join hands. On her first day at work undercover, Ga-kyung meets a familiar face.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-ung remains suspicious of Ga-kyung, but also strangely captivated — or even charmed? Meanwhile, the Gugukdan start making big plans.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Asked to translate for an interrogation, Ga-kyung struggles when she recognizes the man being questioned. Tae-ung's feelings grow increasingly conflicted.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Sato Shinichi confronts his past. As the interrogation escalates, so do Ga-kyung's fears — leading her to find unexpected solace in Tae-ung.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-ung confides in Ga-kyung about his hidden family past, bringing the two closer together. Meanwhile, Ga-kyung makes some discoveries of her own.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Fuzzy about the details of their shared night out, Ga-kyung finds herself flustered in Tae-ung's presence. Later, Tae-ung faces some harsh truths.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: The Gugukdan set their grand plan in motion. Ga-kyung musters up the courage to be honest about her feelings — only for Tae-ung to keep his distance.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: As the Gugukdan comes up against Sato, Tae-ung is forced to witness his father's cruelty first-hand. Ga-kyung has a change of heart.

title: Agent Kim Reactivated
overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Kim, an ordinary middle-aged man who gets grabbed by the collar even by the neighborhood thugs. His estranged daughter Minji suddenly disappears just before her birthday. Manager Kim sets out to find Minji.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Frantic to find where Min-ji is, Manager Kim uses his skills from his days as Agent Kim — a secret agent who specialized in ruthless enemy takedowns.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Kim reconnects with Sung Han-soo and Park Jin-cheol — his fellow dad friends (and former secret agents) — on his search for Min-ji.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Kim's risky actions put him on the radar of enemies past and present. When danger strikes, Han-soo and Jin-cheol step up to help save the day.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Kim trades blows with the enemy agent chasing him — only to realize he is an old friend. Meanwhile, Min-ji attempts an escape of her own.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Min-ji finds herself in a dire situation — until special agent Jung Sang-a shows up. The Special Missions Directorate tries to lure out Manager Kim.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Kim and Min-ji finally reunite, but the path to safety is far from smooth. Later, Manager Kim is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Manager Kim is captured and tortured — until the Special Missions Directorate steps in with a final mission. Ju Gang-chan makes a plan to get revenge.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: As the inter-Korean talks faced the threat of collapse, Kim faced a desperate crisis under pressure from the special bureau led by Minji.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Three people who go from comrades to enemies to protect their loved ones. Can they truly protect those who are precious?

title: Take Charge of My Heart
overview: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Na Bo-bae is a struggling writer — and human electrical conductor. Suddenly, she bumps into Baek Ho-rang, the first person who's immune to her sparks.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: When Ho-rang realizes that Bo-bae's strange powers could be the solution to his heart-battery needs, he tries to make her an offer she can't refuse.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Ho-rang and Bo-bae become roommates and make things official. As per their contract, they go on their first date for Bo-bae's romance research.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-bae ends up as Ho-rang's personal assistant. After a tense birthday lunch with his family, Ho-rang is moved by Bo-bae's simple surprise.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Han Seol-hee comes to Ho-rang with a marriage proposal, but he makes his disinterest clear. Meanwhile, Ji Eun-ho tries to draw closer to Bo-bae.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-bae impresses with her writing skills, but seeing Bo-bae and Eun-ho's bond up close ignites jealous sparks within Ho-rang. Eun-ho makes a bold move.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Worried about endangering yet another person she cares about, Bo-bae keeps her distance from Ho-rang. Do-yoon and Seol-hee's schemes come to a head.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-bae and Ho-rang finally start dating. Ho-rang prepares for his succession announcement — but on the day of the event, Bo-bae is nowhere to be found.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Ho-rang's collapse puts him in serious danger — until Bo-bae arrives in the nick of time. But she soon finds out a dangerous truth about her powers.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: When Bo-bae learns her powers may be gone, she wonders what it means for her — and her future with Ho-rang. Will her story have a happy ending after all?

title: The East Palace
overview: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: After a mysterious death, the king summons the spirit slayer Gu-cheon to banish the pond spirit. Saeng-gang, who hears the dead, also appears before him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: After a close call while pursuing the pond spirit, Gu-cheon makes a pact with Saeng-gang. Later, they uncover the truth behind the salt storehouse ghost.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: The king orders Gu-cheon to save the prince — or die. Forced to enter the spirit realm, he comes face-to-face with the ghost of a former royal guard.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang attempt to seal the pond spirit for good. Still suspicious about the crown princes' deaths, Gu-cheon returns to Saeng-gang.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Gu-cheon escapes danger with Saeng-gang's help. As the king falls ill, Gu-cheon fights the evil spirit — only for a guardian spirit to stand in his way.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: During Gu-cheon's fight, Saeng-gang comes under threat — bringing them closer to the truth. But Gu-cheon loses his sight, putting their mission at risk.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: The king and queen dowager clash over the tragedies as resentful spirits close in. Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang steel themselves for a final confrontation.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Chaos engulfs the palace as the vengeful spirit moves to devour everything in its path. Can Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang stop him before it's too late?

title: Between Steps
overview: Depicts the romance between a man who once was a swimmer but lost his left leg to illness and a woman who, after losing her way as a medical resident, finds a new path as a graduate student. Park Min Jae, a man who lost his promising swimming career and his left leg to osteosarcoma. After hitting rock bottom, he discovers a new purpose in robotics. Four years of dedication pay off when he is accepted into the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Seoul National University. He hides his sensitivity behind a nonchalant facade, but he's actually just a simple guy who has dating on his bucket list. Im Yu Jin, who is on the verge of graduating from the Department of Clothing and Textiles when she gets caught up in an incident and fails in her attempt to enter graduate school; she then becomes fascinated by robotics and enrolls in a master's program in mechanical engineering.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: As Minjae seeks love, an unexpected incident reunites him with Youjin, a stranger he met before.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Youjin wants to go to grad school and asks Minjae for help. Will she make it into the robotics lab?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Yoo-jin begins adjusting to life in the robotics lab but immediately clashes with fellow student Se-jin.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After learning something unexpected about Min-jae, Yu-jin can no longer ignore her growing feelings, creating an awkward tension between them.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Park Min-jae and Im Yoo-jin (Eugene) as they navigate their deepening feelings after their kiss.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Park Min-jae and Im Yu-jin as they attempt to navigate the early, complicated stages of their new relationship.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Min-jae and Yoo-jin struggle to hide their romance as rumors spread. When Se-jin unexpectedly returns, past insecurities surface, forcing the couple to confront their doubts and test the strength of their trust.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Min-jae is forced to choose between a career opportunity abroad and his feelings for Yoo-jin. As outside opposition threatens their relationship, the couple faces a high-stakes crossroads that tests their commitment.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Min-jae returns to Korea after a year, sparking a tense reunion with Yoo-jin, who declares their romance is over while past secrets start to unravel.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Jihoon reveals his feelings for Youjin. At a welcome party, she runs into Minjae, now a professor.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: As Minjae struggles with his lingering feelings for Youjin, she suddenly appears before him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Now it is Minjae's turn to make a move. But the two must once again face their most dreaded choice.

title: My Royal Nemesis
overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

cast.name: Im Ji Yun
cast.character: Sin Seo Ri / Kang Dan Sim

episodeGuide.title: The Vixen and the Beast
episodeGuide.summary: Royal Concubine Kang Dan-sim is sentenced to death by poison. But when she wakes, she finds herself in a very different place: modern-day Korea.

episodeGuide.title: A Guide to Optimizing Your Fate
episodeGuide.summary: As Dan-sim tries to adapt to the new world, her strange ways attract the attention of chaebol heir Cha Se-gye — who approaches her with a proposal.

episodeGuide.title: A Whole New Reality
episodeGuide.summary: Se-gye finds he can't stop thinking about Shin Seo-ri — especially after a weird dream sparks some foreign emotions within him.

episodeGuide.title: Beyond Understanding
episodeGuide.summary: Dan-sim learns more about Seo-ri's past. As Se-gye and Seo-ri spend more time together, mixed signals push them to put their feelings to the test.

episodeGuide.title: Forbidden Fruit
episodeGuide.summary: Confused by Seo-ri's mind games, Se-gye pulls out all the stops to win her heart. Later, Seo-ri deals with a pesky co-star & politics on set.

episodeGuide.title: One Magical Night
episodeGuide.summary: Seo-ri & Se-gye fly out to Jeju, but an emergency leaves Se-gye rattled. Later, Seo-ri goes missing & a worried Se-gye heads out in search of her.

episodeGuide.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
episodeGuide.summary: Seo-ri's feelings for Se-gye grow, but she starts having doubts when Mo Tae-hee stakes her claim on Se-gye as well. Suddenly, Se-gye runs into trouble.

episodeGuide.title: Screw This World
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-hee announces her engagement to Se-gye to the press, angering Se-gye and fueling Seo-ri's jealousy. Choi Mun-do threatens Seo-ri with a demand.

episodeGuide.title: That's First Love for You
episodeGuide.summary: Se-gye confronts Seo-ri about her identity — who is Dan-sim? Forced to face her past, Seo-ri makes up her mind about her relationship with Se-gye.

episodeGuide.title: Hope, Despair, and Longing
episodeGuide.summary: With the link between Seo-ri and Dan-sim revealed, Se-gye and Dan-sim make things official. A furious Mun-do goes to extreme lengths to take revenge.

episodeGuide.title: What Lies on the Hidden Path
episodeGuide.summary: Dan-sim wakes to find herself back in the Joseon era. While she tries to return to the present, Se-gye deals with the fallout from Mun-do's scheming.

episodeGuide.title: Reclaiming Lost Time
episodeGuide.summary: Dan-sim and Seo-ri's worlds start to collide. Se-gye takes Dan-sim to meet someone important to him, but she reveals that they're running out of time.

title: A Bona Fide Killer
overview: Ordinary working mom Yu Bo Na is secretly the legendary assassin Kingfisher, who eliminates criminals beyond the reach of the law. Returning to work after three years of maternity leave, she resumes a perilous double life, balancing work, childcare, housework, and assassinations. As her missions grow more dangerous, a detective hunting a mysterious killer and a husband beginning to suspect the truth threaten to expose her secret. From school drop-offs to taking down criminals, every moment is a high-wire act with no room to slip up. The instant her true identity surfaces, she stands to lose everything. Can Yu Bo Na keep her identity hidden and protect both worlds as a loving wife and mother to her family and a ruthless killer to her targets?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-na, Tae-sung, and their four-year-old daughter Yul are a typical happy and harmonious family. After a three-year parental leave, Bo-na returns to work and successfully completes her duties from day one, defying concerns. Meanwhile, Tae-sung, covering a drug case, learns a serial killer who disappeared four years ago has returned.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-sung and the police are surprised by Kingfisher's return and resolve to finally apprehend Kingfisher for good this time. Tae-sung seeks information from Detective Dong-jin, who previously pursued Kingfisher. Meanwhile, a new employee appears at Bo-na's company, seemingly harboring an unknown secret.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Hyun-nam tells Bo-na why she came to Durumi Electronics to find her. A Sales Team workshop takes place, and Bo-na spends time away from Tae-sung and Yul for the first time since her marriage. While enjoying an unexpectedly pleasant time, an unforeseen incident occurs at the accommodation.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: As Bo-na keeps working, Yul starts whining, and Bo-na struggles with balancing childcare and work. Meanwhile, people are enraged by child sex offender Pyo Gyu-cheol's release after serving his sentence. Tae-sung meets Dong-jin who is tracking Pyo Gyu-cheol. Dong-jin believes Pyo Gyu-cheol could be Kingfisher's new target.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-na, knowing today is Tae-sung's family's memorial day, takes a half-day off and leaves early. She does her best, but her mother-in-law's berating continues. Misunderstandings build as Tae-sung helps her after work, leading to an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Tae-sung begins investigating the suspicious death of a construction worker.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-na and her team travel to a Gangwon Province casino to prepare for a Client Meeting. When their plans hit a snag, Bo-na must step in for the Meeting herself. Tae-sung, investigating a construction worker's death, heads to the casino where Bo-na is, while probing the construction company's Chairman. Meanwhile, suspicious individuals appear around Bo-na's Meeting target.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Eight years ago, in World Cup-feverish Seoul, Bo-na's team holds a Meeting hidden. In the same building, chasing a pickpocket, Tae-sung attacked, collapsing. Bo-na finds him, calls 119. Four months later, Tae-sung awakens, meets Bo-na, falls for her. Bo-na, exhausted by her 16-year mission, plans to quit.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: After discharge, Tae-sung retreats to a secluded mountain lodge, where he coincidentally reunites with Bo-na. Heavy snow isolates them, and only the two stay at the lodge for a while. Sharing food and enduring the cold, they open their hearts and start to love. Meanwhile, released vicious criminals, fearing Kingfisher, try to return to prison.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Sergei, Bo-na's childhood friend and a mercenary from Russia, reappears, and the truth of The Gosiwon Case in Haegong-dong from four years ago begins to surface. Bo-na investigates Sergei's return to Korea. Meanwhile, Dong-jin learns that Jang Eun-hak, the culprit who murdered his parents, has been paroled.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Monitoring paroled Jang Eun-hak, Dong-jin thwarts his renewed attempt at murder. A chase ensues, and Jang Eun-hak is eventually stopped by Kingfisher. This event prompts Tae-sung to resume writing articles about Kingfisher. Bo-na, despite her worries about these changes, decides to continue her own work.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-jin recalls that Tae-sung's assailant and Kingfisher were in the same building in the past. He immediately proceeds with an interview with the assailant, during which he obtains a clue that Kingfisher might be a woman. Meanwhile, Bo-na catches her mother-in-law's Voice Phishing culprit and receives recognition from her mother-in-law. Although the family becomes harmonious, Tae-sung's anxiety steadily intensifies.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Bo-na's painful orphanage childhood surfaces, hinting at a past forged by violence and silence. Tae-sung faces a growing dilemma as doubts about someone close to him become harder to ignore. The task force closes in with a bold new lead, but an unseen hand seems to always stay one step ahead. What Tae-sung uncovers may destroy everything he loves.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: A new murder case occurs, and it confuses the police, but they are sure that it was done by Kingfisher. Bo-na realizes she's framed, and the real culprit is Leila, her old colleague who is resentful toward Bo-na for past condemnation. The appearance of Leila makes Bo-na fearful for her family's safety.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: Leila is identified as Kingfisher, but inconsistencies arise. Meanwhile, Bo-na realizes that Tae-sung knew about her identity as Kingfisher. He confesses his love, but she leaves. During her absence, Tae-sung tries to clear Kingfisher's name, shifting public opinion. He finds Bo-na, convinces her to reconcile, promising to learn her completely.

title: Sacred Jewel
overview: In 1258, amid thirty years of relentless Mongol invasions, the Emperor commands elite warriors to retrieve the Sacred Jewel, a divine relic protecting the kingdom. The warriors break through Mongolian lines and journey toward the eastern sea in search of the legendary relic.

title: Final Table
overview: Follows Choi Song I, the new manager of a family restaurant, who must step up to take charge after her father's sudden death. In a bid to save the restaurant, she becomes entangled in a fierce cooking competition alongside Kang Han, also known as "Chris K", a renowned overseas chef. Their journey brings them head-to-head with Cha U Jin, a perfectionist chef and Kang Han's fiercest rival, whose relentless ambition drives the intense rivalry. At the center of the competition is Seon Jeong Won, the executive producer of The Table: K Chef 2026, who orchestrates the high-stakes event to crown Korea's top chef. As the chefs compete, their personal stories and ambitions unfold, creating a dynamic and dramatic showdown of culinary mastery.

title: A Love Other Than Yours
overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

episodeGuide.title: Will Ten Years Together End in Marriage or a Breakup?
episodeGuide.summary: Namgung and Mi-do first met at the age of seven and began dating at twenty-six. Now in their tenth year together, the love they once believed would last forever begins to buckle under the weight of time. As their relationship changes, they are forced to confront the realities of love and life.

episodeGuide.title: Can We Ever Be Strangers?
episodeGuide.summary: After ten years together, Mi-do and Namgung are struggling with their break up. Not even a romantic couples event can rekindle the spark between them, yet memories of the love they once shared keep pulling them back.

episodeGuide.title: Can We Feel That Spark Again?
episodeGuide.summary: Namgung and Mi-do announce their marriage to their families and try to rekindle the spark between them. Mi-do's decision to step down as director puts her at odds with Tae-seung, while Namgung repeatedly clashes with Su-a as she investigates a sweet potato corruption scandal. As they spend more time with other people, Namgung and Mi-do begin to question whether their relationship can survive.

episodeGuide.title: Are We Dreaming the Same Dream?
episodeGuide.summary: As news of the season's first snowfall spreads, Namgung and Su-a's shared past comes to light. Mi-do accepts Tae-seung's offer to return to directing, while Namgung refuses to help Su-a investigate a sweet potato corruption scandal. The four find themselves swept up in a whirlwind of complicated feelings.

episodeGuide.title: Are There Any Untold Stories Between Us?
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-do is shocked after waking up at Tae-seung's office. Meanwhile, Namgung notices a mysterious caller on Mi-do's phone and becomes uneasy. As always, the two pretend everything is fine for each other's sake. But the more they try to protect the relationship, the deeper their secrets become.

episodeGuide.title: Who Is Our Best Hero?
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-do deeply regrets what happened that day. Meanwhile, Namgung plans something to cheer her up. But unexpected visitors at his workplace push things in an unforeseen direction.

episodeGuide.title: Are We Allies or Enemies?
episodeGuide.summary: Namgung learns the truth about what happened that day, and the deep trust between the couple begins to unravel. Meanwhile, pressured by Ju-hyeok, Tae-seung makes an unexpected decision as his feelings for Mi-do deepen. At the same time, Su-a relentlessly pursues Namgung while investigating the sweet potato corruption scandal.

episodeGuide.title: What Remains of Our Passionate Love?
episodeGuide.summary: Namgung and Mi-do confront emotions they have long suppressed for each other's sake. As their pain pulls them in different directions, they come up with a bold proposal that could upend their relationship.

episodeGuide.title: Do You Remember When We Fell in Love?
episodeGuide.summary: Mi-do tells her family she is quitting directing. Meanwhile, she and Namgung begin dating other people. As soon as they do, Su-a makes a bold move while Tae-seung takes a provocative step.

episodeGuide.title: What Do Our Scars Look Like?
episodeGuide.summary: Namgung and Mi-do keep up the pretense of being a couple in front of their families. Sol's arrival stirs Namgung's past, while Mi-do confides a long-held secret to Tae-seung.

episodeGuide.title: How Do We Love, How Do We Live?
episodeGuide.summary: The three come face-to-face at Namgung's place. They sit down for breakfast, pretending everything is fine, but soon find themselves caught in a swirl of complicated emotions. Meanwhile, Tae-seung notices Mi-do's wavering heart and plans a special day just for her.

episodeGuide.title: Who Do We Love the Most?
episodeGuide.summary: Namgung tries to stop Su-a from putting herself at risk, but the conflict between them deepens as neither is willing to back down. Meanwhile, under pressure from Ju-hyeok, Tae-seung heads to a rural village, where he encounters someone unexpected.

episodeGuide.title: Who Will We Be With in Ten Years?
episodeGuide.summary: With less than a month left, Namgung and Mi-do decide to see it through. Watching them, Tae-seung and Su-a realize that their own feelings for each other have grown too deep to turn back.

episodeGuide.title: What Brought Us Together?
episodeGuide.summary: After their feelings pull them in different directions, Namgung and Mi-do meet again, as do Tae-seung and Su-a. At a moment that can no longer be put off, the four finally confront their true feelings.

title: Filing for Love
overview: Ki-jun, once the ace of the internal audit team, is now stuck handling petty office scandals—all thanks to his manager, In-ah. One day, he receives an anonymous tip: In-ah is involved in an inappropriate relationship at work. Digging into her secret for revenge, Ki-jun instead finds himself drawn to her.

title: Phantom Lawyer
overview: While Shin Yi Rang dreams of joining a prestigious law firm, he's constantly rejected due to his father's criminal past. Undeterred, he "borrows" money from his mother and opens up his own law firm in a building formerly owned by a shaman. His life and career take a supernatural turn after incense he found in a desk drawer gifts him with the ability to communicate with – and be possessed by – ghosts. With unexpected help from elite lawyer Han Na Hyun, Yi Rang is able to get justice for his first ghostly client, although she's reluctant to admit that spirits are truly speaking to Yi Rang. As their peculiar partnership continues to develop, Yi Rang and Na Hyun find themselves growing closer in more ways than one, all while helping lingering spirits get the closure they need to pass on.

episodeGuide.title: A Haunted Law Office
episodeGuide.summary: Rejected by law firms, Shin I-rang rents an eerie old office and lands his first job: a medical malpractice case for a ghost and his grieving wife.

episodeGuide.title: An Unholy Alliance
episodeGuide.summary: After ghostly client Lee Gang-pung possesses him, I-rang reconsiders their arrangement — until a crisis renews his conviction.

episodeGuide.title: Death of High School Girl
episodeGuide.summary: The ghost of a teenage girl haunts I-rang in his office, demanding he acknowledge her existence and find out who she was.

episodeGuide.title: Harmony of the Dead
episodeGuide.summary: I-rang vows to reveal the true perpetrator behind Su-a's case. With this in mind, he enters a temporary alliance with his lawyer nemesis, Na-hyun.

episodeGuide.title: Guilty or Innocent?
episodeGuide.summary: I-rang's new case involves a gifted scientist who died at the hands of his wife. The wife's defense lawyer turns out to be none other than Na-hyun.

episodeGuide.title: New Suspect
