episodeGuide.summary: Mistakenly linked to a murder, I-rang must race against time to solve the case and prove his innocence.

episodeGuide.title: Na-hyun's Past
episodeGuide.summary: When I-rang loses his ability to see ghosts and Na-hyun suffers a career setback, the two cross paths again at the courthouse.

episodeGuide.title: Yi Rang Meets So Hyun
episodeGuide.summary: A possessed I-rang acts out at a crime scene and gets arrested. While locked up, he discovers the identity of the ghost who caused his outburst.

episodeGuide.title: Na Hyun‘s Family
episodeGuide.summary: Na-hyun spends precious time with her sister thanks to I-rang. But her emotional wounds deepen behind the facade of a happy family reunion.

episodeGuide.title: The Secret Of Yi Rang's Old Friend
episodeGuide.summary: I-rang and Na-hyun officially launch their partnership. On their first day, a vegetable vendor arrives at their office seeking legal help.

episodeGuide.title: Seon-hwa's Past
episodeGuide.summary: Attorney Yang Do-kyung complicates Na-hyun's case. I-rang and his partner bond and uncover crucial evidence that couldturn the trial in their favor.

episodeGuide.title: The Missing Child
episodeGuide.summary: I-rang discovers the tragic truth behind a child's death. Meanwhile, Do-kyung seethes with jealousy as he realizes Na-hyun's heart belongs to another.

episodeGuide.title: The Truth Revealed
episodeGuide.summary: After a violent encounter leaves I-rang in a critical state, a desperate Na-hyun confesses a secret as she stands by his side.

episodeGuide.title: The Past of My Father
episodeGuide.summary: The ghost of I-rang's father appears, unaware of the heartache he caused his son. Can they find a way to overcome their painful past?

episodeGuide.title: The Truth Of Gi Jung's Death
episodeGuide.summary: As l-rang learns a shocking truth from his father, Do-kyung adds pressure and pushes him toward a breaking point.

episodeGuide.title: The Final Confrontation
episodeGuide.summary: To solve his father's case, I-rang secures a key piece of evidence. But when a new threat jeopardizes his findings, he makes a dangerous gamble.

title: Spring Fever
overview: Spring Fever : the tiredness people often feel in spring. Yun Bom, a teacher with a frozen heart, arrives at a small rural school and slowly rediscovers joy through Seon Jae Gyu's warmth.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is… That Guy?
episodeGuide.summary: In the small coastal town of Shinsu, Yun Bom immediately piques everyone's curiosity. People can only guess why a successful teacher from Seoul, ended up here. But all attention quickly shifts to Sun Jae Gyu, the town's most notorious figure. His arrival turns Bom's quiet life upside down.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle... Has a Job?
episodeGuide.summary: There's something familiar about Jae Gyu's actions, though Bom can't quite figure out why. Meanwhile, Se Jin disappears, frustrated from always coming in second because of Han Gyul. Bom and Jae Gyu head to Seoul to find her. At a critical moment, Jae Gyu's sudden appearance flips a switch in Bom's memory.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is... a Dad?
episodeGuide.summary: Bom glimpses an unexpected side of Jae-gyu and starts to think he might not be so bad after all. Then a shocking rumor begins spreading through town: Jae-gyu isn't Han-gyul's uncle, he's his dad! The news keeps weighing on her, so she decides to confront it head-on.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is... an Heir?
episodeGuide.summary: Bom's heart freezes over again when she realizes Jae-gyu knows her secrets. She throws up a cold wall and tells him to stay out of her life. Determined to clear up the misunderstanding, Jae-gyu brings out his ultimate move to win her back. Will it be enough to thaw Bom's heart?

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is... Not Participating?
episodeGuide.summary: Shinsu High is buzzing with excitement for its biggest event of the year: Sports Day. But without Jae-gyu, the White Team struggles to keep up, and tension slowly tightens across Bom's face. Still bound by his promise to Han-gyul, Jae-gyu can't take part, leaving him frustrated on the sidelines. When Bom finds him, she says something that stirs his already restless heart even more.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is... a Thief?
episodeGuide.summary: Bom admits she has feelings for Jae-gyu but refuses to date a parent ever again. Jae-gyu then declares he'll wait until Han-gyul graduates. They agree to keep their distance and stay strictly professional. But despite their firm promise, their jealousy toward each other only grows...

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is... a CEO?
episodeGuide.summary: After clearing their misunderstanding, one kiss makes waiting for Han-gyul's graduation frustrating. They compromise on a single secret date.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle... Collapsed?
episodeGuide.summary: A typhoon hits the town of Shinsu. Everyone shelters at Jae-gyu's house, but Bom is missing. He and I-jun brave the storm to find her.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is… Dating Ms. Bom?
episodeGuide.summary: Han-gyul learns his mother is alive and argues with Jae-gyu. During the festival, shocking news forces Bom and Jae-gyu to make a major choice.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle… Got Hurt?
episodeGuide.summary: Nan-hee disapproves of Jae-gyu and Bom but stays close to watch them. A misunderstanding lands Jae-gyu in the hospital, shocking Bom.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is… Going Somewhere?
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-gyu shares his painful past with Bom, unsure of her feelings. Meanwhile, a reporter's news of Nan-hee brings Bom's past back into the spotlight.

episodeGuide.title: Your Uncle Is... That Guy?
episodeGuide.summary: Bom bravely faces the truth with Jae-gyu by her side. As Bom's return to Seoul comes near, she and Jae-gyu make memories in Shinsu together!

title: Make Me Tremble
overview: Depicts the story of Yeon Su, a woman raised in a conservative household who works at a marketing company and has lived her life while maintaining her chastity, as she meets a man who is the CEO of an adult product company. As their worlds collide, they challenge each other's beliefs and grow together in unexpected ways.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Conservative marketer Yeon-su takes on a former blind date as a new client.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Marketer Yeon-su clashes with her new client, Dal.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: A heated argument over love leads to an unexpected move by Dal, leaving a confused Yeon-su reeling.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Yeon-su's event idea takes shape. Meanwhile, Dal shocks her family with an overly blunt remark.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Despite rejecting her date offer, Dal bonds with Yeon-su on assignment -- right as Ji-o drops a surprise confession.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: While running a pop-up store in Busan, Yeon-su is forced to confront her true feelings for Dal once and for all.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Met with resistance after confessing her feelings to Dal, Yeon-su proposes a tailor-made relationship just for him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Dal's true feelings for Yeon-su begins to surface at an untimely moment.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Standing up to her family's fierce opposition, Yeon-su moves in with Dal instead.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: As Loand opens its flagship store, Yeon-su wins her family's approval and begins a real romance with Dal at last.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Pi-o is known around school as an unrivaled talent — until he meets the mysterious Choi Jeong-yo and realizes he may have finally met his match.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: With Jeong-yo now his classmate, a bitter Pi-o keeps his distance. But when the two are tasked with a joint performance, Pi-o finds himself warming up.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: When crisis strikes right before the joint stage, Pi-o improvises a fix — only to wonder if it was a mistake when Jeong-yo's skills outshine his own.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: With Pi-o determined to reclaim his love for music, Jeong-yo shows Pi-o how to have fun on the piano. Jeong-yo's family troubles catch up to him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Intent on proving himself, Pi-o joins the Prague Harmonie International Competition and asks Jeong-yo to join too. Pi-o's obsessive practice takes a toll.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Years later, Pi-o is successful and world-renowned — but miserable. Hong Jae-in tries to let Pi-o know how she feels. Pi-o hunts down news of Jeong-yo.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Pi-o finds himself stuck deep in a slump, but can't seem to overcome his fears alone. Later, a familiar face suggests collaborating on a performance.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Pi-o faces increasing pressure to do the joint performance, but his issues with the piano only get worse. Jeong-yo finally steps in to help.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Pi-o learns the shocking truth behind Jeong-yo's kidnapping. Jeong-yo asks for Pi-o's help with a piano piece, but his harsh words leave Pi-o rattled.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Pi-o realizes Jeong-yo has been hiding a huge secret. With everything revealed, Jeong-yo turns even more cruel, and Pi-o falls deeper into despair.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: As the Korean Symphony's 80th anniversary concert begins, Jeong-yo and Pi-o face a turning point — but when the performance ends, only one person remains on stage.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: After painful losses, Pi-o considers leaving music behind, but Jeong-yo shares his final feelings as their last four-hands performance begins.

title: The Art of Sarah
overview: A supposed luxury maven. A detective with a keen eye. As he digs into her shifting story, the truth behind a murder case slowly comes to light.

episodeGuide.title: Jane Doe
episodeGuide.summary: After Sarah Kim is discovered dead, Jeong Yeo-jin recounts her memories of the elusive woman to Park Mu-gyeong — who suspects something is askew.

episodeGuide.title: Sarah Kim
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-gyeong probes Sarah's past through Woo Hyo‑eun and finds that her "Sarah Kim" is nothing like the woman others recall — and Boudoir looks even shadier.

episodeGuide.title: Mok Ga-hui
episodeGuide.summary: Sarah's buried past surfaces: a down-on-her-luck woman with aspirations for luxury, who'll stop at nothing to reach her goal — no matter the cost.

episodeGuide.title: Kim Eun-jae
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-gyeong presses Kang Ji-hwon about his link to Sarah, and a tangled history begins to emerge — one that also leads to power broker Hong Seong‑shin.

episodeGuide.title: Boudoir
episodeGuide.summary: Determined to put Sarah away, Mu-gyeong prepares to go public with the case — only to find that every new glimpse of "Sarah Kim" makes his path less clear.

episodeGuide.title: Unregistered Person
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-gyeong races to lock Sarah away for murder before time runs out — turning to Choi Chae-u for help, even if trusting her may cost more than he expects.

episodeGuide.title: Kim Mi-jeong
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-gyeong tries to shake Sarah by going after what she guards most: Boudoir's name. Pushed to the edge, she drops a new name into the case.

episodeGuide.title: The Art of Sarah
episodeGuide.summary: As the clock runs down, Sarah fights to protect everything she's built — and Mu-gyeong follows her ever‑shifting story, hoping to finally reach the truth.

title: Sword & Silence
overview: A large-scale historical drama that highlights the great victory of the small nation of Silla, which defeated Goguryeo, Baekje, and even the Tang Dynasty, and completed the unification of the three kingdoms.

title: Scarecrow
overview: Criminal profiler Kang Tae Joo is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Joo joins the investigation, believing that Tae Joo can prove his innocence. Tae Joo is brought back into a world he thought he'd left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Young, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn't as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Joo might be more involved than even he knows. Can Tae Joo finally close the chapter on the "Scarecrow" murders for good, or will a new twist upend his life?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Tae Joo comes back to his hometown, Kangseong, as a result of a demotion because of the arrest of his chief. On the first day at the Kangseong office, he finds out from his colleagues that an ex-convict from his past case has been beaten. Although he believes he is not the culprit, the situation doesn't go as he thinks. While investigating the case, he meets his classmate, Cha Si Yeong, who has bullied him badly. Si Yeong greets Tae Joo with a smile, but it seems like Tae Joo hasn't overcome the past memory.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: After an uncomfortable reunion with Si Yeong, Tae Joo resumes tracking the serial killer. Ji Won, a female reporter, also joins the operation to catch the murderer. Meanwhile, Gi Beom proposes to Sun Yeong, but soon grows uneasy after seeing her leave work in her male colleague's car. At the same time, Tae Joo, dispatched to a college student protest, spots a male student who resembles Gi Beom and begins to grow suspicious.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: After Tae Joo used violence against the county governor's nephew because Sun Yeong was assaulted by him, he is in danger of being resigned. Through the testimony from a victim, he realizes that there is another victim of the serial murder case among the missing people. So he promises that he will find the body of the new victim with the condition of his resignation. Meanwhile, Ji Won prepares a surprising event for Tae Joo's reputation, and Sun Yeong tells Gi Beom that she wants to break up with him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After the death of Min Ji, who showed trust in Tae Joo, Tae Joo meets Si Yeong and suggests catching the serial killer together. Tae Joo's comeback arouses controversy among his colleagues, but he just focuses on tracking the killer. And he discovers a connection between Min Ji and Gi Beom. To make things worse, Gi Beom becomes the suspect because of the assault on Jeon Kyung Ho, and the doubt toward him becomes bigger and bigger.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: As suspicion toward Gi Beom grows, Tae Joo is confused because the circumstances point to Gi Beom as the killer, but he hesitates to arrest him for some reason. After another murder case happens, he tries to find the missing Gi Beom to ask about everything, being sure that Gi Beom is the killer. Si Yeong, who was attacked by the killer, wakes up, and he reconciles with Tae Joo. But with the emergence of Si Yeong's brother, the situation of the investigation unit becomes complicated.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Gi Beom is continuously confined, tortured, and threatened, forced into giving a false confession by Si Yeong and his subordinate detectives. Using a handbag found as evidence, Ji Won begins to deduce the real culprit and eventually tracks down a suspicious man, attempting to interview him. Meanwhile, Tae Joo seeks out a nuclear research scientist, trying a new method to track down the perpetrator.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Despite Si Yeong's interference, Tae Joo continues the investigation and realises that all the clues are pointing toward Seok Man. Late at night, Seok Man visits Sun Yeong to return her handkerchief, and she begins to suspect him. Meanwhile, Gi Beom is cleared of suspicion and released. However, on his way home, he is met with another tragedy.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Corrupt detectives continue to torture Seok Man, forcing him to give a false confession. Tae Joo is instead framed as the officer who illegally assaulted Gi Beom, leading to his death, and finds himself on the brink of demotion. Ji Won attempts to write an article to help Tae Joo but runs into serious obstacles. Meanwhile, Sun Yeong suddenly goes missing, and Tae Joo along with the entire village searches desperately for her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Right before Seok Man is in danger of being sentenced to the death penalty, a doctor who led the autopsies of the murder case changes the atmosphere of the court, insisting that Seok Man isn't the killer. Meanwhile, Tae Joo comes back to the Kangseong and declares that the serial murder case is not over yet. And Tae Joo digs into the case of a missing child, which seems like the evidence of the killer's new activity.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: After Dae Ho tells Tae Joo about the conspiracy on Hye Jin's body, Tae Joo goes on another secret plan to get a hint from Si Yeong about where she is. But things go even more complicated because Si Yeong turns out to be Sun Yeong's half-sibling. With a frustrating feeling about the relationship of Si Yeong and Sun Yeong, Tae Joo rushes to find Hye Jin's body.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Based on the confession of the murderer, Tae Joo visits Seok Man's house and begs for his forgiveness for making him the culprit. He decides to do the retrial for Seok Man's innocence, and meets his past colleagues to persuade them to tell the world the truth about Hye Jin's missing body. Meanwhile, Yeong Beom, the son of Sun Yeong, becomes a reporter, investigates the Kangseong Serial Murders, and meets Tae Joo, unaware of their relationship.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Despite Yeong Beom's blame to Tae Joo, Tae Joo gives all of his heart and strength for Seok Man's retrial and Hye Jin's case steadily. He even stars on Ji Won's news and reveals the culprit of Hye Jin's case openly. Through the news, the situation goes chaotic. Shocked, Yeong Beom and Sun Yeong go to Si Yeong's office, and they blame him. But Yeong Beom requests Si Yeong to say the truth in the court as a last chance. Will Si Yeong say the truth? And will Seok Man's honor be restored?

title: The Husband
overview: Kang Tae Ju, a former neurosurgeon who now serves as a hospital director engages in an extreme fight with a criminal with a human face to save his wife who was kidnapped right before divorce.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Neurosurgeon Tae-ju clashes with his wife Se-yun, the board director of his hospital. Tae-ju demands a divorce. But the next day, his wife vanishes.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Taeju goes to his in-laws for help, only to run into detectives. Another call with no caller ID comes through. Seyun wakes up in a strange room.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Suhyeong gives Taeju an ultimatum: show up at a specific place and time to save his wife, so Taeju makes a daring escape from the police station.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Taeju makes a desperate escape. His hope of seeing Seyun again is short-lived when he's faced with a photo of a brutally murdered woman.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: The kidnapper agrees to Taeju's deal. This could be the last chance to save Seyun. Meanwhile, Suhyeong has been following Taeju from a distance.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Having obtained the kidnapper's home address, Taeju hides in a doctor's office from detectives, only to come face-to-face with an unexpected person.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Taeju and Seyun fight for their lives, but Noh Manhui's ferocious determination to kill pushes them to the brink.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Jeongsu's attempt to kill Gyeongae fails. But Taeju is haunted by Jeongsu's claim that he was "just following orders."

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Noh Manhui and the mastermind behind him remain at large. Taeju poses as Gyeongae's doctor to uncover the truth. Jang discovers an unexpected clue.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: After a tense standoff, Taeju and Manhui each uncover pieces of the truth. Meanwhile, Seyun learns the full story of that nightmarish day.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Taeju discovers who's really behind the case, but he's stuck without proof. A fire alarm goes off at night, throwing Woori Medical Center into chaos.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Manhui and Chiung appear before Taeju, and the three head to the care home where Gyeongae is, each with their own goal.

title: See You At Work Tomorrow!
overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

episodeGuide.title: Even if the Sky Falls, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Despite getting ghosted, Cha Ji-yoon still clocks in, only to get involved with 'Three-No-Man' Kang Si-woo. Learning his secret shakes up her life.

episodeGuide.title: Dreaming of Quitting, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yoon feels butteflies after sharing drinks with Si-woo. He comes to her with an unexpected proposal. Young-sam's power tripping drains Ji-yoon.

episodeGuide.title: Sick or Not, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yoon chooses to join the second-worst task force to dodge the worst, her boss. Ji-yoon and Si-woo are building a rapport when Ga-eul comes back.

episodeGuide.title: Broke Up Yesterday, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Things end for good with Ga-eul, but Ji-yoon still clocks in. Her dynamic with Si-woo shifts leading up to the 'sphere ice refrigerator' presentation.

episodeGuide.title: Have a "Meeting," Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yoon feels uneasy seeing Si-woo and Soo-jin close, but an accidental find at his place leaves her confused. Later, No-ah sets her up on a date.

episodeGuide.title: Busted for My Feelings, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: To suppress her feelings for Si-woo, Ji-yoon tries to leave the task force. But when he refuses to let her go, they develop feelings hard to ignore.

episodeGuide.title: Have a New Secret, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yoon and Si-woo start a secret romance. As the line between work and love blurs, Ga-eul reappears before a struggling Ji-yoon.

episodeGuide.title: Held Back by My Past, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: As the romance deepens, unvoiced thoughts and secrets grow. Meanwhile, Si-woo's failure to show up on Hye-ji's wedding leaves Ji-yoon anxious.

episodeGuide.title: There's an Error, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: When Ji-yoon asks for some time, Si-woo takes Seong-min's advice and lingers near. Meanwhile, Home-AI demo day arrives, and so does the Demo Ghost!

episodeGuide.title: Don't Know the Answer, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: While an unexpected event forces Ji-yoon to stay at Si-woo's, settling them into life's simple joys, her promotion sends Mr. Ko's envy spiraling.

episodeGuide.title: Even if Rumors Blur the Truth, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: Ji-yoon goes public to protect Si-woo, but intense public scrutiny backfires on them. Left with no choice, Si-woo makes a grave decision.

episodeGuide.title: No Map to Follow, Still Clocking In!
episodeGuide.summary: As Ji-yoon struggles with Si-woo's decision, Hye-gyeong discovers their romance. Will the two safely clock in for work tomorrow, and for love?

title: Reborn Rookie
overview: Kang Yong Ho is the chairman of the Choiseong Group, a leading conglomerate in South Korea. He built the company by himself, and he is now known as the "God of Business". One day, he has an unexpected accident. He collides with a young man named Hwang Jun Hyeon. Hwang Jun Hyeon is a soccer player who has just joined the League 1 team FC Choiseong. Due to the accident, Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul is swapped with soccer player Hwang Jun Hyeon's soul. With Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul in Hwang Jun Hyeon's body, he applies to the Choiseong Group as a new employee. He begins his unpredictable journey with his soul as an outstanding businessman and the young body of Hwang Jun Hyeon.

cast.name: Lee Jun Young
cast.character: Hwang Jun Hyeon / Kang Yong Ho

episodeGuide.title: Putting a Price Tag on a Dream
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Kang Yong-ho announces that he'll step down and choose his successor. His twins, Kang Jae-gyeong and Kang Jae-seong, instantly switch into competition mode. Jun-hyeon finally signs with Choiseong FC. On the way to celebrate it with his grandma, he gets hit by a car. After finding out he can't continue his career, he focuses on the hit-and-run driver of the accident.

episodeGuide.title: The Reborn Chairman
episodeGuide.summary: After hearing about the accident Yong-ho was in, Bang-geul rushes to the hospital and runs into Yong-ho in Jun-hyeon's body. Yong-ho is accused of being the hit-and-run driver and faces a fierce public backlash, while Jae-gyeong seizes the opportunity to force him out of the chairman position for good. Jun-hyeon joins Choiseong Group as an intern.

episodeGuide.title: Proving Your Competency
episodeGuide.summary: Determined to help Bang-geul, Yong Ho sets out in Jun-hyeon's body to uncover the twins' hidden stash of illicit funds. As the twins compete for the position of the next Chairman, they quietly carry out their own schemes behind the scenes. Jun-hyeon's grandmother sets off for Seoul to find her grandson. When Bang-geul learns of her disappearance by chance, she joins the search and helps track her down.

episodeGuide.title: A Divide and Conquer Strategy
episodeGuide.summary: The disappearance of Managing Director Song becomes the subject of a police investigation, putting Jae-seong in a difficult position. Yong-ho realises that Jae-seong intends to sabotage the port project for Taeha's benefit, his father-in-law's company. Yong-ho sides with Jae-gyeong and shares everything he knows, deepening the twins' mistrust of one another.

episodeGuide.title: A Self-Destructive Battle
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Na insists that GF Solution must be acquired and assures Jae-seong that Taeha will back the deal financially if needed. Yong-ho manipulates both Jae-gyeong and Jae-seong into driving up the acquisition price to an absurd level. Meanwhile, Yong-ho reveals to Sang-jae that he is Yong-ho, now living inside Jun-hyeon's body.

episodeGuide.title: The Claws are Out at Last
episodeGuide.summary: Yong-ho, Bang-geul, and Bong-gi travel to Yulivia to steal the mining project Taeha has been working on. They figure out Chairman Na's scheme against Yulivia's government. Seon-hee finds out that Jae-gyeong and her husband have been sedating Yong-ho to keep him from waking up. After learning about this, Yong-ho and Bang-geul decide to reveal themselves to the board of directors.

episodeGuide.title: War Is Declared
episodeGuide.summary: Determined to stand by Bang-geul, Seon-hee declares war on Jae-gyeong and the family, pledging to support her with all her might. Jae-gyeong figures out that Bang-geul and Jun-hyeon are behind Smile Investment. Meanwhile, Chairman Na meets Jae-gyeong and suggests getting rid of Bang-geul for her.

episodeGuide.title: Making Another Sacrifice
episodeGuide.summary: After successfully getting rid of Jae-seong, Jae-gyeong sets Managing Director Lee up and accuses him of trying to take over Choiseong. She calls an emergency board meeting and makes Bang-geul and Jun-hyeon fire 20 percent of the staff. In the meantime, she also makes a secret deal with Chairman Na.

episodeGuide.title: Deep in Enemy Territory
episodeGuide.summary: After Chairman Kang's death, Jae-gyeong openly moves to take over Choiseong Group. She also frames Seon-hee and Bang-geul for Chairman Kang's alleged creation of slush funds. Determined to take Jae-gyeong down, Yong-ho pretends to betray Bang-geul and joins Jae-gyeong's side.

episodeGuide.title: Betrayal Upon Betrayal
episodeGuide.summary: Jae-gyeong finds herself on the verge of losing the Daesan Hydrogen Complex to Chairman Na under highly unfavourable terms. Realising that Jae-gyeong is being blackmailed by Chairman Na, Yong-ho pretends to join forces with Chairman Na and ultimately discovers that Jae-gyeong was not the one who killed him. Meanwhile, Bang-geul learns that Yong-ho has sided with Taeha and begins following him to uncover the truth.

episodeGuide.title: Getting Proper Revenge
episodeGuide.summary: Bang-geul finds out who actually killed her dad and swears to take revenge on them. Yong-ho gives the CCTV footage from the hospital to Jae-gyeong, and she uses it to blackmail Chairman Na. Eun-se flies to Singapore to get Chairman Na's slush fund, but unexpected news hits her while she's there.

episodeGuide.title: The Final Punishment
episodeGuide.summary: Yong-ho finally wakes up in his body and saves Jun-hyeon, who was in danger because of Chairman Na. Yong-ho asks Jae-gyeong to make things right with him, but she refuses. Jae-seong turns himself in and reveals everything he did with Jae-gyeong.

title: The WONDERfools
overview: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

episodeGuide.title: Every Life Comes With a Surprise Twist
episodeGuide.summary: When news of the apocalypse spreads in Haeseong City, a cash-strapped and terminally ill young woman devises a kidnapping plot with two clumsy sidekicks.

episodeGuide.title: Secrets Are Meant To Be Kept
episodeGuide.summary: Eun Chae-ni and her quirky friends Son Gyeong-hun and Kang Ro-bin are baffled by their sudden abilities. A wary Lee Un-jeong confronts his doubts.

episodeGuide.title: Brutes and Bad Luck Do Come in Droves
episodeGuide.summary: The gang witnesses Un-jeong's superpower in a crisis. While they're thrilled after a daring rescue, Un-jeong senses danger nearby.

episodeGuide.title: Boon the King Duck vs Wunderkinder
episodeGuide.summary: Dr. Ha Won-do returns after 20 years, chasing secrets of the Child of Eternity. Later, the gang faces an attack — still unsure of their powers.

episodeGuide.title: All We Need Is You
episodeGuide.summary: Un-jeong leads a bootcamp for the gang to tap into their abilities. Chae-ni confronts her grandma about the superpower's secret.

episodeGuide.title: All Roads Lead to Chae-ni
episodeGuide.summary: Chae-ni wakes up to danger — but finds a surprise lifeline in her pocket. Un-jeong plans with Gyeong-hun and Ro-bin to rescue Chae-ni.

episodeGuide.title: The Guardians of Haeseong City Part 1
episodeGuide.summary: Un-jeong and the gang fight other superpowered followers, while Dr. Ha's risky plan targets Chae-ni.

episodeGuide.title: The Guardians of Haeseong City Part 2
episodeGuide.summary: New Year's Eve 1999. Three misfits use their abilities to battle superpowered villains in an all-out brawl for Haeseong City.

title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
overview: In the game of life, we all face countless quests of choice. Kang Sung-jae, who enlisted to escape a harsh reality, one day encounters a mysterious virtual "Quest" screen to become an army cook. With each quest he clears, hidden secrets of the base, even those tied to his father's death, begin to surface.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Kang Seong-jae enlists in the army as a cook and receives mysterious game-like commands that appear only to him.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Facing reassignment, Seong-jae must complete a high-stakes cooking quest within 72 hours to secure his role as military cook.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae must improvise a daring dish during a surprise inspection to save his military kitchen.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae's culinary success lifts unit morale but triggers professional jealousy and tension after an unexpected encounter.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Stripped of his skills while on leave, Seong-jae works as a kitchen assistant to save his mother's business and discovers a secret ingredient.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae rallies the troops with an improvised arancini, but encounters danger after overhearing Captain Lee's plot.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: A quest challenges Seong-jae to turn his rival, Sergeant Kim Kwan-cheol, into an ally.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae navigates rising tensions and a sudden offer to join the officer's mess.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae enters the officer's mess and completes a crucial quest.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae begins his final quest and participates in a cooking competition.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Seong-jae teams up with Sergeant Yoon and Sergeant Kim, as they go head-to-head with Lee Ho-young.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As Seong-jae emerges as the contest winner, a brand new quest comes to light, challenging his skills once again.

title: Sold Out on You
overview: A workaholic home shopping host heads to the countryside to get her sales back on top, but a mysterious farmer shakes up her plans — and her heart

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Dam Ye-jin's shopping host career is on the rise — until she loses her primetime slot. Determined to find a new hit item, she heads to the countryside.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Ye-jin realizes farmer Matthew Lee may be able to help her. But her efforts to persuade him prove futile, until she bumps into the perfect opportunity.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Strange phone calls keeps Matthew up at night. Meanwhile, Eric Seo and Ye-jin double down on their plans to get Matthew to work with L'Étoile again.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: When crisis hits the farm, Ye-jin improvises a way to help. Matthew starts to see Ye-jin in a different light after a surprisingly close encounter.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Matthew and Ye-jin make a pact to work together. When Matthew discovers some pressing information, Ye-jin is forced to make an important choice.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: As Ye-jin deals with the fallout of her decision, Matthew invites her to Deokpung Village to get her mind off things — and be his temporary roommate.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Everyone gathers in the village, sparking new realizations and emotions. Ye-jin confronts Matthew about the mixed signals he's been giving her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: With their feelings revealed, Matthew and Ye-jin explore their new relationship. But secrets from the past start to threaten their newfound happiness.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: After coming clean about his past, Matthew pushes Ye-jin away. But keeping a distance gets harder when Ye-jin learns about her late-night calls.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Matthew gets jealous when he learns that Eric is Ye-jin's new neighbor. Sparks fly in the village, keeping spirits high — until someone goes missing.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Matthew enlists Ye-jin's help to develop a new skincare cream. Everything looks promising — until a smear campaign triggers an attack on the village.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: With the truth behind the scandal from five years ago revealed, Matthew and Ye-jin prepare for their home shopping launch. Will they be able to sell out?

title: Gold Land
overview: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring's gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

episodeGuide.title: Betting
episodeGuide.summary: Customs officer Heeju agrees to help her pilot boyfriend Dokyung with a suspicious deal.

episodeGuide.title: Homecoming
episodeGuide.summary: Hiding in the one place she swore she'd never return, Heeju guards the gold from her pursuers.

episodeGuide.title: Partnership
episodeGuide.summary: Woogy makes Hee-ju an offer she can't refuse, as Director Park steps up his search for the gold.

episodeGuide.title: That Person
episodeGuide.summary: Sun-ok takes the fall for Hee-ju's crime. In return, Hee-ju prepares one final surprise for her.

episodeGuide.title: Secret
episodeGuide.summary: Heeju joins forces with Woogy but doesn't trust him. As the others close in, Heeju stands alone.

episodeGuide.title: Fissure
episodeGuide.summary: The owner of the gold bars is back. Director Park goes mad, while Heeju fights to keep the gold safe.

episodeGuide.title: Villains
episodeGuide.summary: Heeju doesn't hide her desire for the gold, and Jinman learns an unexpected truth.

episodeGuide.title: Choice
episodeGuide.summary: Jinman is shocked and confused after discovering Heeju's identity and Woogy finds himself in danger.

episodeGuide.title: Consequences
episodeGuide.summary: Jin-man makes a bold move and Do-kyung goes to see Hee-ju.

episodeGuide.title: Gold Land
episodeGuide.summary: Everyone chasing the gold finally arrives in the same place.

title: The Perfect Lie
overview: Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night after a heart-fluttering date. The next day, they face each other at a police station with completely different memories. One of them is lying. With no evidence or witnesses, even the polygraph result defies expectations, and their mutual suspicion throws their lives into chaos. Questions about Joonho's late wife reveal that the case extends far beyond the two of them. As conflicting testimony and hidden relationships emerge, the truth grows murkier, and one lie sparks a dangerous game in which no one can be trusted.

title: Dive into You
overview: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

title: Can This Love Be Translated?
overview: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Cha Mu-hee and Joo Ho-jin cross paths in Tokyo, both hoping to leave the past behind. At a ramen shop, Mu-hee begs Ho-jin to translate her feelings.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-hee becomes a global superstar overnight, but struggles to leave her character behind. A ruffled Ho-jin becomes the subject of an Instagram post.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-hee and Hiro meet by chance at a red carpet event, unintentionally creating on-cam drama. Their spark inspires the casting of "Romantic Trip."

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Unhappy with his new co-star, Hiro decides to give her a hard time while filming in Canada. Ho-jin becomes supportive of Mu-hee as he gets to know her.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Hiro enjoys time with Mu-hee, despite his determination to dislike her. Meanwhile, a surprise encounter with a new producer stops Ho-jin in his tracks.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Kim Yong-u and Ji-sun bond over a secret. Mu-hee blames a bold action on Do Ra-mi, before a night out with the crew leaves Ho-jin with mixed emotions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Hiro goes soul searching in Seoul for clarity about his feelings. After a concert, Kim Young-hwan arranges a meetup with Mu-hee and a reluctant Ho-jin.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-hee and Do Ra-mi's relationship shifts as awkward moments with family, friends and co-stars build — pushing someone to take drastic action.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-hee and Hiro share their feelings while filming in Italy. As the crew gossips about Ho-jin's rumored lover, he learns a shocking truth from Do Ra-mi.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: While adjusting to his new relationship, a lavish winery reunites Ho-jin with an important family member. Mu-hee finds the root cause of her problems.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Mu-hee and Ho-jin find themselves confronting their pasts after a scandal hits the media. A resurfaced Instagram post raises important questions.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: While some secrets come out, some romances solidify. Will Mu-hee and Ho-jin get their happy ending — or are some emotions too hard to interpret?

title: Nine to Six
overview: Kang Yi Ji has long kept romance on the sidelines, pouring all her energy into her career. Her perspective shifts when she meets Han Seon Woo, whose warmth and thoughtfulness help her rediscover love. Together, they navigate both professional challenges and personal growth, finding balance in work and life.

title: Francesca Next Door
overview: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

title: Doctor on the Edge
overview: Elite plastic surgeon Do Jiui has his perfect life turned upside down when he's unexpectedly sent to the remote island of Pyeondongdo as a public health doctor. Surrounded by the sea, the island is more than just isolation for him, as past trauma has turned the ocean into an unknowable terror and a massive prison. Intrusive locals and grotesque bugs turn life into a living hell for the city man. Amid it all, a mysterious nurse, Yuk Hari, appears. Hiding secrets behind her gentle smile, she always seems to be nearby when Jiui is overwhelmed by his fear of the sea. As the two become entangled on the small island, can Jiui overcome his past and escape safely?

episodeGuide.title: The Doctor Sent to the Island
episodeGuide.summary: Dreading his post, Do Jiui arrives on Pyeondongdo, meets Yuk Hari, and begins harsh island life.

episodeGuide.title: The Woman Who Crosses the Line
episodeGuide.summary: Do Jiui meets the mysterious nurse Yuk Hari, and their line-crossing house calls begin.

episodeGuide.title: Getting Through Another Day
episodeGuide.summary: The village chief makes Jiui an outcast. Meanwhile, Hari and Chiyeon are stranded overnight.

episodeGuide.title: A Notorious Woman, a Pathetic Man
episodeGuide.summary: Jiui is shaken by Hari's past and rumors, and a storm-hit emergency leaves him paralyzed by trauma.

episodeGuide.title: Pyeondong Scandal
episodeGuide.summary: Hari nurses Jiui amidst hospital gossip. Meanwhile, on Pyeondongdo, Mija is in critical condition.

episodeGuide.title: An Unspeakable Secret
episodeGuide.summary: Jiui and Hari's relationship is tested by Mija as the county governor schemes over Deokhwa's rescue.

episodeGuide.title: Words Left Unsaid
episodeGuide.summary: Torn between love and hurt, Jiui and the hurt Hari drift apart, and Mija's condition worsens.

episodeGuide.title: I Can't Do It. I Can't Ignore You.
episodeGuide.summary: Grieving her grandma, a downpour forces Hari to live with Jiui. Amid mix emotions, a secret emerges.

episodeGuide.title: Courage to Forgive
episodeGuide.summary: Jiui and Hari confirm their feelings, illness spreads on Jineondo, and a man appears before Jucheon.

episodeGuide.title: It's Not Okay
episodeGuide.summary: A crash shatters Jiui. As his first love Hwayeong returns, Hari must decide whether to let him go.

episodeGuide.title: Reconciliation, Healing, And...
episodeGuide.summary: Amid a confession and a breakup ahead, a misdiagnosed case returns, and Jiui stands at a crossroads.

title: Absolute Value of Romance
overview: A quiet student by day, a romance novelist by night, Eui-ju is inspired when four gorgeous teachers appear: icy Woo-su, lively Da-ju, gruff Gi-jeon, and gentle Dong-ju. She writes them into her new novel, which blows up overnight! But her secret is discovered by Woo-su, her worst enemy since day one. title: Gift
overview: Depicts the story of professional baseball coach Jung Min Yong, who gains extraordinary abilities after an unexpected accident and takes on the role of head coach for the last-place amateur Deokcheon High School baseball team, leading to a passionate, intense, and tear-jerking season. He gains the power to rate the level and ability of baseball players and scouts Tae Hun as a first-team pitcher, after seeing in him the potential to become a great player. The story unfolds as the players express their dissatisfaction with the newly appointed coach.

title: What a Boss Wants
overview: Kwon Do Hyuk is a brilliant tech visionary and wealthy CEO who seems to have it all, yet he suffers from persistent insomnia and a deep emotional void. After his business partner betrays him and his father tasks him to save a failing entertainment company, Do Hyuk decides to develop an AI-powered entertainer. His search for the perfect muse leads him to the mysterious indie singer "Soo," who bears an uncanny resemblance to his latest AI creation. In reality, "Soo" is Eun Chae, a woman juggling a call center job by day and a vibrant stage persona by night. After several awkward encounters, Do Hyuk uses her secrets as leverage, forcing her into a three-month contract as his secretary. But neither of them expects the line between professional duty and personal attraction to blur.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8

While it is a huge amount, realistically, it is hard for him to even purchase his own house in Seoul. After reviewing everything, he decides to live his life as he used to, but with a somewhat different mindset, as he has "insurance" that he can depend on.

title: My Bias, My Boss

When she lands a job at fashion company APPELLO, she's shocked to find out that her beloved idol co-founded the company. Da Reum resolves to hide her identity as a fan and prove that she can be a professional. However, when she starts work, she's faced instead with workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, Chan's childhood friend. Meanwhile, Ha Gi seems to harbor hidden, unrequited feelings for Chan, and Chan struggles to maintain his public persona while dealing with a complicated personal life. As the three become entangled, Da Reum finds herself caught between her past obsession with Chan and a growing, unexpected connection with Ha Gi. .

However, her carefully curated life unravels when she investigates rumors of her husband Lim Jae Hong's infidelity, only to discover him disposing of a dead body – and their daughter is allegedly responsible for the killing. Despite attempting to cover up the incident, they receive an anonymous message that someone has recorded them, forcing Kyung Hee to navigate a treacherous web of blackmail and deceit as they try to put their lives back in order.

title: The Substitute
overview: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas. Kang Geon Tae, the miracle of a "special low-income scholarship student" who does not lose the top rank at Jeonggyeong High, where wealthy people abound. He drew a perfect blueprint toward the first cornerstone of life, the "prestigious university," but the choices he made to survive return as the only stain. He is a figure who falls into a whirlpool by Nam Jae Yeop's irresistible proposal amid the greatest crisis of his life. Nam Jae Yeop, a hexagon full of a gold spoon background, warm visuals and excellent grades, but everything is a mask. As he begins to deviate from the life plan his father wants, his inferiority toward Kang Geon Tae also intensifies. As cracks start to form in his perfect daily life, he begins to run amok like a grenade with the pin pulled.
