Meanwhile, Woo Gyeom asks Attorney Park Han Jun to take his case.

episodeGuide.title: A Desperate Gamble
episodeGuide.summary: Han Jun suspects both Woo Gyeom's abilities and his intentions. However, after meeting an actual patient who was treated and cured by Woo Gyeom, Han Jun decides to take on the case and win it. Meanwhile, persuading Woo Gyeom's patients to testify in court proves to be difficult, and Woo Gyeom makes an unexpected move of his own to secure victory.

episodeGuide.title: Shifting the Narrative
episodeGuide.summary: In an effort to change the direction of the trial, Han Joon argues that Woo Gyeom's medical work is a legitimate research breakthrough rather than a criminal act. As the legal battle intensifies, both sides present conflicting evidence, and the court is left to decide the fate of Woo Gyeom's groundbreaking treatment.

episodeGuide.title: A Glimmer of Hope
episodeGuide.summary: A potential breakthrough occurs when Woo Gyeom's blood is linked to miraculous recoveries. Han Joon works to secure a public demonstration of the treatment, hoping to change perceptions. Meanwhile, outside forces work to control the growing media frenzy and the powerful implications of Woo Gyeom's medical discoveries.

episodeGuide.title: The Deal with the Devil
episodeGuide.summary: Chairman Chae offers Han Joon a deal that could save his daughter, with Woo Gyeom's treatment at the center. However, as new revelations surface, Han Joon faces difficult moral decisions and growing pressure. The stakes rise as both political and personal forces collide, threatening to derail their plans.

episodeGuide.title: Uncovering the Truth
episodeGuide.summary: As the investigation deepens, Yi Yeon uncovers troubling details that suggest Woo Gyeom's past is more complicated than anyone thought. Han Joon, desperate to save his daughter, turns to Woo Gyeom for help, but they must navigate a dangerous path fraught with ethical dilemmas and mounting risks.

episodeGuide.title: Fleeing for Survival
episodeGuide.summary: Woo Gyeom and Han Joon are forced to go on the run, pursued by those who will stop at nothing to control the cure. As they face danger at every turn, Yi Yeon uncovers deeper connections to illegal practices. Time is running out, and Woo Gyeom's health begins to deteriorate.

episodeGuide.title: The Final Act of Revenge
episodeGuide.summary: Woo Gyeom's troubled past comes to light, revealing dark secrets that have driven his actions. As the final confrontation looms, he makes a bold move to confront those who wronged him. In the aftermath, Han Joon is left to grapple with the consequences of Woo Gyeom's actions and the cure's future.

title: The Apartment Job
overview: A once-feared gangster enters the race for apartment association president, driven by greed for hidden funds. But his quest for easy money unravels a web of corruption—and against all odds, he emerges as the unlikely champion of the residents.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Desperate to raise a fortune, Park Hae-kang tries every scheme imaginable. But when he still comes up short, a tip leads him to an apartment complex.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: After discovering the apartment's reserve fund, Hae-kang sets out to steal it. But first, he must somehow win the election to join the association.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Hae-kang enters a tight and competitive election. While a nosy opponent tries to sway voters, he spots a unique opportunity to win over the residents.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After winning the election, Hae-kang aims for the presidency. But when his gangster past is exposed, a new subway entrance becomes his lifeline.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Having finally reached his goal, Hae-kang prepares to disappear without a trace. But when he heads to the bank to claim the cash, everything unravels.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: With Jang Suk-jin on their tail, Hae-kang and Kang Ha-ri scramble to keep their secret safe. Soon, they launch a crusade to find the missing funds.

title: Love Phobia
overview: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.

title: Summer Vacation
overview: Kim Ha Yeon is an ordinary 18-year-old girl who dreams of a life as dramatic as the ones she sees on screen. Her life takes an unexpected, mystical turn when she heads to the unfamiliar countryside village of Upo-ri for her summer break. There, she crosses paths with Jo Yu Gyeom, the heir to a traditional noble family, and his girlfriend, Sae Ryeong. While he possesses stunning looks and a genius talent for swimming, he lives a colorless existence constrained by old-fashioned rules and repetitive routines. As these two opposites meet in the quiet beauty of Upo-ri, their worlds collide, sparking a transformation in their daily lives and the beginning of a once-in-a-lifetime summer.

title: Our Sticky Love
overview: Amnesia, small-town hijinks and a shadowy past — classic tropes collide in this rom-com about a star prosecutor and the boxing coach who upends her life.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Go Eun-sae wakes up in the hospital with no recollection of who she is. Suddenly, scruffy-looking Jang Tae-ha shows up claiming to be her boyfriend.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: From quirky villagers to shady little details, everything feels off to Eun-sae — especially Tae-ha. Later, she tries to figure out if he can be trusted.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-ha takes Eun-sae on a fun day out to cheer her up. However, news starts to get back to mafia boss Baek Sang-gil about what happened with Eun-sae.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-sae heads to Seoul in search of answers, only to be confronted with the ugly truth about who she used to be — and the painful past of Tae-ha.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-sae and Tae-ha's relationship grows sweeter, but some sticky encounters with Tae-ha's old friends put their newfound intimacy to the test.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Tiny misunderstandings snowball into wild rumors all over town. The village trio tries to fix it, only to worsen things — and Eun-sae corners Tae-ha.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: When Eun-sae vanishes, the village searches for her. Meanwhile, her doctor An Gi-jun turns up at Tae-ha's door at night with questions about her past.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Sang-gil finally realizes what Tae-ha has done. Realizing Eun-sae's safety is in danger, Tae-ha makes plans to help her escape.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: With her memories revived, Eun-sae buckles down on her plan to go after Sang-gil. But her very existence now puts the whole town in danger — Tae-ha included.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-sae busies herself with putting Sang-gil away. But with Eun-sae held up at work, Tae-ha wonders if there's any space left for him in her life.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-ha and Eun-sae reunite with everyone in the village, but things take a turn when Sang-gil shows up — only to discover a shocking truth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-ha confronts Sang-gil to save his grandmother. Despite Sang-gil's constant threats, will Tae-ha and Eun-sae stay happily stuck together forever?

title: The Lie We Lived In
overview: A contract killer, Seo I Do, arrives at a secluded house to take out his target, Heo Dong Hwa. Before he can finish the job, his boss unexpectedly orders him to stay put and to keep Dong Hwa captive instead. Things get messy fast when a cheerful stranger, Chu Tae Jeong, suddenly shows up. He's an old friend of Dong Hwa and was already promised a week-long stay. Their first meeting crackles with tension, and in the chaos, Tae Jeong mistakes I Do for Dong Hwa's younger brother, who supposedly left for the US years ago. I Do rides that misunderstanding, acting like the brother while quietly plotting to get Tae Jeong out of the way. His plan takes a sharp turn when he discovers Tae Jeong is actually a detective.

title: Still Shining
overview: After falling in love as teens, two young adults drift apart — only to reunite 10 years later and confront their heartbreak, growth and new challenges.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Yeon Tae-seo heads to the countryside with his younger brother to stay with their grandparents. There, he meets Mo Eun-a and the two form a special bond.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Tae-seo and Eun-a's relationship continues to blossom, progressing from romance to intimacy. But adulthood soon separates them, testing their connection.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: From school to relationships and work, Tae-seo struggles to juggle his responsibilities. Meanwhile, Eun-a's career begins to reshape her life.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Ten years later, Tae-seo and Eun-a live completely different lives. One day, they cross paths again by chance — stirring old feelings.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: After running into Eun-a again, Tae-seo looks after her out of concern — but unresolved feelings keep things awkward between them.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-a and Tae-seo slowly settle back into their rekindled rhythm. Meanwhile, they both navigate challenging personal and family issues.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Despite help from Bae Seong-chan, Eun-a struggles to find her place in the world. Tae-seo deals with unease as he confronts his family's health issues.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-a makes a decision that forces her and Tae-seo apart again. Soon after, a major misunderstanding leaves him heartbroken and betrayed.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Before long, Tae-seo's life returns to how it was before he reunited with Eun-a. But the question of why they broke up still lingers in his mind.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-a decides where she will go, while Tae-seo decides how to say goodbye. Will their love endure -- even until the very last moment?

title: Never Forget Your Enemy
overview: After a car accident, Gi Ha Neul wakes up at age 29 with only the memories of his 19-year-old self, losing an entire decade of his life. The biggest shock comes when he learns that during those missing years, he was in a seven-year relationship with his lifelong rival, Yeo Sae Byeok. While photos, messages, and even his own instincts suggest they were deeply in love, Ha Neul remembers him only as the enemy who overshadowed him throughout childhood. As fragments of memory slowly return, he begins to suspect that their relationship ended for a reason and that Sae Byeok may be hiding the truth.

episodeGuide.title: Childhood Enemies
episodeGuide.summary: Gi Ha Neul wakes up in the hospital after a car accident, suffering from retrograde amnesia that erases his memories of the past 10 years—he still thinks he's 19 years old.

episodeGuide.title: Back to the Future
episodeGuide.summary: Ha Neul continues to feel like a "intruder" in his own life, finding it difficult to treat his former high school rival as his lover.

title: To My Beloved Thief
overview: Eun-jo is the true identity behind Gil-dong, the legendary righteous bandit who robs corrupt officials and redistributes their wealth to the people. Born as the illegitimate daughter of Minister Hong and raised in the lowest social class, Eun-jo lives in a Joseon society where no one would ever suspect a woman of being a notorious outlaw. Behind this prejudice, she carefully maintains a flawless double life. Meanwhile, Yi Yeol—the prince assigned to capture Gil-dong—falls in love with Eun-jo at first sight and begins to pursue her, completely unaware that the woman he loves is the very thief he is hunting. This is a sweeping and dangerous romance: a woman who unintentionally becomes Joseon's greatest thief and a prince bound by duty find their fates intertwined. When their souls are mysteriously exchanged, they embark on a journey to save each other—and ultimately, to protect the people.

title: Positively Yours
overview: The story of Jang Hui Won, a successful woman who prioritizes her career over marriage. She works late-night shifts and weekends, but one night, her life takes an unexpected turn when she impulsively becomes pregnant with the company's president and insists on marriage.

episodeGuide.title: I Have a Baby?!!
episodeGuide.summary: "There's no marriage in this life!" Jang Hui Won, the youngest manager at a liquor company, says beer is everything. Betrayed by her long-held unrequited love, she feels helpless and reeling. Then, she meets a strange yet charming man and spends an impulsive one-night stand with him...

episodeGuide.title: Love? Let's Do it Properly
episodeGuide.summary: "She's the first person who's ever put me to such a deep sleep!" Du Jun then discovers the woman he's been searching for is pregnant. After a fleeting moment of shock, he begins to pursue her unconditionally. Meanwhile, Hui Won, who has been desperately pushing Du Jun away...

episodeGuide.title: Let's Be Cool About It!
episodeGuide.summary: That night, that man is our company's president?! Hui Won flatly rejects Du Jun's confession, which isn't really a confession. Du Jun is uncomfortable with Hui Won's brashness. Meanwhile, the recipe for a new product that Hui Won was developing is leaked to a competitor, and Hui Won is accused of being an internal spy...

episodeGuide.title: Ah, Alert! A Morning Sickness Alert Has Been Issued
episodeGuide.summary: Ugh! Hui Won's morning sickness has begun! Thanks to Du Jun and Se Hyeon's fantastic collaboration, Hui Won barely escapes the threat of her colleagues discovering her pregnancy. However, with the untimely tears streaming down her face and a loss of appetite, she struggles with morning sickness everyday. But Hui Won...

episodeGuide.title: My Heart Keeps Pounding!
episodeGuide.summary: Du Jun confesses to Hui Won in front of Min Uk! Her heart races with bewilderment and a mixture of excitement and embarrassment. After avoiding Du Jun at work, Hui Won finds herself forced to be with him. Meantime, Min Uk worries about whether or not Hui Won will accept Du Jun's confession...

episodeGuide.title: Declaration of War: One Night vs. 15 Years
episodeGuide.summary: Hui-won activates the elevator emergency system and saves Du-jun from danger! Du-jun falls even deeper for Hui-won. Meanwhile, Min-wook, realizing his feelings for Hui-won are not friendship, but love, declares war on Du-jun and begins to make serious advances toward Hui-won.

episodeGuide.title: Pandora's Box Has Been Opened
episodeGuide.summary: Du-jun sees Hui-won and Min-wook together at the OB/GYN clinic. Hui-won becomes increasingly concerned about Min-wook's presence, and the misunderstanding deepens. Hui-won, too, is secretly resentful of Du-jun's absence from the clinic, and is distraught by Min-wook's confession.

episodeGuide.title: Shh, Don't Let the Copier Catch You
episodeGuide.summary: Hui-won and Du-jun finally confirm their feelings! From snack delivery to naptime, the boss's special support begins. While their precarious yet thrilling office romance continues, Du-jun's hand trauma fuels misunderstandings between Hui-won and Du-jun.

episodeGuide.title: The Man's Way of Love
episodeGuide.summary: Thanks to Du-jun's resourcefulness, Hui-won manages to avert a crisis! However, her teammates' suspicions prevent her from having a moment of peace. Meanwhile, rumors about Du-jun spread, putting his position in jeopardy. Taking advantage of this moment, Jeong-eum begins to make her move in earnest.

episodeGuide.title: Taehan Liquor, I'll Take it
episodeGuide.summary: Thanks to Du-jun's successful press conference, the mood within the company becomes even more subdued. As Du-jun and Hui-won's love deepens, Jeong-eum exploits Du-jun's weakness to become co-CEO, this time targeting Hui-won.

episodeGuide.title: Don't Hide Anymore
episodeGuide.summary: Jeong-eum's rampage exposes Hui-won's secret to the world. Hui-won is bewildered by allegations of preferential treatment in the contest and proposes a new idea to clear her name. Meanwhile, the vote on Du-jun's dismissal approaches, and Du-jun gathers evidence and prepares his final counterattack.

episodeGuide.title: The Greatest Variable of My Life
episodeGuide.summary: Hui-won and Du-jun grow stronger as they confront Jeong-eum, who arrives to ruin their meeting. Du-jun, along with Mi-ran and Min-wook, contemplates a proposal for Hui-won, while Hui-won plans a secret operation for Du-jun. Jeong-eum, who has lost everything, rushes in front of the two, who dream of a happier life.

title: Winter Season
overview: Nine years after their last encounter, Koo Seung Hyeok and Kwon I Hyeon unexpectedly reunite at Nexus, a nightclub linked to organized crime. Seung Hyeok, now the club manager, confronts I Hyeon, who works in lowly conditions, leading to a series of hostile interactions rooted in past grievances. When I Hyeon's father is diagnosed with cancer, he reluctantly re-engages with Seung Hyeok under a work and debt agreement. This forced collaboration ignites complex emotions, as hatred and fixation intertwine. As both men grapple with their tumultuous history—Seung Hyeok's contempt and I Hyeon's struggle with vulnerability—they face the choice between continued conflict or an unforeseen future together.

title: Happy Anding
overview: Asura, a struggling comedy trio made up of Tae-gu, Nam-il, and Jun-seo, who have spent ten years together without recognition. They endured a shabby reality of scant stage income and part-time wages, but after a broadcaster's one-sided taping cancellation, leader Tae-gu declares Asura's breakup. Before them, their feelings jagged and confused, appears a "mysterious suspicious woman" with her face wrapped in a black scarf!

title: No Tail to Tell
overview: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a football player -- altering both of their fates.

episodeGuide.title: An Inevitable Event
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-ho lives a glamorous life granting the wishes of the wealthy. Until one day, she crosses paths with Kang Si-yeol, a high school soccer player.

episodeGuide.title: The Hour of Transfer
episodeGuide.summary: Without explanation, Eun-ho's power drains away after her encounter with Si-yeol. She soon appears before him again, demanding that he make a wish.

episodeGuide.title: The Rise and Fall
episodeGuide.summary: After giving away his wish to Hyeon Woo-seok, Si-yeol enrages Eun-ho — and wakes up to unintended consequences as he tries to understand his new reality.

episodeGuide.title: The Price of Good Deeds
episodeGuide.summary: Desperate for his life back, Si-yeol pleads with Woo-seok to reverse the wish. But Jang Do-cheol kidnaps Si-yeol — putting him and Eun-ho in peril.

episodeGuide.title: The Changer, the Changed, and the Lacking
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-ho and Si-yeol head to the mountains in search of another fox that could help. But they encounter a figure from her past that shocks her.

episodeGuide.title: The False Kindness
episodeGuide.summary: Si-yeol and Eun-ho clash over Geum-ho's plan, each trying to persuade the other that their way is better — and what it means to be human.

episodeGuide.title: The Revenge of Memory
episodeGuide.summary: After surviving a near disaster, Eun-ho and Si-yeol begin to develop a bond. Soon, they try to turn their luck around by stepping up their good deeds.

episodeGuide.title: The Hobby Called Love
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-ho's confession and subsequent actions leave Si-yeol feeling overwhelmed. But after spending quality time together, they end up going on a date.

episodeGuide.title: Love Attack
episodeGuide.summary: After their kiss, Eun-ho and Si-yeol navigate the awkward aftermath. Meanwhile, Do-cheol uses Woo-seok to get one step closer to Eun-ho.

episodeGuide.title: From Chance to Destiny
episodeGuide.summary: Pagun approaches Eun-ho with a sobering truth about Si-yeol and Woo-seok's fate — forcing her to find a way to change destiny as her feelings evolve.

episodeGuide.title: The Way of Humans
episodeGuide.summary: During a date at a soccer game, Eun-ho runs into Lee Yoon — shocking Si-yeol. Meanwhile, Do-cheol uses Geum-ho to obtain the fox bead.

episodeGuide.title: Love Without Regret
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-ho makes a fateful decision to save a dying Si-yeol. Now facing eternal separation, will they ever find their happily ever after?

title: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
overview: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

title: We Are All Trying Here
overview: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: After 20 years trying to make his debut film, Hwang Dong-man flails through life, irritating his director friends — until one day he meets Byeon Eun-a.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: While Dong-man deals with rock bottom, Ko Hye-jin delivers devastating news. Meanwhile, Eun-a seeks counseling as she struggles at work.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-man slowly grows closer to Eun-a. Later, he makes an enemy of Park Gyeong-se — whose film opens to negative critical reception.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Gyeong-se sets his revenge against Dong-man in motion — playing dirty. Meanwhile, Eun-a faces mounting hostility and pressure at work.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Tired of enduring contempt from his peers, Dong-man confronts Gyeong-se. He later chastises Ma Jae-yeong over his relationship with Eun-a.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Dong-man rushes to share a meal with Eun-a — but is met with a surprise. Later, Eun-a receives a phone call that stops her in her tracks.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: As Dong-man and Eun-a's bond deepens, they both make decisions about their scripts. Eun-a and Oh Jeong-hui finally come face-to-face in a tense moment.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: When Dong-man learns that Jae-yeong is about to begin filming, he becomes consumed by envy. Meanwhile, Eun-a decides to confront Jeong-hui directly.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Just as Dong-man is about to debut, his fears haunt him — but Eun-a offers her brand of support. Meanwhile, Eun-a's secret script garners interest.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Desperate to cast Noh Kang-sik, Dong-man takes matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Eun-a grows uneasy as Jeong-hui involves herself in her project.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Despite exciting casting news, Dong-man witnesses an explosive clash between his lead and another actor. Jeong-hui confronts Eun-a about her hostility.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: Eun-a takes a bold step forward in resilience. As Dong-man grows increasingly impatient with production timing, will he finally release his film?

title: Mind the Boy
overview: Jang Gi U is a 32-year-old temporary high school teacher. Four years ago, he became the subject of an inappropriate rumor involving a student. As a result, he never took the teacher certification examination and has instead spent the years moving from one contract teaching position to another. Raised in a single-mother household, he grew up constantly hearing that he had to be someone with "no flaws in the eyes of others." He lives as a person who appears flawless, but his life feels dull and unremarkable. At least, that is what everyone says.

title: Love on the Menu
overview: Some sacrificed love for the sake of family. Others walked away from their families to protect the ones they loved. And some, believing they were acting out of love, only left deeper wounds behind. Years of misunderstanding and conflict have driven them apart, but an unexpected bond and reunion bring them face-to-face once again. As lost love, tangled family ties, and the true feelings they have long kept hidden begin to surface, even the coldest hearts slowly begin to heal. Through love, forgiveness, and the courage to understand one another, they discover what it truly means to be a family. Can the scattered pieces of a family finally find their way back to one warm table?

episodeGuide.title: The Saviour Who Saved My Son
The Secret Behind Gyu Rim's Childbirth

title: Always Meet Again
overview: Everyone has imagined it at least once. What if you could go back to the past? Jang Hye Seong, a well-known painter, visits his alma mater, Seongjin High School, to give a special lecture at the request of his friend Tae Jun. During a break, he stops by the art room and discovers his old sketchbook. Inside it, he finds a drawing of his first love, Lee U Jin, half undressed. On impulse, Hye Seong redraws U Jin right there. The moment he finishes the painting and puts the brush down, he is suddenly transported back to 2008, his high school days, where he reunites with U Jin. Even after returning, Hye Seong doesn't want to repeat the mistakes he made back then, so he tries to keep his distance from U Jin. But with U Jin boldly and persistently coming closer, Hye Seong is left completely defenseless. Their eighteen begins again. Can they change their fate and finally reach each other?

title: Second Plate
overview: Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product. As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.

title: Love in Sync
overview: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

episodeGuide.title: First Encounter
episodeGuide.summary: Yu Ji-an is an actress with a lot of fans thanks to her pretty face, but she is not the kind of actress who acts well. And she feels she is losing her popularity to her rival, Han Yi-jin. So she is advised to get psychological counseling from a famous counselor, Cha Eun-hwan, to get a hint to improve her acting skills from her subconscious. But at their first meeting, an unexpected incident happens.

episodeGuide.title: Ji An’s Downfall
episodeGuide.summary: After Ji An feels panic at Eun Hwan's clinic, she experiences a weird phenomenon, where she can listen to a man's voice out of nowhere. Meanwhile, Ji An meets Moon Gyeong Sik, a famous movie director, and gets cast in his movie, which is a huge opportunity for her. However, the emergence of her bullying video makes her popularity plummet, ruining her bright future.

episodeGuide.title: Attempt to Comeback
episodeGuide.summary: After moving to the small house compared to her previous villa, she realises that Eun Hwan is living across the hall and meets his daughter, Ha Yul. Ji An struggles to make a comeback despite her collapsed reputation in the industry, and she gets a golden chance to audition. Meanwhile, Eun Hwan is frustrated by his guilt over his client's arrest, so he tries to meet the victim of the crime.

episodeGuide.title: Proposal to Eun Hwan
episodeGuide.summary: Finally, Ji An feels sure that Eun Hwan's emotions are transferred to her. She receives praise for her acting because she can finally understand other people's emotions, thanks to transference from Eun Hwan. Hence, she suggests that Eun Hwan be her manager and help her immerse herself in acting. Meanwhile, Eun Hwan's situation is getting worse because he rejects the therapist position at J.An Entertainment and has to close his clinic because of the disciplinary action from the Association. Will he accept Ji An's proposal?

episodeGuide.title: New Manager
episodeGuide.summary: After Eun Hwan accepts Ji An's proposal to be her manager, they start practising their collaboration for the acting so they don't make mistakes during the shoot. However, when the shooting starts, Ji An is flustered upon realising that the emotional transference no longer works, and she is fired from the show. Hence, Eun Hwan tries to cheer her up by enhancing her reputation, and they try to figure out why the emotional transference is not working.

episodeGuide.title: Audition
episodeGuide.summary: Ji An and Eun Hwan guess that the reason why the emotional transference is reversed is the earlier kiss. So they try to kiss every hour in different places. After the emotional transference is reversed again, Ji An passes on an audition and gets a role in Director Moon's film. Also, Eun Hwan tries to find Mi Jeong, who accused Ji An, and tries to find out the truth of the power abuse case from her.

episodeGuide.title: Reveals the Truth
episodeGuide.summary: After Ji An knows that the culprit in Ji An's bullying case might be Yi Jin, she rushes to Yi Jin's dressing room and slaps her on the cheek. CEO Kim tries to drag Ji An down one more time, insisting that their fight was Ji An's one-sided assault. But his plan is ruined by Eun Hwan's attack, and the truth behind Ji An's bullying accusation is revealed. After being rehabilitated, Eun Hwan leaves Ji An, and Ji An is flustered by his absence.

episodeGuide.title: Disappearance
episodeGuide.summary: Ji An's mom, who has always tried to control Ji An, returns and reconciles with her. But after her comeback, Ji An's ordinary life is ruined. She interferes with her career, requesting Director Moon to increase her screen time. Hence, Ji An's reputation collapses again, and even Yi Jin gets angry at Ji An, believing that Ji An is taking her opportunity again. She decides to disappear from the public, and Eun Hwan tries to find her, feeling anxious.

title: A Trap Called Desire
overview: One accusation destroys an ordinary life overnight. Falsely accused of murder, Ko Eun Seol loses her name, her family, and everything she once called her own. Instead of running, she turns hunter. Eun Seol sets out to reclaim what was stolen from her and confront those who sacrificed innocent lives to protect their own ambitions. As she uncovers one hidden truth after another, the fragile alliances built on greed begin to fracture, and the world sustained by lies starts to collapse. Every truth she reveals brings her closer to the conspiracy that branded her a murderer and closer to those determined to silence her. Can Eun Seol expose the conspiracy behind the life that was stolen from her and finally reclaim it? The perfect lie begins to crumble because of the one woman it failed to erase.
broadcast: KBS2 · Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday · 21:10

title: Family Register
overview: Branded as a "mistress' daughter," Na Ji Ni carries lifelong stigma. No Yeong Ju, wrecked by her husband's betrayal, lives with unhealed wounds. Forced under one roof by the man who ruined them both, the two confront buried pain, clashing families, and years of prejudice—fighting to turn bitterness into strength, and maybe into something like family.
broadcast: MBC · Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday

title: Azure Spring
overview: After years marked by injury and failure, former swimmer Anna returns to her quiet seaside hometown, leaving her dreams behind. There, she crosses paths with Yun Deok Hyun, a quiet sea diver who remains trapped in his past, enduring time in silence. Brought together under one roof, Anna begins to learn diving from him, slowly finding her way back to life. But as their distance closes, unspoken emotions rise, and a long buried secret surrounding Deok Hyun begins to fracture their fragile peace. As the past refuses to stay buried, both are pushed to confront what they have been running from and find the courage to move forward.

title: Mission: Mompossible
overview: Cho Mi Mi has spent her entire life as a devoted mother, raising three children alone while running a humble samgyetang restaurant after her husband's affair. Tired of being the family's sole support system, she finally decides to put her own needs first. However, chaos erupts when all three of her adult children unexpectedly return home. In sharp contrast, Jeon Jin Hui married into a wealthy family and has always prioritized her own desires. The women's paths cross when they learn that their children both work at Jin Hui's fashion company: her son Cha Seung Yun is the chief designer, and Mi Mi's daughter Kang Da Mi is his assistant. While Mi Mi and Jin Hui might seem like they have nothing in common, they both find themselves navigating love, ambition, and the true meaning of motherhood.
broadcast: KBS1 · Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday

episodeGuide.title: A Home In Ruins, A Missing Tablet
The Name That Freezes Jin Hee

title: Spooky in Love
overview: When a ghost-seeing heiress and an ace prosecutor discover that a single touch makes them an unlikely crime-solving duo, they team up to uncover unsolved murders. Cheon Yeo-ri, a hotel CEO haunted by spirits of people who died unjustly, joins forces with prosecutor Ma Kang-wook to investigate paranormal cases. As they unravel mysteries together, their strange partnership soon turns into something more romantic.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Haunted by the gift of seeing ghosts, Cheon Yeo-ri keeps others at a distance — except prosecutor Ma Gang-uk, whom she can't seem to stop bumping into.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Gang-uk meets Yeo-ri at yet another crime scene, increasing his suspicions. Kang Min-hwan invites Yeo-ri to his hotel, but strange things occur at night.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: A troubled, tipsy Yeo-ri finds solace in Gang-uk and his coworkers. But the liquid courage causes her to let her guard down — and take her gloves off.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: After experiencing Yeo-ri's ghost-seeing abilities firsthand, Gang-uk begins to understand her burden. Yeo-ri coaches Gang-uk on handling ghosts.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Determined to keep Gang-uk safe from any more deadly trouble, Yeo-ri tells him not to keep in touch — but a new case brings them back together.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Gang-uk and Yeo-ri grow closer. But Cheon Ha-ri's schemes and a health scare threaten Yeo-ri's position — forcing her to come up with an unlikely plan.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo-ri and Gang-uk's sudden engagement shocks everyone. To allay suspicions, they go on a series of sweet dates — sparking mixed emotions in Min-hwan.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Yeo-ri's grandma suggests moving up the wedding, giving Gang-uk the perfect chance to confess. Min-hwan makes a last-ditch effort to win Yeo-ri over.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Gang-uk and Yeo-ri throw a successful engagement party — but the happy couple are forced apart when Yeo-ri's position at work is suddenly threatened.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Gang-uk surprises Yeo-ri on her trip, lifting her spirits. Meanwhile, Gang-uk's grandma changes her mind about their marriage. Min-hwan starts plotting.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Gang-uk spots Yeo-ri at the prosecutor's office but struggles to approach her. A pendant gives him the chance to get close again and show her how he truly feels.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: A comatose Yeo-ri meets some familiar faces. Meanwhile, the truth behind the yacht accident unravels - but someone is determined to keep things hidden.

title: For Romance, Call the Boss
overview: Do Hye-ju is a lifelong singleton juggling two jobs — office worker by day, adult web novel writer by night. When her secret serialization gets discovered by director Han Jung-woo, she's fired on the spot. But when the company realizes they can't do without her, Jung-woo offers to rehire her — and this time, Hye-ju holds all the cards. "Director Han, I want you to be my adult scene consultant." And just like that, their steamy coaching sessions begin. There's just one clause in the contract: "If either party develops real feelings, the contract is immediately terminated." But as their demonstrations bring them closer and closer, Hye-ju finds herself growing confused by Jung-woo's advances. Is this just a demonstration — or something real? A romance more dramatic than any novel is about to begin.

title: Seoul Trip
overview: On the first day of my trip to Seoul, I chased down a man I mistook for a pickpocket, only to end up spending the night with him. To my horror, I later found my wallet tucked safely in my bag—and discovered he was actually waiting for an "outcall service." The moment I'm forced to pay my debt with my body instead of cash, a disastrous misunderstanding spirals into a dangerous Seoul affair.

title: Scandal love
overview: In the highly commercialized idol industry, emotions are often manufactured and sold as part of the brand. Scandal Love follows four women navigating different levels of power within a K-pop girl group system. As they struggle with strict contracts, overwhelming public scrutiny, and their own genuine feelings, each is forced to make impossible choices. The series explores one central question: can real love survive inside relationships that are carefully designed and controlled?

title: Shaman Girl and Her Mr. CEO
overview: Park Seon A, a young shaman who is losing her spiritual powers due to a lack of yang energy, discovers that Lee Jae U, a wheelchair-bound billionaire heir, possesses overwhelming yang energy but suffers greatly because of it. To secure his family's conglomerate and to help Seon A continue her life as a shaman, the two enter into a contract. With his yang energy, Seon A regains the power to perform spells and repeatedly overcomes dangerous situations, while Jae U gradually recovers the use of his legs thanks to her. Together, they defeat Jae U's villainous uncle and Mi Gyeong, Seon A's aunt and a corrupt doctor, before falling in love and choosing to spend the rest of their lives together.

title: Notes from the Last Row
overview: A failed writer-turned-professor finds rare talent in a student's writing — and grows obsessed with his draft as their private lessons go off course.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Impressed by student Lee Kang's remarkable talent, Professor Heo Mun-oh offers him a special writing class — but a troubling request tests his ethics.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Kang's story begins with a chance meeting with his classmate Kim Se-yun. While Mun-oh doubts Kang's motives, a sudden accident reveals a shocking truth.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Mun-oh's obsession with the unfolding story grows as accusations swirl around Se-yun's dad. Kang's continued research leads him to tailing someone.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Suspicion grows as Kang continues his observations. Mun-oh hesitates to stop him from writing. Later, a letter draws Kang to a late-night rendezvous.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: When Kang's story ends on a cliffhanger, Mun-oh anxiously awaits what he'll write next. Se-yun's mom makes a desperate choice to protect her family.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Mun-oh becomes fixated on Kang's writing, while Kang keeps crossing the line for the sake of his craft — pushing both toward a point of no return.

title: Honour
overview: Ra Young, Shin Jae, and Hyun Jin are lawyers at LnJ, a law firm for women who are victims of sexual abuse. Their relationship is well-defined, starting with Shin Jae's leadership as CEO of the firm. Ra Young serves as a messenger, regarded as a celebrity lawyer with outstanding eloquence, while Hyun Jin always rushes to the scene to find out evidence. They start to investigate a sexual abuse case involving underage students, and they confront the challenging situation head-on against the cartel of sexual abuse on digital platforms. As they approach the truth of the case, their lives begin to fall into danger, while their past memories haunt them repeatedly. Will they be able to save the victims and overcome the bruises from their past? It is the perfect time to retrieve their lost honour.

episodeGuide.title: The Confession
episodeGuide.summary: As the nation is rocked by a scandal involving 'national actor' Kang Eun-seok, who is accused of having an inappropriate sexual relationship with a high school girl, Yoo-jeong, Hyun-jin, a lawyer at L&J, struggles to prove Eun-seok's guilt. By chance, Hyun-jin overhears a conversation about the Eun-seok – Yoo-jeong case at the home of her former lover, Jun-hyeok, and is taken aback to realize that the case is far bigger than she had imagined.

episodeGuide.title: The Unveiled Truths
episodeGuide.summary: Jun-hyeok is found dead, and Yoo-jeong claims that she killed him. Hyun-jin finds it hard to believe, so she tries to find out the truth behind Ra-young and Shin-jae. Hyun-jin meets Seon-hwa, hoping she'd share some information about Jun-hyeok. Meanwhile, Ra-young comes home, only to be attacked by a mysterious man.

episodeGuide.title: The Consequences of the Statement Recanting
episodeGuide.summary: Seon-gyu takes DNA samples from Ra-young and Hyun-jin to compare them with the DNA found on an earring discovered at Jun-hyeok's house. Ra-young pulls some strings so that the police don't get their hands on Hyun-jin's DNA. On the day of the crime scene reenactment, Yoo-jeong recants her statement.

episodeGuide.title: The Man Hidden Behind
episodeGuide.summary: Ra-young goes to see Min-seo at the restaurant she works at to convince her to get their help. Seon-gyu accuses Hyun-jin of visiting Jun-hyeok's place on the day of his death. Min-seo decides to get help from L&J under one condition: To live with one of them. Min-seo starts working for L&J, and meets one of the clients from Connect.

episodeGuide.title: An Old Friend
episodeGuide.summary: Park Ju-hwan visits Ra-young at her office, leaving her shaken. He tells her that he's going to reinvestigate his case from 20 years ago. Shin-jae finds out that Ju-hwan is part of the Connect scheme. Meanwhile, Attorney Kwon Jung-hyeon takes over L&J as the new head in order to send Shin-jae to Haeil.

episodeGuide.title: The Inside Men
episodeGuide.summary: Hyun-jin shares the news with Seon-gyu that she's pregnant. However, at the doctor's appointment, Seon-gyu realizes that the baby might not be his. Jun-hyeok's laptop gets recovered, and the voice recording of an interview with Yoo-jeong is revealed. Meanwhile, Lee Seon-hwa steals Jun-hyeok's laptop for the corrupt cop.

episodeGuide.title: Another Victim
episodeGuide.summary: Seon-hwa is found dead in an abandoned building, but Jun-hyeok's laptop is nowhere to be found. Shin-jae decides to marry Tae-joo, announcing to her mother that L&J will go independent. Meanwhile, another victim of Connect is found at Magan Hotel, and Shin-jae asks Tae-joo's help to rescue her.

episodeGuide.title: The Long Awaited Disclosure
episodeGuide.summary: Ra-young manages to save Yeon-hee from Je-yeol. Hyeon-jin saves Da-eun, the victim of Connect, from the hotel room and transfers her to the hospital. Ra-young exposes Connect In live on a news show. After the show airs, the victims of Connect visit the L&J office to reveal the truth.

episodeGuide.title: All-Out Attack on L&J
episodeGuide.summary: With enough statements gathered from the victims, L&J decides to go public with the list of Connect In's clients. As a result of this exposure, a significant social uproar rises, and Joint Investigation Headquarters is formed. However, the lead prosecutors at the Joint Investigation HQ turn out to be Haeil's clients, and Shin-jae immediately realises her mom is behind it.

episodeGuide.title: The Mastermind
episodeGuide.summary: Ra-young gets imprisoned for murdering Je-yeol. While looking for ways to get Ra-young out, Shin-jae and Hyun-jin find out who Han Min-seo really is. Shin-jae confronts Baek Tae-joo after finding out that he was the mastermind behind Connect In. Ra-young's trial is held under unfavourable circumstances, with no additional witnesses coming.

episodeGuide.title: The Ultimate Resolution
episodeGuide.summary: Ra-young goes to see Min-seo at the restaurant she works at to convince her to get their help. Seon-gyu accuses Hyun-jin of visiting Jun-hyeok's place on the day of his death. Min-seo decides to get help from L&J under one condition: To live with one of them. Min-seo starts working for L&J, and meets one of the clients from Connect.

episodeGuide.title: The Final Verdict
episodeGuide.summary: Ra-young reveals that Baek Tae-ju is the man behind Connect In during The Prime's Technical Demonstration. Ra-young and Hyun-jin suggest Shin-jae return to L&J, but she refuses. Shin-Jae tries her best to clean up the damage caused by Haeil, but she faces difficulties due to one man who remains an obstacle until the very end.

title: Beautiful Malice
overview: A girl from Sichuan, Zhang Zhi'an, moves to South Korea to study abroad and stumbles into an elite chaebol academy — landing in Class F, the lowest tier of the social ladder. Here, everyone lives by a strict code of power drawn along lines of birth and family background, and the whole class is steeped in outright malice. But an airhead is the natural antidote to a schemer: armed with her uniquely Chinese brand of relaxed, unbothered obliviousness, Zhang Zhi'an doesn't just fail to sense the hostility around her — she's far too busy wanting to study to care. Then, one day, she lets slip a glimpse of explosive martial-arts skill that floors the entire class. Slowly but surely, in her own distinctly Chinese way, she begins steering the lost, rebellious students of Class F back toward learning — kicking off a fiery, rule-breaking high-school journey in which she climbs step by step through the academy, turning Class F into a name to be reckoned with.

title: Love In Protocol
overview: Jeong Yeon joins the research lab of Yu Geon, his former private tutor, as an intern. However, Yu Geon's attitude upon their reunion is cold. An experiment that studies emotions, and two people facing each other once again. Subtle waves begin to ripple between Jeong Yeon and Yu Geon.

episodeGuide.title: Don't Look at Me Like That
Do I still look like a kid to you?
You Don't Have to Feel Guilty, Professor
So I Came Back All Grown Up

title: Your Personal Taxi
overview: There are times when all we want is for someone to truly listen to our story. And sometimes, we come across a song that feels like it's telling that story for us. Welcome to Your Personal Taxi —a special ride where music plays alongside memories, and your story is met with a listening ear. This isn't just any car—it's a personalized classic, and there's something quietly mysterious about it. Passengers with ordinary yet extraordinary lives step in to share personal stories, along with the songs that carry their emotions.

title: Dream to You
overview: A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.

episodeGuide.title: Su-bin's Return
episodeGuide.summary: Woo Su-bin, a new director, wins an award at an international film festival. During his acceptance speech, he thanks his first love for giving him a dream. After the festival, he visits Korea to meet his first love, Joo Yi-jae who wanted to become a director but works as a reporter. During a conversation, Su-bin suggest they make a film together. However, Yi-jae firmly rejects the offer, revealing deep scars he left on her.

episodeGuide.title: Their Past and Present
episodeGuide.summary: During their senior year of high school, Yi-jae is an aspiring amateur filmmaker. Su-bin also decides to become a director after helping Yi-jae and spending time with her. Although Yi-jae wins an award at a youth film festival, her family fails to show up. Only Su-bin is there to celebrate with her, and the two spend time together after the festival, promising to make movies together in the future. However, neither of their families supports their dreams. Many years later, Su-bin returns to Korea and reunites with Yi-jae, and the long-hidden secret behind their separation begins to unfold.

episodeGuide.title: A New Bond and a Broken Bond
episodeGuide.summary: Yi-jae travels to her hometown to meet and cast Su-bin. As they spend time together, they share a deep conversation about their pasts. However, when Su-bin reveals his hidden history, Yi-jae responds with sarcasm, finding him pathetic. Later, Yi-jae discovers she has been betrayed by her long-standing bond. Meanwhile, Yu-geon is struggling to achieve his own success. One day, he runs into Ha-na again on set. After a brief chat, Yu-geon opens her eyes to a whole new experience. Ha-na later visits Yu-geon's house, where the two begin to form a new bond.

episodeGuide.title: The Contract
episodeGuide.summary: After mulling it over, Yi-jae finally makes a contract with Su-bin, and they move to Bunam to write the script for Gyeongseong Love Song. Working together, Yi-jae's feelings towards him begin to grow despite herself. Meanwhile, Ha-na protects Yu-geon from Sang-yeon. Sa-rang accidentally finds a man she has dreamed of and makes advances.

episodeGuide.title: The Truth
episodeGuide.summary: After spending a night with Sa-rang, In-wook decides to appear on her show because he wants to keep the relationship with her. Yu-geon saves Ha-na from people putting her down, and they open up about their inner wounds and dreams. Meanwhile, Su-bin and Yi-jae's relationship grows steadily as their work goes well. However, Su-bin learns from his father what Yi-jae went through because of him.

episodeGuide.title: The Pre-Production of Gyeongseong Love Song
episodeGuide.summary: Su-bin tries to help Yi-jae in every way after learning about her accident. Therefore, when pre-production for Gyeongseong Love Song begins, Su-bin goes on location scouting and Yi-jae stays indoors for the script meeting. However, it makes Yi-jae feel like she is not approved by the crew because of Su-bin's overprotection. She even overhears colleagues' insults about her lack of experience. Hence, he decides to show Su-bin her willpower. Meanwhile, Yu-geon gets an unexpected opportunity after arguing with his father about his dream.

episodeGuide.title: Ha Na's Decision
episodeGuide.summary: Su Bin and Yi Jae reunite to work together on a new project. Upon learning that Yu Geon is now working alongside Soo Hee, Su Bin can't hide a hint of disappointment, while Yi Jae reacts in a way no one expects. Meanwhile, Ha Na is hurt when Yu Geon begins to distance himself from her. Soon after, Ha Na makes a surprising declaration to her mother, Soo Hee.

episodeGuide.title: Chaos During Filming on Set
episodeGuide.summary: Filming for Su Bin and Yi Jae's movie finally begins, but chaos erupts when Soo Hee suddenly shows up on set and causes a scene. The situation escalates to the point where replacing the male lead is even brought up. Meanwhile, Ha Na gives up her rebellion against Soo Hee and decides to renew her contract with her. On the other hand, someone breaks into Su Bin's empty house late at night and causes a disturbance.

episodeGuide.title: A Connection That Goes Way Back
episodeGuide.summary: Su Bin gets extremely jealous when Seong Moo appears on set and shows how close he is to Yi Jae. The Gyeongseong Love Song crew decides to go on a retreat, and Seong Moo joins as well. From dodgeball to grilling meat, the competition between Su Bin and Seong Moo gets fierce. Meanwhile, Director Kang decides to leave CEO Ahn after getting badly burned.

episodeGuide.title: Confronting the Truth
episodeGuide.summary: News breaks that Su Bin is Ha Na's half-sibling, and reporters flock to the filming location. Due to the scandal, Yi Jae has to handle the movie shoot all by herself. However, the production comes to a halt due to investment issues. Su Bin holds a press conference, and CEO Ahn bursts in to tell the whole truth.

episodeGuide.title: Achieving One’s Dream
episodeGuide.summary: Su Bin tells Yi Jae that he'll drop out of the movie production so that it can proceed smoothly. Yi Jae convinces CEO Ahn to reconsider firing Su Bin. Yi Jae wants to study film abroad, but she struggles to tell Su Bin about it. Meanwhile, Yu Geon finds out that his dad has only three months to live.

episodeGuide.title: The End of a Love Like War
episodeGuide.summary: Yi Jae leaves for Montreal to study film in greater depth. Su Bin goes to the airport to stop her, but he misses her. Gyeongseong Love Song gets released successfully, but Su Bin can't help but feel empty. Two years later, Yi Jae returns, and to Su Bin's surprise, she suggests making a movie with her.

title: The Judge Returns
overview: Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Lee Han-young, a former corrupt judge, comes to his senses after presiding over a trial involving Gojin Chemical.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Lee is assassinated but miraculously travels back in time, determined to right his wrongs.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Lee seeks to correct the sentencing errors he made in the past and is determined to avoid similar mistakes.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: Seoul presents a hidden advantage to Lee and he forms an alliance with Prosecutor Kim Jin-a.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: A step closer to finding his killer, Lee makes a bold decision and pledges false allegiance to Kang Sin-jin.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Judge Lee obtains incriminating evidence of Woo and continues to expand his influence.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: Judge Lee continues to gain Kang Sin-jin's trust, while discovering more corruption.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Kang is wary of Lee and sets out to test his loyalty.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Lee and his allies devise a plan to intercept Kang's hidden funds but meet with an unexpected obstacle.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: Judge Lee and Kang Sin-jin begin to disagree, and Kang reveals a shocking truth to Lee.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Judge Lee continues his partnership with Kang and secretly plots to take down a greater evil.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As Judge Lee's plans begin to materialize, Kang continues to seize more control.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 13
episodeGuide.summary: Judge Lee reveals his true identity to Kang Sin-jin, but the worst is yet to come.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 14
episodeGuide.summary: Han-young, falsely accused of murder and pursued by the police just like in his previous life, embarks on a final operation to clear his name and bring Shin-jin to justice.

title: Proxy Driver
overview: Jae-hoon is a timid man who works as a designated driver to make ends meet after being unfairly fired. When he becomes the target of violent exploitation by Jun-hyuk, a drunken team leader at a major corporation, he finds himself trapped in an abnormal relationship marred by power and emotional dependence. Within this toxic cycle, Jae-hoon struggles to reclaim his lost dignity and humanity.

title: Private Lesson
overview: College freshman Jae On has harbored a secret crush on his former tutor, Hyeon Seo, for three long years. When Hyeon Seo finally tries to move on from his own painful, unrequited love, Jae On seizes the opportunity to boldly confess his feelings. Terrified that the younger man will suffer the same heartbreak he did, Hyeon Seo desperately pushes him away, but Jae On's relentless and passionate pursuit begins to slowly dismantle his guarded heart.

title: D-100: Marry My Ex to My Bestie
overview: On her wedding day, Ye Rin is betrayed by her fiancé and best friend and loses her life. In her final moments, she realizes the only man who truly loved her was the one she once rejected. When she wakes up at the moment of the proposal, she chooses revenge—bringing the two together and leading them toward ruin. But as she grows closer to the man she once turned away, her feelings begin to change. Caught between revenge and love, can Ye Rin reclaim everything and find true love?

title: Mad Concrete Dreams
overview: In Korea, nothing defines success more than owning a building. Ki Su-jong, once an ordinary office worker, believes that going all in—risking everything and drowning in debt—to finally become a landlord will be his way out. But when global capital swoops in and threatens to push his building into foreclosure, Su-jong clings to a desperate plan with his best friend: a staged kidnapping in the building's basement that spirals into a real one. Trapped in a chain of crimes that could destroy his life or save it, Su-jong is forced to make impossible choices. How far will he go to keep his dream from collapsing?

episodeGuide.title: Episode 1
episodeGuide.summary: Landlord Gi Su-jong struggles to make ends meet and faces the threat of losing his property.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 2
episodeGuide.summary: Desperate to save his building, Su-jong stages an abduction in an attempt to pay off his debt.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 3
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jong pulls off the staged abduction, unaware that Detective Ko Ju-ran is on his tail.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 4
episodeGuide.summary: As secrets continue to unravel, Su-jong faces a new threat.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 5
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jong receives an offer on his building and attempts to eliminate other threats.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 6
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jong and his wife, Kim Seon, face a dangerous situation and go against all odds to survive.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 7
episodeGuide.summary: While Su-jong's daughter, Da-rae, uncovers her parents' secrets, Su-jong discovers another body.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 8
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jong and Kim Seon's plans backfire.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 9
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jong tries to keep his family safe, but things go awry

episodeGuide.title: Episode 10
episodeGuide.summary: A brutal fight breaks out as Su-jong's building catches fire.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 11
episodeGuide.summary: Su-jong escapes the police while Kim Seon struggles to hold on to crucial evidence against Real Capital.

episodeGuide.title: Episode 12
episodeGuide.summary: As Su-jong makes an unexpected alliance, he finds himself facing the music for his past actions.

title: Sweet Blood
overview: On the night of a blue moon lunar eclipse that happens once in ten years, the portal between the vampire world, where drinking human blood is forbidden, and the human world opens. Lucifer, a vampire prince who desperately craves human blood, descends into the human world. Min U, a university student in his early twenties, moves to the city from the countryside. He works tirelessly, day and night, to save up for tuition while also studying hard. However, Min U contracts a rare disease that puts his life at risk whenever he bleeds. One day, Min U becomes a victim of a hit-and-run accident, bleeding and finding himself in a life-threatening situation. Lucifer, drawn by the scent of blood, attacks Min U. However, something strange happens: Lucifer collapses, and Min U miraculously survives, unharmed.

title: Rule 101
overview: A wealthy professor consumed by sex addiction. A group of students drawn into a forbidden ethical abyss. When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

title: Play Me
overview: The top star Jung Yihyun, who started as a child actor, decides to quit the entertainment industry due to his mother's sudden death. Kang Jaewon, a part-time worker who lives from hand to mouth, has to temporarily give up his actor dream due to real-life pressures. The two, who had a falling-out in high school due to a misunderstanding, reunite years later because of a musical. Through portraying the characters, they rediscover love.
